abothid.name: Abothid

traits.name: Poison Cloud
traits.desc: The abothid is constantly surrounded by a cloud of gas that is toxic to non-abothids. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or begin suffocating and be stunned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abothid makes two tentacle attacks. If it is grappling a creature, the abothid can also use its tongue sting once.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage (constriction). If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). The abothid has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tongue Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack (Dexterity-based): +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a disease: the injection of a minuscule abothid egg. A humanoid can carry only one abothid egg to term. The egg hatches after 24 hours, producing a larva that climbs to the brain over a number of hours equal to 1d12 + the infected target's Constitution score. During this time, the victim is poisoned and can't regain hit points. Once the larva reaches the brain, the infected target's hit point maximum is reduced by 10 (3d6) per 24 hours. If the larva reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, its transformation into an abothid is complete. Only a wish spell can reverse the transformation.

actions.name: Enslavement (1/Day)
actions.desc: The abothid targets a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the abothid for 1 hour. A charmed target is under the abothid's control and can take no actions except to defend itself to the best of its ability. The abothid can use its telepathy to give orders to the target. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The effect also ends early if the abothid is destroyed, moves more than 1 mile away from the target, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end it.

actions.name: Psychic Drain
actions.desc: The abothid can feed on the psyche of an enslaved target within 60 feet to regain hit points. It deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage to the target and regains an equal number of hit points. This ability uses all of the abothid's actions for that turn.

abothid.languages: Undercommon, Deep Speech, the racial language of its originating creature

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Akyishigal's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: magic circle, detect evil and good, teleport
3/day each: polymorph (vermin form only), dispel magic, insect plague (as a 6th-level spell)
1/day: contagion (filth fever only)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Akyishigal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: Akyishigal can summon one chasme. The demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Akyishigal, acts as his ally, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 1 minute, until Akyishigal dies, or until he dismisses it as an action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Akyishigal makes four claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Swarms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Akyishigal surrounds himself with a cloud of stinging flying insects that pour out of his mouth, eyes, and the sores marking his skin. The cloud surrounds him to a distance of 5 feet. While the cloak is active, attacks against him have disadvantage, and Akyishigal can see in all directions (through the insects' eyes). Any living creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of Akyishigal takes 11 (2d10) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is also poisoned for 1 hour. The swarm persists for 5 rounds. It dissipates instantly if Akyishigal takes 30 damage from an attack that isn't made with a weapon and to which he isn't resistant. While a character is poisoned by the cloak of swarms, the stench of carrion hangs about them. Any vermin not controlled by a creature attacks that character on sight, in preference to all other targets.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal teleports to a spot he can see.

legendaryActions.name: Frenzy Move
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal combines an attack with a move of up to 20 feet, as if using the Withdraw action; he doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Akyishigal casts insect plague using his innate spellcasting.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: An ala doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Poisoned Flesh
traits.desc: An ala's flesh is suffused with poison. A creature that hits an ala with a bite attack must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Storm Strength
traits.desc: If a thunderstorm is raging near an ala and its target, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw against the ala's lightning kiss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An ala makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Lightning Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A target within 60 feet must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: An algorith is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An algorith's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: aid, detect magic, blur, dimension door
5/day each: dispel magic
1/day each: commune (five questions), wall of force

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An algorith makes two logic-razor attacks.

actions.name: Logic Razor
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12+5) force damage.

actions.name: Cone of Negation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: An algorith projects a cone of null energy. A target in the 30-foot cone takes 42 (12d6) force damage and is subjected to the dispel magic spell. A successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and negates the dispel effect.

actions.name: Reality Bomb (5/Day)
actions.desc: An algorith conjures a tiny rune of law and hurls it as a weapon. Each creature within 30 feet of the square where the reality bomb lands takes 21 (6d6) force damage and is stunned until the start of the algorith's next turn. A successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and prevents the stun.

traits.name: Shadow Born
traits.desc: Each turn, Alquam can take the Hide action as a bonus action when in dim light or darkness, even while being observed by another creature.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Alquam's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: silence, darkness
3/day each: invisibility, fear, teleport
1/day: circle of death

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: Alquam has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Alquam fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Alquam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Alquam's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alquam makes one bite attack, one wing attack, and one talons attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 17). Alquam can grapple one creature at a time while on the ground, or two while flying. He can't use the talons holding a grappled creature to attack another creature.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Alquam makes one attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: Alquam flies up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Shroud (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: A veil of magical darkness radiates from Alquam's body in a 30-foot radius. The darkness persists until the start of Alquam's next turn.

traits.name: Woodland Friend
traits.desc: While in a forest, an alseid leaves no tracks and automatically knows the direction of true north.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/300 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Woodland Friend
traits.desc: While in a forest, an alseid leaves no tracks and automatically knows the direction of true north.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The grove warden is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, guidance, produce flame, shillelagh
1st level (4 slots): animal friendship, cure wounds, faerie fire
2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, heat metal, lesser restoration
3rd level (2 slots): call lightning, dispel magic

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit (+5 with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage, 5 (1d8+1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, or 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/300 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.desc: When an amanita myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet sense its pain.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The myconid uses its Amanita Spores or Rapport Spores, then makes one fist attack.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (4d4+1) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Amanita Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: The myconid targets a creature it can see within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 3 rounds. While poisoned this way, it takes 10 (4d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Rapport Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: The myconid targets a creature it can see within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious and be poisoned for 1 minute. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The amphibian can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Aquatic Advantage
traits.desc: While underwater, the amphibian has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, as well as on Dexterity saving throws made to avoid danger. If it swims in a straight line, it can take the Dash action.

traits.name: Hind Legs
traits.desc: The amphibian gains 2 extra claw attacks with its hind legs when it attacks while swimming.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An unarmed amphibian makes 3 attacks: 1 with its bite and 2 with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) slashing damage.

Variant: Armed Amphibian. Amphibians serving an aboleth are sometimes trained to fight with two-handed reach weapons or thrown weapons. In that case, they get only one attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: the target is restrained. It can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees a target without harming it and destroys the net.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: An amphiptere doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Crowd
traits.desc: Two amphipteres can occupy the same space at the same time. An amphiptere sharing its space with a non-incapacitated kin has advantage on its melee attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An amphiptere makes one bite attack and one tail stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An andrenjinyi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, using verbal components only:
At will: speak with animals, create water, stone shape
3/day each: control weather, dispel magic, reincarnate
1/day each: commune with nature, contagion, plant growth, blight, flesh to stone

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: An andrenjinyi's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An andrenjinyi makes two attacks, the first with its bite and the second with Constrict. If both attacks hit the same target, that target is swallowed.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12+10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12+10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the andrenjinyi can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Rainbow
actions.desc: As an action, an andrenjinyi can teleport instantly between two sources of fresh water within 1 mile. If it uses this power during a turn, it can't move normally or take any other action that turn. When this power activates, a rainbow appears for 1 minute between the starting point and the destination.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: If an andrenjinyi hits the same target with both its bite and its Constrict in one turn, it swallows that creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the andrenjinyi. An andrenjinyi can hold up to three Medium or four Small creatures at a time. If a swallowed creature deals 20 damage or more to the andrenjinyi in a single turn, the andrenjinyi must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 5 feet of the serpent. If the andrenjinyi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by expending 15 feet of movement, exiting prone. An andrenjinyi can regurgitate swallowed creatures as a free action.

actions.name: Transmuting Gullet
actions.desc: When a creature is swallowed by an andrenjinyi, it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failure, it is subjected to the true polymorph spell, with the andrenjinyi choosing its new form. This is a permanent effect that can be dispelled or ended only by a wish or similar magic.

traits.name: Shapeshifter
traits.desc: An angel can choose among several forms: a winged celestial form, its original mortal form, and the form of a Medium eagle. Its statistics are the same in each form, apart from the attacks it can make in eagle form.

traits.name: Constant Companion
traits.desc: Faithful angels always know their companion's mood and state of health. Damage dealt to one of them is split between the two; if the damage can't be split evenly, the original target of the attack takes the extra point. Any other harmful effect, such as ability damage, affects both in the same manner.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A faithful angel's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: guidance, spare the dying, light, purify food and drink
3/day: scorching ray (five rays), cure wounds
1/day: enhance ability, bless, detect evil and good, daylight, protection from evil and good, hallow

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: An angel's weapon attacks are magical while it is in eagle form.

traits.name: By My Love's Side
traits.desc: If separated from its companion, each faithful angel can use plane shift and teleport once per day to rejoin them.

traits.name: Unfailing Loyalty
traits.desc: Faithful angels never willingly part from their companion. No spell or power can compel a faithful angel to act against its companion, and no charm or domination effect can keep them apart or change the love and loyalty they feel for each other.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An angel makes two attacks with its longsword or longbow; in eagle form, it can instead make two talon attacks and one beak attack.

actions.name: Longsword +1 (Mortal or Angel Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8+6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10+6) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow +1 (Mortal or Angel Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Beak (Eagle Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons (Eagle Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Sand Walk
traits.desc: Instead of moving, an anubian's humanoid form can disintegrate into a heap of sand and reform in another unoccupied space within 10 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. After using this trait in sandy terrain, the anubian can hide as part of this movement, even while being observed. Anubians can use their sand walk to pass under doors or through similar obstacles, provided these have an opening wide enough to let sand through.

traits.name: Water Vulnerability
traits.desc: For every 5 feet an anubian moves in contact with water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 (1d4) cold damage. A fully submerged anubian takes 10 (4d4) cold damage at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An anubian makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Haboob (1/Day)
actions.desc: An anubian can create a sandstorm in the shape of a cylinder 30 feet tall with a 5-foot radius that moves with it. Visibility in the sandstorm's area is zero, and any non-anubian creature that enters it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength check or be restrained by it. In addition, any non-anubian creature that ends its turn in the sandstorm takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage. The anubian can maintain the haboob for up to 10 minutes by concentrating as if on a spell. While concentrating this way, its speed is reduced to 5 feet and it can't use its sand walk. Creatures restrained by the sandstorm move with the anubian. A creature can attempt to free itself or an adjacent creature caught in the sandstorm by using an action to make a DC 13 Strength check. On a success, the targeted creature is no longer restrained.

traits.name: Infectious Ichor
traits.desc: Whenever an apau perape takes piercing or slashing damage, a jet of caustic blood sprays from the wound toward the attacker. This jet forms a line 10 feet long and 5 feet wide. The first creature in the line's path must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become infected with the ichor of Mechuiti disease. The creature remains poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours, the target repeats the Constitution saving throw; on a failure, its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (2d4). On a success, the disease is cured. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction to a creature's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An apau perape is an innate spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
1/day each: wall of fire, fear

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An apau perape has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: The apau perape attempts to magically summon a creature of its choice. It has a 50 percent chance of summoning another apau perape or a giant ape.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An apau perape makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of the spider's next turn. A creature automatically fails this saving throw and takes an extra 1d6 poison damage if a different red-lined spider bites it while it is already poisoned this way.

actions.name: Diving Line
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: the spider immediately moves the full length of its silk line (up to 60 feet) to reach the target and bites it with advantage. This attack works only if the spider is above its target and at least 10 feet away from it.

traits.name: Unusual Understanding
traits.desc: A spider of Leng can read and use any scroll.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The spider of Leng uses Intelligence as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: comprehend languages, detect magic, shocking grasp
3/day each: shield, silence
1/day each: arcane eye, confusion, hypnotic pattern, stoneskin

traits.name: Poisonous Blood
traits.desc: An attacker that hits a spider of Leng with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shocking Retort
traits.desc: When a spider of Leng casts shield, it can also make one shocking grasp attack for 9 (2d8) lightning damage against an enemy within 5 feet as part of the same reaction.

traits.name: Ancestral Hate
traits.desc: A spider of Leng reduced to 0 hit points makes one final venom spit attack before dying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A spider of Leng makes two claw attacks, two staff attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10+3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Venom Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8+3) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Staff of Leng
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of the spider's next turn.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The sand spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ambush Burrow
traits.desc: When a creature passes over a sand spider's hidden burrow, the spider can use its reaction to attack that creature with two impaling leg attacks; the creature is considered surprised for both attacks. If either or both attacks hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the spider and the target contest Strength. If the target wins, it can immediately move 5 feet away from the spider. On a tie, it is grappled (escape DC 15). If the spider wins, it grapples the target and drags it 30 feet into its lair. If the creature is still grappled at the start of the spider's next turn, it is instead restrained. Once restrained, it can escape by using an action and succeeding on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand spider makes two impaling leg attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Impaling Legs
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage. If the sand spider scores a critical hit with this attack, roll the damage dice three times instead of twice. If both impaling leg attacks hit the same target, the second hit deals an extra 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Camouflaged Webs
traits.desc: A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check is required to spot a j'ba fofi's web. A creature that doesn't notice it and comes into contact with the web is restrained. A restrained creature can free itself by using an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Strength check. The web can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp, vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Arachnid Sympathy
traits.desc: No ordinary spider attacks a j'ba fofi unless magically controlled or attacked first. In addition, every j'ba fofi is accompanied by a swarm of spiders (a variant of the insect swarm) that moves and attacks at the j'ba fofi's mental direction (directing the swarm costs it no action).

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the j'ba fofi knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this attack is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points.

traits.name: Specter Walk
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the specter spider turns invisible and intangible. This invisibility doesn't end when it attacks. While invisible, the spider has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gains the following benefits: resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons; immunity to the paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned conditions. The specter walk ends when the spider ends it as a bonus action or when it dies.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (Specter Walk Only)
traits.desc: The specter spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The specter spider makes two bite attacks. It can make one phantom snare attack in place of a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. While the spider is using its specter walk, its bite and poison deal half damage to targets not affected by a phantom snare (see below).

actions.name: Phantom Snare (Specter Walk Only, Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: the target is restrained by a ghostly web. While restrained this way, it is invisible to all creatures except specter spiders and has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. A creature restrained by a phantom snare can escape by spending an action and succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. The web strands can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The thief spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The thief spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Assisted Leap
traits.desc: If its barbed line attack is available, the spider can use its movement to leap 20 feet in a direction of its choice, trailing the line like a strand of web. The line anchors to an object, and the spider reels itself in immediately. It can carry up to 25 extra pounds when moving this way. This kind of movement doesn't count as spending the barbed line attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thief spider makes two sickle-claw attacks.

actions.name: Sickle Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8+1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Line (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Instead of moving, the thief spider can retract the barbed line and pull itself onto the grappled creature (it enters and stays in that creature's space). The spider's sickle claw attack has advantage against a grappled creature in the same space. If the grappled creature breaks free, the spider immediately moves into an occupied space within 5 feet.

arbeyach.name: Arbeyach
arbeyach.speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft. (hover)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Arbeyach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Arbeyach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Arbeyach's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Arbeyach's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: poison spray. 3/day each: fog cloud, stinking cloud. 1/day each: contagion, insect plague, cloudkill

traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to Arbeyach that starts its turn within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw unless Arbeyach is incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to Arbeyach's aura of fear for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Aura of Virulence
traits.desc: Creatures that would normally be resistant or immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition lose that resistance or immunity while within 120 feet of Arbeyach. All other creatures in that area have disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal poison damage or impose the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Prince of Swarms
traits.desc: Within 120 feet, Arbeyach can communicate via pheromone transmission with Arbeyach's spawn and with all insects and vermin, including swarms and giant varieties. Within a hive, this range extends to the entire hive. This is a silent, instantaneous mode of communication that only Arbeyach, its spawn, insects, and vermin can understand. All such creatures obey Arbeyach and never harm it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Arbeyach makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with a curse called Arbeyach's rot. The cursed target is poisoned, can't regain hit points, has its hit point maximum reduced by 13 (3d8) every 24 hours, and is attacked on sight by vermin. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of the curse, it dies and immediately transforms into a swarm of randomly chosen insects. The curse lasts until it is removed with remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Vermin Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Arbeyach exhales a cloud of vermin in a line 120 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line takes 54 (12d8) poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails the saving throw must also make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw to avoid being afflicted with Arbeyach's rot (see the Bite attack). In addition, Arbeyach summons a swarm of insects (of any kind) at a point of its choice on the line. The swarm persists for 2 minutes unless it is destroyed or Arbeyach dismisses it as a bonus action. Arbeyach can have no more than five insect swarms at a time.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach moves up to half its speed, using whichever movement type it chooses.

legendaryActions.name: Poison
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach targets one creature within 120 feet of it. If the target isn't poisoned, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach casts a spell.

arbre-feuilledragon.name: Dragonleaf Tree
arbre-feuilledragon.languages: understands the languages of its creator or its designated master

traits.name: Loyal to Dragon Master
traits.desc: A dragonleaf tree follows only the orders of its designated master (or of any creature to which that master has handed over control). It has advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that would charm or compel it. In addition, the tree has advantage on all saving throws made to resist a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check intended to influence it to act against its master.

traits.name: Weaknesses
traits.desc: Dragonleaf trees immune to fire are vulnerable to cold, and trees immune to cold are vulnerable to fire.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 58 (10d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Leaves
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (10d8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A dragonleaf tree can use its leaves to create a breath weapon matching the dragon it honors. The creature's breath deals 49 (14d6) damage, or half as much damage to targets that succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A black, copper, or green tree spits a 60-foot line of acid; a blue or bronze tree spits a 60-foot line of lightning; a brass, gold, or red tree spits a 30-foot cone of fire; and a silver or white tree spits a 30-foot cone of cold.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A feywarden tree has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Contractibility and Conductivity
traits.desc: Certain spells and effects affect feywarden trees in special ways. A magical attack that deals cold damage slows a feywarden tree (as if it were under the effects of the slow spell) for 3 rounds. A magical attack that deals lightning damage ends any slow effect on the feywarden tree and lets it regain 1 hit point for every 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If this healing raises the tree's hit points above its hit point maximum, the excess becomes temporary hit points. The tree makes no saving throws against lightning effects.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A feywarden tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: A feywarden tree's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Guardian Reach
traits.desc: Creatures within 15 feet of a feywarden tree provoke opportunity attacks from it even if they take the Disengage action before moving out of reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tree makes two razor-leaf branch attacks and, as a bonus action, it can make one razor-leaf branch attack against a creature adjacent to its space.

actions.name: Razor-Leaf Branch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flaying Leaves (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The tree can hurl a volley of razor-sharp cold iron leaves in a 20-foot radius around it. All creatures in the area of effect must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Beast Hunter
traits.desc: The elven veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track a beast and on Intelligence (Nature) checks to recall information about a beast.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: The veteran archer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Hearing
traits.desc: The veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The veteran archer's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Quiet Traveler
traits.desc: The elven veteran archer can use Stealth even while moving at a normal pace.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the veteran archer surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elven veteran archer makes two melee attacks or three ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The veteran archer makes a ranged attack against every enemy within 10 feet of a point it can see.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: An asanbosam can climb difficult surfaces, including moving upside down along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Tree Dweller
traits.desc: While in a tree, an asanbosam can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An asanbosam makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution check against disease. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) poison damage and is poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours, the victim must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction persists until the disease is cured. If the creature's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of the disease, it dies.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled this way, the target is restrained, and the asanbosam can't claw another target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against disease or contract the disease described in the Bite attack section.

traits.name: Extradimensional Book Repository
traits.desc: A small door on the librarian automaton's chest opens onto an extradimensional shelf. It functions exactly like a bag of holding, but it can hold only written material, such as books, scrolls, folders, notebooks, spellbooks, and the like.

actions.name: Confounding Gaze
actions.desc: The librarian automaton chooses one creature it can see within 40 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or take 9 (3d4 + 2) psychic damage and have disadvantage on Intelligence-based checks, saving throws, and attacks until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

actions.name: Bibliotelekinesis
actions.desc: This power functions like the mage hand cantrip, but it works only on books, scrolls, maps, and other printed or written materials.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The ostrich can jump up to 20 feet long and up to 10 feet high, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Bounding Warrior
traits.desc: If a riderless ostrich jumps at least 10 feet and lands within 5 feet of a creature, it has advantage on attacks against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ostrich makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Freezing Presence
traits.desc: Boreas freezes everything within 150 feet of him. After 5 rounds, nonmagical fires the size of a campfire are extinguished. Water freezes after 1 minute. Spells that protect against cold are immediately subject to dispel magic (with a spellcasting ability of +10) within 150 feet of Boreas.

traits.name: Wind Form
traits.desc: As an action, Boreas can shift between his humanoid body and a body made of wind and mist, but he can't be forced to change shape. In his wind form, he can use his whirling burst attack and cast his spells, but he can't make weapon attacks. A creature with truesight sees both his forms at once.

traits.name: Freedom of the Wind
traits.desc: No lock, manacle, rope, or other bond can hold Boreas.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Boreas's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: aid, speak with animals, create or destroy water, detect magic, invisibility, polymorph, wind wall, true seeing. 3/day each: call lightning, control weather, dispel magic, lesser restoration, cure wounds, ice storm. 1/day each: chain lightning, shapechange, finger of death, heal, word of recall, wall of ice, earthquake

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The avatar of Boreas regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the avatar of Boreas takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The avatar of Boreas dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Boreas makes four ice lance attacks, four north wind longbow attacks, or two whirling bursts.

actions.name: Ice Lance (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) cold damage.

actions.name: North Wind Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Whirling Burst (Wind Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 50 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d12 + 5) slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Ice Lance
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas makes one ice lance attack.

legendaryActions.name: Icy Gaze of the North Wind
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas can freeze an enemy with a glance. A creature within 60 feet of the avatar of Boreas that it can see must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be petrified until the start of the avatar's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Whirlwind Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas suddenly transforms into an icy whirlwind. Normal and magical light sources within 20 feet of him are automatically extinguished. Each creature within 20 feet of the avatar must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) cold damage. The avatar can then fly away, moving up to half its flying speed.

traits.name: Healing Oil
traits.desc: As an action, a bagiennik can automatically stabilize a dying creature by smearing some of its oily secretion on the creature's flesh. If it performs the same gesture on a creature that is already stable or that has at least 1 hit point, the oil has the same effect as a potion of healing and restores 2d4 + 2 hit points to the creature. Alternatively, the bagiennik's secretion can have the same effect as the lesser restoration spell. However, any creature that receives a bagiennik's healing oil must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be slowed for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bagiennik makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Jet
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling prone because of the slippery oil, which covers a 5-foot-square area. A creature that enters the oily area or ends its turn there must also make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling. A creature makes only one saving throw per turn per 5-foot-square area, even if it enters and ends its turn in the same area. The slippery effect lasts for 3 rounds.

traits.name: Burning Touch
traits.desc: An abominable beauty's slam attack deals 28 (8d6) fire damage. A creature that touches it also takes 28 (8d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An abominable beauty makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) damage plus 28 (8d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Blinding Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A creature within 30 feet of an abominable beauty that is targeted by this attack and that meets the abominable beauty's gaze must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be blinded. On a success, the creature develops permanent immunity to that abominable beauty's blinding gaze.

actions.name: Deafening Voice (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: An abominable beauty's voice is lovely, but each creature within 90 feet of it that can hear it when it uses its deafening voice attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be permanently deafened.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A behtu exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 21 (5d8) fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Ichor Infusions
actions.desc: War bands of behtus carry 1d6 vials of ichor infusions. They usually drink one before springing an ambush. For 2d6 rounds after drinking one, behtus gain a +4 bonus to their Strength and Constitution scores, and their base speed (including their climbing speed) is quadrupled. During this time, behtus suffer a −4 penalty to their Intelligence and Wisdom scores. A non-behtu character who drinks a behtu infusion is poisoned and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. On a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw against poison, the character takes half damage and isn't poisoned.

traits.name: Arctic Hunter
traits.desc: A beli has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks made in frozen natural environments.

traits.name: Cold Regeneration
traits.desc: While the temperature is below freezing, a beli regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If the beli takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. A beli dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Aerial Withdrawal
traits.desc: A beli doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A beli's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility. 3/day: chill touch

actions.name: Ice Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Icy Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain two levels of exhaustion from the arrow's freezing touch. On a success, the target also becomes immune to further exhaustion effects from beli arrows for 24 hours (however, any levels of exhaustion it has already gained persist). A character who reaches sixth level of exhaustion doesn't die automatically but falls to 0 hit points and makes death saving throws normally. Levels of exhaustion persist until the creature fully recovers from the cold damage.

traits.name: Grasping Hair
traits.desc: A drowned beauty's hair attacks as if it were three separate limbs. Each can be targeted separately (AC 19; 15 hit points; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered). A lock of hair can be broken by a creature that succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it as an action.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A drowned beauty's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: disguise self, silence

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drowned beauty makes two claw attacks and one hair attack. She can replace any of them with a kiss attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Up to three creatures can be grappled at a time.

actions.name: Kiss
actions.desc: The drowned beauty can kiss a grappled target in an adjacent space. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its Strength reduced by 1d6.

actions.name: Wrap
actions.desc: The drowned beauty can pull a grappled creature of Large size or smaller up to 15 feet in a straight line toward her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bereginyas makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is grappled (escape DC 12), and the bereginyas immediately uses its choke attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Choke
actions.desc: If a bereginyas is grappling an opponent, it uses a bonus action to insert a half-solid, half-gaseous tendril into its victim's throat. The victim must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or immediately be out of breath and start suffocating. The suffocation ends if the victim escapes the grapple or if the bereginyas is killed.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The shadow beast can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The shadow beast can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The shadow beast uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day each: fear, telekinesis

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The shadow beast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in direct sunlight, the shadow beast has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow beast makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Push (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The shadow beast whips its foes with a gust of animated shadows in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area of effect must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Carnivorous Compulsion
traits.desc: If a blemmye sees an incapacitated creature, it must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it can't resist the temptation to move toward the creature and attack it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A blemmye makes two slam attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is an incapacitated creature of Medium size or smaller, it is swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the blemmye, but it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the blemmye's turns. If the blemmye takes 20 damage or more in a single turn from a swallowed creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone within 5 feet of the monster. A blemmye can contain only one swallowed creature at a time. If the blemmye dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can climb out of the carcass by spending 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A boloti can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A boloti's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, water walk. 3/day: control water, create or destroy water, invisibility, fog cloud, water breathing, see invisibility. 1/day: wall of ice

traits.name: Water Mastery
traits.desc: A boloti has advantage on attack rolls if it and its opponent are in the water. If the opponent and the boloti are on land, the boloti has disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Vortex (1/Day)
actions.desc: A boloti can transform into a vortex of swirling water for 4 minutes. It can use this power only while underwater, and it can't leave the water while in vortex form. While in vortex form, the boloti can enter another creature's space and stop there. In this liquid form, a boloti takes damage normally from weapons and magic. A creature that starts its turn in the same space as the boloti takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. If the creature is of Medium size or smaller, a failed save also means it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the target succeeds on its saving throw, it is pushed 5 feet away and ends up in a space different from the boloti's.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The water leaper can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: The water leaper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The water leaper uses its shriek and makes one bite attack and one tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The target is restrained, and the water leaper can't bite another creature while the grapple continues.

actions.name: Shriek
actions.desc: The water leaper lets out a bloodcurdling shriek. Each creature within 40 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be frightened until the start of the water leaper's next turn. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the water leaper's shriek for 24 hours.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The water leaper makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, it swallows the target, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, but it has total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the water leaper. A swallowed target takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of the water leaper's turn. The water leaper can have only one swallowed creature at a time. If it dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can use 5 feet of movement to crawl out of the corpse, landing prone.

traits.name: Aerial Withdrawal
traits.desc: A boucca doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Sunlight Vulnerability
traits.desc: A boucca takes 1 point of radiant damage for each minute it is exposed to sunlight.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A boucca's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility. 3/day each: hex, locate object, darkness

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against poison or have its Strength reduced by 1d2. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. Each time it fails, its Strength is again reduced by 1d2. The effect ends when the target succeeds on a saving throw, or automatically after 4 rounds. All Strength lost this way returns at the end of a long rest.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: A bouda can use an action to polymorph into a human, a hyena, or its true form, which is a hybrid of hyena and humanoid. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for its mephitic claw attack. Any equipment it is wearing isn't transformed. When a bouda is destroyed, it reverts to its true form before crumbling to dust.

traits.name: Demeaning Mark (1/Day)
traits.desc: A bouda can secrete a disgusting, whitish-yellow substance as viscous as tar to mark its food and territory. As a bonus action, a bouda marks a single space, object, or defenseless creature within 5 feet of it. Any living creature within 30 feet of the mark at the start of its turn must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against poison or be poisoned for 1d6 rounds. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that bouda's demeaning mark for 24 hours. The stench given off by a mark persists for one week.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A bouda's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components: Constant: detect magic, detect good and evil. At will: thaumaturgy. 3/day: expeditious retreat, darkness. 1/day: contagion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bouda makes one bite attack and one mephitic claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Mephitic Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 round by the cloud of vermin swarming around the bouda's arms.

actions.name: Voracious Gorging
actions.desc: A bouda devours the organs of a corpse in the corpse's space. The bouda gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the dead creature's hit dice for 1 hour. The organs devoured this way no longer exist, and the creature can't be returned to life with spells or magic effects that require a mostly intact corpse.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The jester uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: At will: disguise self, grease, inflict wounds, magic mouth, misty step. 3/day each: contagion, mirror image. 1/day each: delayed blast fireball, finger of death, mislead, seeming

traits.name: Last Laugh
traits.desc: Unless the macabre jester perishes in a way that amuses the death god who created it, it rises again 1d20 days later, wherever the god wills.

traits.name: Mock the Dying
traits.desc: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the jester have disadvantage.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Ridicule Hope (Recharge 4–6)
traits.desc: When a spell that restores hit points is cast within 60 feet of the jester, the jester can make it deal damage instead of healing. The damage equals the number of hit points that would have been restored.

actions.name: Swap Fools (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The jester forces a Small or Medium humanoid within 60 feet of it to make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target and the jester teleport and exchange places, while an illusion exchanges their appearances: the jester looks like the target and makes the same sounds, while the target takes on the jester's appearance and makes the same noises. The illusion persists for 1 hour, until the jester dismisses it as a bonus action, or until it is dispelled (DC 17).

actions.name: Killing Joke (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The jester tells an old nihilistic joke laden with necromantic power. It has no effect on undead and constructs. Each creature within 60 feet of the jester must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. Those who fail collapse to the ground, laughing. This fit of laughter lasts 1d4 rounds, during which the victim is incapacitated and unable to stand. Each round, at the end of its turn, the incapacitated victim must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. The fit of laughter can be ended early by knocking the victim unconscious or with greater restoration or similar magic.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The buraq's weapon attacks are magical. When the buraq hits with its hooves, it deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack's damage).

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A buraq's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The buraq can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: At will: holy aura, comprehend languages, detect good and evil, pass without trace. 3/day each: longstrider, haste. 1/day each: plane shift, wind walk

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The buraq has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Night Travel
traits.desc: When it is outdoors at night, the buraq's vision isn't limited by nonmagical darkness. Once per month, the buraq can declare that it is undertaking a night journey: for the next 24 hours, it can use its teleport action once per round. Its destination must always be an area of nonmagical darkness it can see. At any point during its night journey, as a bonus action, the buraq can return with its rider to the place where it began the night journey.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The buraq makes two hoof attacks.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.desc: The buraq can magically teleport itself, its rider, and any equipment they carry to a location it is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

camazotz.name: Camazotz
camazotz.languages: Common, Darakhul, Derro, Draconic, Infernal, Void Speech, Dwarvish, Nurian, Primordial

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Camazotz can use its action to take the form of a giant bat covered in smoking ash or revert to its true winged humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in either form. Any equipment it wears or carries isn't transformed. If it is destroyed in either form, it collapses into a heap of greasy ash.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.desc: Camazotz can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: Camazotz has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Gift of Vampirism
traits.desc: Camazotz can choose to bring back those it has killed by reducing their Strength to 0 as vampires. They rise after 1d4 days and are then under Camazotz's permanent control until it decides to return their free will. Camazotz can have no more than ten vampires under its control.

traits.name: Heat Shroud
traits.desc: Camazotz is imbued with the heart of volcanoes. A creature that hits Camazotz with an unarmed strike or a melee weapon without reach automatically takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Camazotz's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: plane shift, shapechange, detect good and evil, dispel magic, telekinesis, teleport, darkness. 3/day each: banishment, haste, symbol. 1/day: earthquake

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Camazotz has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Bats (1/Day)
traits.desc: Camazotz can summon 4d6 giant bats or 2d6 swarms of bats. The bats appear immediately and serve the demon for 1 hour.

traits.name: Summon Demons (1/Day)
traits.desc: Camazotz can summon 2d4 barlguras of a variety endemic to its cavernous realm. They are squat, greasy creatures with clawed wings in place of arms, and they fly at a speed of 40 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Camazotz makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (8d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or have its Strength score reduced by 1d4. A creature reduced to Strength 0 dies.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or have its Strength score reduced by 1d4. A creature reduced to Strength 0 dies.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Camazotz can spit a 30-foot cone of unholy fire. Each creature caught in the area of effect takes 55 (10d10) damage, half of which is fire damage and half necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful DC 22 Dexterity saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.desc: Camazotz makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Camazotz beats its wings, extinguishing ordinary and magical light sources. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage. Camazotz can then fly up to half its flying speed.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A cambium's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: Constant: levitate. At will: plane shift, disguise self, detect thoughts, spare the dying, hold person. 3/day: heal, protection from poison, ray of sickness 18 (4d8), cure wounds 21 (4d8 + 3). 1/day: finger of death

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A cambium makes four needle-finger attacks.

actions.name: Needle Fingers
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. In addition, the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw; on a failure, the cambium inflicts either an ability score reduction or a humoral imbalance. The target can make this saving throw only once per turn, even if it receives more than one needle-finger attack.

actions.name: Ability Score Reduction (3/Day)
actions.desc: If the target of a cambium's needle-finger attack fails its Constitution saving throw, it takes a 1d4 reduction to one ability score (the cambium's choice) until it finishes a long rest. If this effect reduces one of its ability scores to 0, the creature falls unconscious until it regains at least 1 point.

actions.name: Humoral Imbalance (3/Day)
actions.desc: If the target of a cambium's needle-finger attack fails its Constitution saving throw, it suffers one of the following effects. Blood Flux. The target can't be healed, naturally or magically, until it finishes a long rest. Bilious Flux. The target is confused (as if under the effects of the confusion spell) for 3d6 rounds. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, trying to end this effect early. Melancholic Flux. The target is incapacitated for 1d4 rounds and slowed (as if under the effects of the slow spell) for 3d6 rounds. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, trying to end this effect early. Phlegmatic Flux. If the target succeeds on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, this effect is canceled. On a failure, it gains one level of exhaustion that lasts for 3d6 rounds.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.desc: Mole hounds can't burrow through solid rock, but they can dig through softer materials, such as earth or gravel, leaving a tunnel 5 feet wide behind them.

traits.name: Wormkiller Rage
traits.desc: Wild mole hound packs are said to battle monsters in the world's dark underground caverns. If a mole hound draws the blood of vermin, a purple worm, or another subterranean invertebrate, it gains a +4 bonus to its Strength and Constitution but suffers a −2 penalty to its AC. The wormkiller rage lasts 3 rounds. The mole hound can't voluntarily end this state while the creatures that triggered it still live.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A mole hound makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.desc: Mole hound juggernauts can't burrow through solid rock, but they can dig through softer materials, such as earth or gravel, leaving a tunnel 10 feet wide behind them.

traits.name: Ferocity (1/Day)
traits.desc: When a mole hound juggernaut is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Mighty Frame
traits.desc: A mole hound juggernaut is treated as one size category larger than its normal size whenever doing so is to its advantage (for example, on checks made to grapple, shove, or trip, but not when squeezing or for its AC). It has advantage on saves against magical attempts to push it, such as gust of wind or thunderwave.

traits.name: Wormkiller Rage
traits.desc: Wild mole hound juggernaut packs are said to battle monsters in the world's dark underground caverns. If a mole hound juggernaut draws the blood of vermin, a purple worm, or another subterranean invertebrate, it gains a +4 bonus to its Strength and Constitution but suffers a −2 penalty to its AC. The wormkiller rage lasts a number of rounds equal to 1 + the mole hound juggernaut's Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round). It can't voluntarily end this state while the creatures that triggered it still live.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mole hound juggernaut makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Tactical Intuition
traits.desc: The watch captain has advantage on initiative checks. Watch soldiers under the captain's command act on the captain's initiative count.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The watch captain makes two rapier attacks and one dagger attack. The captain can replace a rapier attack with a disarm.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Disarm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or drop an object it is holding, chosen by the captain. The object lands 10 feet from the target in a location of the captain's choice.

actions.name: Order to Attack (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature of the captain's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear it makes one melee attack as a reaction.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A rider is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: sacred flame. 3/day each: plane shift (rider and steed only), phantom steed (which appears as a horse of the rider's appropriate color), ethereal jaunt. 2/day: daylight. 1/day each: fire shield, haste, slow, dimension door

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A rider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Peerless Rider
