traits.desc: All attacks directed at a rider's mount target the rider instead. The mount benefits from the same damage and condition immunities as its rider, and if the rider succeeds on a saving throw against an area effect, its mount takes no damage.

traits.name: Weapon in Hand
traits.desc: As a bonus action, a rider can sheathe its lance to draw its longsword, or vice versa.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A rider makes three attacks with its lance or its longsword. If it has the opportunity, it can use its temporal strike with one of these attacks.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. (disadvantage within 5 ft.), one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Temporal Strike (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: When a rider hits a target with a melee attack, the target takes the attack's normal damage but must also succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or age instantly by 3d10 years. A creature aged this way has disadvantage on its attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws based on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution until the effect is reversed. A creature that exceeds its natural lifespan because of this aging dies immediately. The aging reverses automatically after 24 hours, or it can be magically cured with greater restoration or similar magic. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the temporal strike's effect for 24 hours.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A rider is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: ray of frost. 3/day each: plane shift (rider and steed only), phantom steed (which appears as a horse of the rider's appropriate color), ethereal jaunt. 2/day: darkness. 1/day each: fire shield, haste, slow, dimension door

A creature that exceeds its natural lifespan because of this aging dies immediately. The aging reverses automatically after 24 hours, or it can be magically cured with greater restoration or similar magic. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the temporal strike's effect for 24 hours.

It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day each: plane shift (rider and steed only), phantom steed (which appears as a horse of the rider's appropriate color), ethereal jaunt. 2/day: continual flame, scorching ray. 1/day each: fire shield, haste, slow, dimension door

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. (disadvantage within 5 ft.), one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage.

A creature that exceeds its natural lifespan because of this aging dies immediately. The aging reverses automatically after 24 hours, or it can be magically cured with greater restoration or similar magic. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the temporal strike's effect for 24 hours.

traits.name: Prey Detection
traits.desc: The cerberus can detect the direction of the nearest Medium warm-blooded creature (or Small, failing that) within half a mile. To do so, it makes a Wisdom (Perception) check opposed by the target's Dexterity (Stealth). If the target is more than 1,000 feet away, the cerberus has disadvantage on its check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cerberus makes three bite attacks, one with each head.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned by the saliva.

actions.name: Tear Apart
actions.desc: If the cerberus hits the same target with multiple bite attacks, each head pulls violently in an opposite direction, trying to tear the victim's body apart. The target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage for each hit after the first in the same turn.

traits.name: Heavy Boots
traits.desc: The redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Red Cap
traits.desc: The redcap must soak its hat in the blood of a humanoid killed within the past hour at least once every three days. If it goes more than 72 hours without doing so, the blood dries on its cap and it gains one level of exhaustion every 24 hours. It has no way to get rid of these levels of exhaustion while its cap is dry, but they all disappear immediately once it soaks its cap in fresh blood. A redcap that dies from exhaustion crumbles to dust.

traits.name: Iron-Shod Kick
traits.desc: The redcap kicks a creature within 5 feet of it as a bonus action. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The redcap makes two pike attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target bleeds profusely. A bleeding creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of its turn or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and keep bleeding. On a success, it takes no necrotic damage and the effect ends. A creature takes only 10 necrotic damage per turn from this effect, no matter how many bites it receives, and one successful saving throw ends all the bleeding. The bleeding also stops if someone succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check as an action, or if the creature receives magical healing. Constructs and undead are immune to the bleeding effect.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: A temple cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A temple cat's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). A temple cat can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: guidance. 3/day each: charm person, cure wounds. 1/day: enhance ability (cat's grace only)

traits.name: Ageless Purr
traits.desc: When a cleric or paladin who worships Bastet spends an hour preparing spells while a temple cat of Bastet is within 5 feet, the spellcaster can choose two 1st-level spells and one 2nd-level spell it can cast and imbue the temple cat with them. The cat can then cast those spells 1/day, requiring no verbal components. The cat casts these spells as if they were part of its Innate Spellcasting trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The temple cat makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fascinating Lure
actions.desc: A temple cat emits a loud purr it can direct at a humanoid it can see within 30 feet that can hear it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed. While charmed by the temple cat, the target moves toward the feline at normal speed and tries to pet it or pick it up. A charmed target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that temple cat's fascinating lure for the next 24 hours. The temple cat has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is petting it or holding it in its arms.

traits.name: Summon Bat Swarm
traits.desc: A skin bat can emit shrill cries and draw common bats to it. When a skin bat is in danger, 0-3 (1d4-1) bat swarms arrive after 1d6 rounds. These swarms aren't under the skin bat's control, but they usually attack by reflex the opponent it is fighting.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. In addition, the skin bat attaches to the target. While attached to a creature, the skin bat can't bite another one, and its bite attack automatically hits the creature it is attached to. To remove an attached skin bat, a creature must succeed on a DC 11 Strength check, and the creature from which it is removed takes 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the skin bat's poison for 24 hours.

traits.name: Key to Prophecy
traits.desc: The Emerald Order cult leader can always act in a surprise round, but if it doesn't notice an enemy, it is still considered surprised until it takes an action. It gains a +3 bonus on initiative checks.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The Emerald Order cult leader uses Wisdom as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 2/day each: detect thoughts, haste, slow, dimension door. 1/day each: suggestion, teleport

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: The Emerald Order cult leader is a 10th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): guidance, spare the dying, sacred flame, light, thaumaturgy. 1st level (4 slots): hunter's mark, identify, cure wounds. 2nd level (3 slots): spiritual weapon, lesser restoration, silence. 3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians, mass healing word. 4th level (3 slots): banishment, guardian of faith, death ward. 5th level (2 slots): flame strike

traits.name: Esoteric Vengeance
traits.desc: When the cult leader is hit by a melee attack, it can use its reaction to expend a spell slot to deal 10 (3d6) necrotic damage to the attacker. If it expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Emerald Order cult leader makes one melee attack and casts one cantrip.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A chelicera has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: A chelicera is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast spells without material components. A chelicera has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips: acid splash, minor illusion, mage hand, true strike. 1st level: detect magic, burning hands, ray of sickness, expeditious retreat. 2nd level: hold person, invisibility, scorching ray. 3rd level: animate dead, lightning bolt, haste. 4th level: phantasmal killer

traits.name: Spell Slot Siphon
traits.desc: A chelicera can't recharge its spells naturally. Instead, it uses spellcasters it has grappled as spell reservoirs, fueling its magic by draining the spells they haven't cast. When a chelicera wants to cast a spell, it uses the number of spell slots required to cast it, drawn from its victim's reserve. If the victim doesn't have enough available spell slots, the chelicera can't cast that spell. A chelicera can also draw energy from drained spellcasters or from creatures with no magical powers. It reduces the grappled creature's Wisdom score by 1d4 and adds 2 spell slots to its reserve for each ability point reduced this way. A creature reduced to Wisdom 0 falls unconscious until it regains at least 1 point in that ability, and it has no power left to offer. A creature regains all the Wisdom it lost at the end of a long rest.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: A chelicera can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A chelicera makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). The target must also succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target falls unconscious and takes a 1d4 reduction to its Strength at the start of each of its turns. The poison ends after 4 rounds, or when the target succeeds on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of one of its turns.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A chernomoi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, invisibility, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, mending. 1/day each: detect poison and disease, dimension door

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The chernomoi emits a piercing shriek. Each creature within 60 feet of it that can hear it takes 10 (3d6) thunder damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

cheval-de-guerre-celeste.name: Celestial Warhorse

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Mount
traits.desc: The celestial warhorse extends its necrotic damage resistance to any creature riding it. In addition, it can cast the water walk spell on itself only, and must finish a short rest before it can use this ability again. The celestial horse agrees to serve as a mount only for creatures of Lawful Good, Neutral Good, or Lawful Neutral alignment.

traits.name: Elite Mount
traits.desc: The celestial warhorse is reserved for an elite among paladins: the knights of the oath of perfection. Other characters cannot acquire this mount. A celestial warhorse cannot be bought and is obtained only through a mystical summons. Should another character ride a celestial warhorse, they cannot impose their will on it — the horse decides its own actions.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

cheval-de-guerre-celeste.languages: understands Common and Celestial but can't speak

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the ghost knight is mounted and moves at least 30 feet in a straight line toward a target it hits with a melee attack in the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

traits.name: Mounted Combatant
traits.desc: While the ghost knight is mounted, it has advantage on attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than its mount. If the mount is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, it takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.desc: The ghost knight and all darakhul and ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.desc: A ghost knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost knight makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: An eel hound can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: An eel hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Slippery Saliva
traits.desc: An eel hound can spend 2 rounds spitting saliva over an area, covering a 5-foot square with its slippery saliva. That area is treated as if it were under the effects of the grease spell for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sinuous Bite
traits.desc: A creature attacked by an eel hound can't make an opportunity attack against it until the start of the eel hound's next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

chien-du-temple.name: Temple Dog
chien-du-temple.languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The temple dog has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Guardian Initiative
traits.desc: If the temple dog enters combat against a threat clearly directed at the temple, it has advantage on its initiative roll.

traits.name: Charging Slam
traits.desc: If the temple dog moves at least 10 feet in a straight line toward its target and then hits it with a slam attack, it can make one additional slam attack against a second target within 5 feet of the first as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from the dog and knocked prone. The temple dog can immediately move into the space the target occupied before being pushed away, if it wishes.

traits.name: Calm State
traits.desc: A calm, unafraid mastodon pup uses the following statistics instead of its normal ones: Small size; 9 (6d6 − 12) hit points; speed 20 ft.; STR 8 (−1); CON 6 (−2); languages Common, Sylvan

traits.name: Poor Senses
traits.desc: The mastodon pup is nearsighted and hard of hearing. In dim light or normal light, it sees up to 30 feet and hears sounds within 60 feet.

traits.name: Runaway Emotions
traits.desc: When the mastodon pup feels threatened (if someone touches it, intimidates it, corners it, or attacks it, or if a stranger stands adjacent to it), it immediately grows from Small to Huge size as a reaction. If the pup has been attacked, the reaction occurs after the attack but before damage is applied. Nearby creatures and objects are pushed into the nearest empty space and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone. Weapons, armor, and other objects the pup wears or carries grow (and shrink) proportionally when it changes size. Overwhelmed by a wave of raw emotion, it sets about destroying everything it sees (which isn't much) and everything within reach (which is a lot). The transformation persists until the pup perceives no creature for 1 round, until it drops to 0 hit points, until it gains 5 levels of exhaustion, or until it is affected by calm emotions or similar magic. The transformation isn't entirely uncontrollable: a creature or person the pup knows and trusts can stand beside it without triggering the reaction. Under particularly unfavorable conditions, such as in a crowded area, the pup's transformation can last for days.

traits.name: Quick Step
traits.desc: When it is attacked, the mastodon pup can move 20 feet as a reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mastodon pup makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A chort's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: magic circle, blur, teleport. 3/day: scorching ray (5 rays). 1/day each: dispel magic, dominate person, flame strike, haste

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A chort makes three melee attacks with its flaming corseque or three melee attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) slashing damage, and the target's Charisma is reduced by 2 (1d4).

actions.name: Flaming Corseque
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Devil's Weapons
actions.desc: Any weapon wielded by a chort deals an extra 10 (3d6) fire damage in addition to its normal damage.

traits.name: Temporal Body
traits.desc: When a chronomentary is subjected to the slow, haste, or a similar spell or effect, it automatically succeeds on the saving throw and regains 13 (3d8) hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A chronomentary makes 1d4 + 1 slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Time Theft (1/Day)
actions.desc: The chronomentary targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the chronomentary steals some of its time and gains a +10 bonus to its position in the initiative order. In addition, the target's speed is halved, it can't take reactions, and on its turn it can take either an action or a bonus action, not both. While it is stealing time, the chronomentary's speed increases by 30 feet, and if it chooses the multiattack action, it can make one extra slam attack. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Displacement (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The chronomentary targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be magically displaced out of time. The creature then disappears for 1 minute. As an action, the displaced creature can retry its saving throw. On a success, it returns to the space it previously occupied, or to the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A cikavak's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: speak with animals. 1/day: silence

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Chew
actions.desc: When the snaptrap knocks a Medium or smaller target prone, it can immediately make three bite attacks against it and move 5 feet, all as a bonus action.

traits.name: Clurichaun's Luck
traits.desc: Clurichauns add their Dexterity and Charisma modifiers to their armor class.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A clurichaun's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). A clurichaun can cast the following spells, using alcohol as the only component: At will: friends, minor illusion, vicious mockery, purify food and drink, mending. 1/day each: calm emotions, blur, heroism, sleep, suggestion

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clurichaun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the weapon.

colonne-possedee.name: Possessed Pillar
colonne-possedee.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The pillar is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The pillar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The pillar's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Weapon Theft
traits.desc: The strange magic animating the pillar generates a magnetic field that magnetizes metal objects in contact with it, including metal weapons. When a creature hits the pillar with a metal melee weapon, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity saving throw or the weapon sticks to the pillar until the pillar releases it or is destroyed. The saving throw uses the same ability as the attack. The pillar can drop any metal weapons magnetized to it at will. It always drops them as soon as it believes it is no longer in danger. This power affects armor only during a grapple.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the pillar remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary statue or carved column.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pillar makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the Black Knight commander is mounted and moves at least 30 feet in a straight line toward a target it hits with a melee attack in the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

traits.name: Aura of Hate
traits.desc: The Black Knight commander and its allies within 10 feet of it add its Charisma modifier to their weapon damage rolls (already included in the damage below).

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The Black Knight commander's weapon attacks are made with magic weapons (+1).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Black Knight commander makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Charge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The Black Knight commander lets out a terrifying cry and makes a melee attack at the end of a charge. Whether the attack hits or not, all enemies within 15 feet of the target that are aware of the commander must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.desc: All the elements of a bone collective within 45 miles of their main body are in constant communication. If one of them becomes aware of a given danger, they are all informed of it. Any bone collective with at least 30 hit points forms a hive mind, which gives it Intelligence 14. Below that hit point threshold, it becomes mindless (Intelligence 0) and loses its innate spellcasting power. At 0 hit points, a few surviving clusters of bones scatter and spend several months forming a new collective.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A bone collective's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: chill touch. 3/day: animate dead (up to 5 skeletons or zombies)

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: A bone collective can act as a swarm (a collection made of smaller elements), or it can cede control to a single member (called an exarch) and then act as an individual creature. It must use an action to change this state. In its individual form, the collective can't occupy the same space as another creature, but it can make sneak attacks and cast spells. In its swarm form, it can occupy another creature's space (and vice versa) and can move through openings at least 1 foot wide. It can't take its individual form while it occupies the same space as another creature. In either form, it can use its skills normally.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bone collective makes two claw attacks, or one claw attack and one bite attack, or one swarm attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer the effects of blooddragon venom.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Swarm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 57 (8d12 + 5) piercing damage, or 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage if the bone collective is reduced to half its hit points or fewer. If the attack hits the target, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer the effects of blooddragon venom.

actions.name: Blooddragon Venom (Injury)
actions.desc: Bone collectives create a reddish fluid with which they coat their fangs. The terrifying red maws of the tiny skeletons are unsettling, and the toxin they contain is deadly. A creature that has been bitten must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and take a 1d6 Charisma reduction. A poisoned creature must attempt another saving throw every four hours. On each failure, it takes another 1d6 Charisma reduction, until it has succeeded on two consecutive saving throws or has survived for 24 hours. If the creature survives, the effect ends and it can heal normally. Lost Charisma can be restored with a lesser restoration spell or comparable magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The shellcap can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: 1/day each: darkness, fog cloud. 1/day (if it has its cloak): water breathing

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The shellcap regains 3 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Unobtrusive Watcher
traits.desc: The shellcap has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide and on Perception checks based on hearing.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: The shellcap is petrified after 5 (2d4) consecutive rounds of direct exposure to natural sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shellcap makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13), restrained, and poisoned (DC 13 Strength saving throw to negate; lasts for the duration of the grapple + 1 round). The shellcap can move a grappled creature up to 15 feet as a bonus action. While it grapples a creature, it can use its claw attack only against that creature.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A covetous one is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A covetous one has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shared Rage
traits.desc: A covetous one can't speak telepathically to its creator, but it feels strong emotions and can determine their cause. A creator can telepathically order a covetous one to track down and attack an individual by sending it an image of the creature along with the appropriate emotion. While so engaged, the covetous one can be more than 100 feet from its master without acting.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Attach
actions.desc: When a covetous one hits with a bite attack, it attaches to its target with its jaws, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 9). While the covetous one maintains its grip, its bite attack automatically hits its target on each of its turns.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 8). While the target is grappled, it can't speak or cast spells with verbal components.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Bone Camouflage
traits.desc: A bone crab has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while it is among bones.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.desc: A bone crab can communicate perfectly with all other bone crabs within 100 feet. If one of them spots a danger, they all spot it.

traits.name: Leap
traits.desc: Bone crabs have incredibly powerful legs and can leap 10 feet forward or backward as part of their movement. This leap counts as the Disengage action when it takes the crab away from an enemy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bone crab makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: White Ghost Shivers
actions.desc: A living creature that touches or is wounded by a creature carrying the white ghost shivers must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the end of the encounter to avoid becoming infected in turn. The first symptoms of this disease appear after 24 hours as a slight chill, which worsens after a day and is accompanied by fever and often the terrifying hallucinations that give the disease its name. As soon as it contracts the disease, the infected creature gains two levels of exhaustion that can be removed only once the disease is cured with lesser restoration, comparable magic, or rest. The infected creature makes another DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the end of each long rest. On a success, it loses one level of exhaustion. On a failure, the disease persists. If both levels of exhaustion are eliminated through successful saving throws, the victim has recovered from the disease naturally.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The glass crocodile can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Snap
traits.desc: When the glass crocodile leaps at least 10 feet toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack in the same turn, it can immediately constrict it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Transparency
traits.desc: The glass crocodile has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while it is underwater or in dim light.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The glass crocodile can long jump up to 15 feet if it takes off in water, or up to 10 feet if it takes off on land, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Muck Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: After the glass crocodile takes damage in the water, it thrashes to stir up a cloud of muck in a 10-foot radius around it. Visibility within this sphere is nil for 1 minute (10 rounds) in still water, or 5 (2d4) rounds if the current is strong. The glass crocodile can move at its speed after stirring up the muck.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The target is restrained, and the croc can't attack another creature while the grapple continues.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: If the glass crocodile is already grappling a creature, the creature takes 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. It takes half as much poison damage on a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Warren Sense
traits.desc: A cynome has advantage on Perception checks if at least one other awake cynome is within 10 feet.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: A cynome has advantage on its attack rolls when its target is in a space adjacent to at least one other cynome that is able to attack it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A cynome makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Freezing Presence
traits.desc: The frost maiden is surrounded by cold air. Her presence extinguishes small nonmagical flames and makes water freeze. A character who spends more than 10 minutes unprotected within 15 feet of her must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer from exposure to extreme cold. Spells that protect against cold damage are targeted by an automatic dispel magic.

traits.name: Icy Eyes
traits.desc: A frost maiden sees perfectly despite snow, even in a raging blizzard, and is immune to snow blindness.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: A frost maiden moves without penalty on surfaces covered with snow or ice.

traits.name: Invisibility in Snow
traits.desc: In a snowy environment, the frost maiden can turn invisible as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The frost maiden has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The frost maiden uses Charisma as her innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). She can innately cast the following spells: At will: chill touch, detect magic, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, resistance. 5/day each: endure elements (cold only), fear, fog cloud, misty step. 3/day each: alter self, protection from energy, sleet storm. 1/day: ice storm

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The frost maiden makes two ice dagger attacks.

actions.name: Ice Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind Form
actions.desc: The frost maiden transforms into a cloud of swirling snow. Her statistics are the same as an air elemental's, except she deals cold damage instead of bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Icy Entanglement
actions.desc: Snow and ice hinder the movements of her opponents as the entangle spell (DC 17).

actions.name: Kiss of the Frozen Heart
actions.desc: A frost maiden can kiss a willing individual, freezing the poor soul's heart. He falls under the effect of a dominate spell, his alignment becomes lawful evil, and he is immune to cold. The frost maiden can have up to three such thralls at a time. The effect can be broken with dispel magic (DC 17), greater restoration, or a kiss from someone who loves the target.

actions.name: Snowblind Burst
actions.desc: In a snowy environment, the frost maiden can try to blind all creatures within 30 feet of her. Those that fail a DC 17 Charisma saving throw are blinded for 1 hour. Targets immune to cold damage are immune to this effect as well.

demon-de-seve.name: Sap Demon
demon-de-seve.languages: none in its natural form; knows the same languages as the creature it dominates

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The sap demon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Season Change
traits.desc: If the sap demon (or its host) takes at least 10 fire damage, it gains the benefits of the haste spell until the end of its next turn. If it takes at least 10 cold damage, it suffers the effects of the slow spell until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sap demon makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, it is grappled (escape DC 12), and the sap demon uses its spirit sap as a bonus action.

actions.name: Spirit Sap
actions.desc: The sap demon slides into the throat of a living creature that is asleep, defenseless, or grappled, and of Medium size or smaller. Once inside, the sap demon takes control of its host, as with the dominate monster spell (DC 12 Wisdom to negate). Once dominated, the host gains blindsight in a 90-foot radius. It bleeds from the ears, nose, eyes, or from a wound resembling the one opened in the sap demon's tree (1 damage per hour). Damage the host takes has no effect on the sap demon. If the host dies or drops to 0 hit points, the demon must leave its body within the following hour.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: When it is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, the derro takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Madness
traits.desc: The derro has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shadow Strike
traits.desc: The derro's weapon attack deals 9 (2d8) necrotic damage (included in the actions list).

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: The derro is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared: 1st level (4 slots): hellish rebuke, inflict wounds, shield of faith, wrathful smite. 2nd level (2 slots): aid, crown of madness, darkness, magic weapon

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A derro shadow antipaladin has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks while exposed to sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A derro makes two scimitar attacks or two heavy crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Infectious Madness (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A derro chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be under the effect of a confusion spell for 1 minute. The affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Enchanted Cage
traits.desc: The iron cage that holds a fetalsavant grants it shelter. The cage (AC 19, 10 hp) is treated as worn equipment while it is carried by a derro, and it can't be directly targeted by an attack. In addition, the cage protects its occupant from 20 levels of spells of 4th level or lower. It grants no protection to creatures outside the cage, however. Spells of 5th level or higher function normally against the cage and its occupant. Once the cage has protected its occupant from 20 spell levels or more, it becomes nonmagical. If it is exposed to direct sunlight for a cumulative hour, it is destroyed.

traits.name: Madness
traits.desc: A derro fetalsavant's particular madness grants it immunity to psychic effects. Its sanity can be restored only by a wish spell or comparable magic. A derro fetalsavant that regains its sanity gains 4 points of Wisdom and loses 6 points of Charisma.

traits.name: Sunlight Vulnerability
traits.desc: A derro fetalsavant's Constitution score is reduced by 1 for every hour it spends exposed to sunlight. It dies if its Constitution score reaches 0. It regains its Constitution points at a rate of 1 per day for each day spent underground or otherwise protected from the sun.

actions.name: Babble
actions.desc: The sight of potential hosts excites a fetalsavant so much that it babbles and chuckles in a way that is both childish and insane, triggering a madness effect. All sane creatures that start their turn within 60 feet of a fetalsavant must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be affected by a confusion effect (as the spell) for 1d4 rounds. This is a psychic effect. Creatures that succeed on their saving throw can't be affected by that fetalsavant's babble for the next 24 hours. A fetalsavant can't use this action while it is using its soul swap power.

actions.name: Soul Swap
actions.desc: As an action, a fetalsavant can try to take control of a creature it can see within 90 feet by forcing it to swap souls, as if it were casting the magic jar spell with its own body as the receptacle. The fetalsavant can use this power at will, but it can swap souls with only one creature at a time. The victim can resist if it succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature is immune to that fetalsavant's soul swap for 24 hours. On a failure, the fetalsavant takes control of the target's body and savagely attacks the target's enemies, its eyes gleaming with a supernatural light. As an action, the fetalsavant can leave its host's body and take back possession of its own if it is within range; the victim's soul then returns to its original body. If the host's body or the fetalsavant's body drops to 0 hit points while they are within 90 feet of each other, both souls return to their original bodies, and the creature at 0 hit points is dying: it then makes death saving throws normally until it dies, is stabilized, or regains hit points. If the host's body or the fetalsavant's body is killed while they are more than 90 feet apart, their souls can't return to their respective bodies, and they both die. While its soul is imprisoned in the fetalsavant's frail body, the victim is paralyzed and incapacitated.

traits.name: Bound to the Summoner
traits.desc: When a soul devourer is summoned, it creates a mental link between its summoner and itself. If the target assigned to the soul devourer (see the Find the Target power) dies before it can drain its soul, or if the target defeats the devourer without killing it, the devourer returns to its summoner as fast as it can and attacks the summoner. As long as they are both on the same plane, the devourer can use its find the target power to locate the summoner.

traits.name: Find the Target
traits.desc: When the summoner orders the soul devourer to find a creature, it does so unerringly, regardless of the distance and obstacles separating them, as long as the creature is on the same plane as the devourer. The summoner must have seen the chosen target and must speak its name.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The soul devourer makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage, or half as much psychic damage on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.desc: If the soul devourer reduces its target to 0 hit points, it can absorb the creature's soul as a bonus action. The victim must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it dies but can be returned to life normally. On a failure, the devourer consumes its soul, preventing it from being returned to life with clone, raise dead, or reincarnate. Resurrection, true resurrection, and wish bring the target back to life provided the caster succeeds on a DC 15 spellcasting check. If the soul devourer is killed within 120 feet of its victim's corpse and the victim has been dead for one minute or less, its soul returns to its body, bringing it back to life and leaving it unconscious and stable at 0 hit points.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The automaton devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: An automaton devil's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: charm person, suggestion, teleport. 1/day each: banishing smite, cloudkill

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An automaton devil makes two melee attacks, using any combination of bite, claw, and whip attacks of its choice. It can make only one bite attack per turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained. The devil can grapple only two targets at a time, and each grappled target prevents it from using one whip to attack. A target can be grappled by only one whip at a time. A grappled target takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Punishing Maw
actions.desc: If a target is grappled by a whip at the start of the automaton devil's turn, the two creatures make opposed Strength (Athletics) checks. If the grappled creature wins, it takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage and remains grappled. If the devil wins, it drags the grappled creature to its maw-stomach, which contains a mass of moving gears, sharp teeth, and whirling blades. The creature takes 49 (4d20 + 7) slashing damage and is grappled by the devil's maw, which can then use the whip it was grappling the creature with on its next turn. While grappled by the devil's maw, the creature automatically takes another 49 (4d20 + 7) slashing damage at the start of each of the automaton devil's turns. The punishing maw can grapple only one creature at a time. The automaton devil can freely 'spit out' a creature or its corpse during its turn to make room for a new victim.

actions.name: Aura of Fear
actions.desc: The automaton devil radiates an aura of fear in a 10-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the aura's area of effect must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened. If it succeeds on the saving throw, the creature can never again be affected by that automaton devil's aura of fear.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A crystalline devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: A crystalline devil deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a target if it hits it with a weapon attack while it has advantage on the attack roll, or if the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the crystalline devil that isn't incapacitated and the devil doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: While it is in gem form, a crystalline devil is an innate spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 2/day: command. 1/day: suggestion

traits.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
traits.desc: A crystalline devil has a 25% chance of summoning another crystalline devil.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Treacherous Carbuncle
actions.desc: The crystalline devil takes the form of a gem worth 500 gp. In this form, it radiates a magic aura but it can't be destroyed. It is aware and can see and hear everything going on around it. It can resume its original form as an action.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Crystal Spray (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A crystalline devil can magically project a cloud of crystal shards in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area take 17 (7d4) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: An ink devil's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, illusory script, invisibility, teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only). 1/day each: planar ally (1d4 + 1 lemures 40%, or 1 ink devil 25%), glyph of warding

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Break Concentration
actions.desc: The shrill, babbling voices and sharp claws of ink devils make them a greater nuisance than their martial skills would suggest. As a bonus action, an ink devil can force a single enemy within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, the target loses its concentration until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Scroll Corruption
actions.desc: With a mere touch, an ink devil can corrupt the magic in any scroll. To use such a corrupted scroll correctly, a creature must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the spell contained in the scroll affects the caster if it is an offensive spell, or the nearest devil if it is a beneficial spell.

actions.name: Devil's Mark
actions.desc: An ink devil can project ink from its fingertips at a single target within 15 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or receive the devil's mark: a black, red, or purple tattoo depicting the seal of an archduke (most often Mammon or Titivilus, but sometimes Arbeyach, Asmodeus, Beelzebub, Dispater, or another). All devils have advantage on their spell attacks targeting a creature bearing a devil's mark, and that creature has disadvantage on its saving throws against spells and powers used by devils. The mark can be removed only with a remove curse spell or similar magic. Moreover, the mark detects as faintly evil and often changes location on the creature's body. Paladins, witch hunters, and some clerics may consider the mark proof that a creature has entered into a pact with a devil.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A salt devil's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: darkness. 1/day each: contagion, teleport

traits.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
traits.desc: A salt devil has a 40% chance of summoning another salt devil.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes two scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is neither undead nor a construct, it also takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. Plants, oozes, and creatures with the amphibious trait, a water body, or water breathing have disadvantage on this saving throw. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it also gains one level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Prodigality of the Liar
traits.desc: A gilded devil has influence over the recipient of a gift for as long as the creature keeps it. The creature takes a −2 penalty on its saving throws against the gilded devil's powers, as well as a further −10 penalty against the gilded devil's scrying attempts. This effect can be dispelled with a remove curse spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: A gilded devil's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A gilded devil's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect thoughts, major image, suggestion. 3/day each: dominate person, polymorph, scorching ray (4 rays), scrying. 1/day: teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A gilded devil makes two heavy flail attacks.

actions.name: Heavy Flail (Flail of Avarice)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Treachery of Treasures (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a gilded devil can momentarily turn the rings, necklaces, and other jewelry worn by a creature against it. The devil can affect all the visible jewelry worn by two creatures within 60 feet, suddenly endowing it with barbs and spikes. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to halve the damage caused by this effect. On a failure, a victim takes 13 (3d8) piercing damage plus an additional effect depending on the item's location. |Location|Effect| |:-|:-| |Arm|Melee damage dealt is halved until the end of a short rest.| |Hand|The target drops everything it is holding.| |Eyes|The target is permanently blinded.| |Head|The target has disadvantage on Intelligence checks until the end of a long rest.| |Feet|Speed is halved for 24 hours.| |Neck|The target is stunned and unable to breathe for 1 round.| |Other|No additional effect.| An item counts as jewelry if it is made of a precious material (such as silver, gold, ivory, or adamantite), decorated with gems, or both, and is worth at least 100 gp.

actions.name: Contempt for Base Metals
actions.desc: A gilded devil's attacks ignore all protection granted by nonmagical armor made of bronze, iron, steel, and similar metals. Protection granted by items made of precious metals, such as adamantite, mithral, or gold, functions normally, as do bonuses granted by nonmetallic items.

actions.name: Flail of Avarice
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a gilded devil wearing at least 1,000 gp worth of jewelry can reshape it into the form of a +2 heavy flail. A creature hit by this jewel-encrusted flail has disadvantage on all its Wisdom saving throws until its next short rest, in addition to the weapon's normal damage. The components making up the flail separate and return to their original appearance when the gilded devil dies or 1 minute after leaving its hands.

actions.name: Voracious Greed
actions.desc: As an action, a gilded devil can devour nonmagical jewelry or coins worth up to 1,000 gp. It is healed of 5 hit points for every 200 gp worth it devours this way. A gilded devil can use this power on items worn by an enemy it is grappling. The target must then succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw if it wants to prevent one of its items from being devoured.

diable-lunaire.name: Moon Devil
diable-lunaire.speed: 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (hover), walks on light 80 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A moon devil's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: fly, major image, planar binding. 3/day: greater invisibility. 1/day: wall of ice

traits.name: Light Intangibility
traits.desc: While bathed in moonlight, the devil is only half tangible and is then immune to all nonmagical attacks. Even when hit by spells or magic weapons, it takes only half the damage inflicted by a tangible source, with the exception of force damage. Holy water can affect the devil the same way it affects intangible undead.

traits.name: Walk on Light
traits.desc: Once per round, a moon devil can magically teleport itself, with its equipment, from one ray of moonlight to another within 80 feet. This repositioning consumes half its speed.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
traits.desc: The devil can attempt a magical summoning. It has a 40% chance of summoning either 2 chain devils or 1 moon devil.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes 3 attacks: one bite, one claws, and one tail. Alternatively, it can use moonbeam projection twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Moonbeam Projection
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d12) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 4 rounds.

diaspaad.name: Diaspaad

traits.name: Split
traits.desc: When a Small or larger diaspaad takes at least 25 slashing damage, it splits into two new diaspaads one size category smaller. Each new diaspaad has half the hit points of the diaspaad it split from. They have disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Their damage is reduced by 1 point and one die category per size below Large.

traits.name: Fission
traits.desc: Once per day, if it wishes, a diaspaad can generate another identical diaspaad (same size) by dividing into two parts, each of which regrows into a full creature. The process takes 1 minute, during which the diaspaad is motionless and can do nothing else.

traits.name: Adaptive Damage Resistance
traits.desc: When the diaspaad takes a type of damage, it develops resistance to that damage type for the rest of the combat. Affected damage types are: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, cold, piercing, poison, thunder, slashing. These resistances stack.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The diaspaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and took no damage it wasn't resistant to since the start of its previous turn.

traits.name: Bodily Fusion
traits.desc: Two Medium or smaller diaspaads can merge to reform a diaspaad one size category larger (Large at most). The process takes 1 minute, during which the two diaspaads are pressed together, motionless, and can do nothing else. If uninterrupted, their bodies fuse and reform the "parent" diaspaad at full hit points in 1d3 rounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The diaspaad makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Haste (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Until the end of its next turn, the diaspaad gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.

diaspaad.languages: Diaspaad, repeats words without understanding them

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: A dipsa can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Subtle Bite
traits.desc: A dipsa's bite is barely visible, and the wound is quickly anesthetized. A creature that has been bitten must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to realize it has been attacked or to notice the damage.

traits.name: Translucent
traits.desc: A dipsa can choose to take the Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the dipsa's space. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the dipsa attaches to the target. A creature with a dipsa attached takes 3 (1d6) acid damage per round per dipsa. It must also succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the damage taken. If the creature's hit point maximum reaches 0 as a result of this effect, it dies. The reduction of the creature's hit point maximum lasts until it is targeted by a lesser restoration spell or comparable magic.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: A dissimortuum can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A dissimortuum makes three claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frightening Mask
actions.desc: All non-undead creatures within 60 feet of a dissimortuum that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1d8 rounds. A target that succeeds on its saving throw, or for which the effect ends, is immune to the effect of all frightening masks for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A domovoi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility, alter self. 3/day each: haste, dimension door, darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A domovoi makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: A doppelrat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Arcane Duplication (Recharges after 10 Minutes)
actions.desc: A doppelrat that feels threatened creates clones at the start of its turn. Each round for 4 rounds, the number of living doppelrats is multiplied by four, up to a maximum of 20. For example, when a doppelrat triggers its arcane duplication power, 1 rat becomes 4. At the start of its next turn, those 4 rats become 16, then 20 (the maximum allowed) at the start of its third turn. If one of the clones is destroyed between the original doppelrat's first and second turns, the 3 surviving rats become 12, and so on. Each clone appears in the same space as its original and can either move or take an action during the round it appears. Each has 4 hit points and AC 13. All surviving clones perish 1 minute (10 rounds) after the first clones were created. If the original doppelrat dies, the clones stop duplicating, but those already created persist until the scheduled end of their existence.
