On a success, it suffers no damage and feels well enough to act normally during the day. The creature repeats this process until it dies from the Dexterity loss, recovers naturally by succeeding on its saving throws after two consecutive long rests, or is cured with lesser restoration or comparable magic. Once cured, the victim recovers 1d3 Dexterity points after each long rest; it can recover all its Dexterity points at once with greater restoration or comparable magic.

traits.name: Shadow Blend
traits.desc: In areas of dim light or darkness, an ancient shadow drake is considered invisible. Artificial light, such as a lantern, or a spell, such as light or continual flame, isn't enough to counter this trait; only true sunlight or the daylight spell is. The drake can't use its hasten and stygian breath powers while invisible. An ancient shadow drake can choose whether to use this trait at will as long as it is in an area of dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Shadow Leap (3/Day)
traits.desc: An ancient shadow drake can travel between shadows as if it were using the dimension door spell. This magical movement must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness, and those two areas can be no more than 60 feet apart.

traits.name: Haste (3/Day)
traits.desc: An ancient shadow drake can take one additional move action this turn. It can haste only once per round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes one bite attack and one tail strike.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stygian Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The ancient shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid with a maximum range of 60 feet. It explodes at the end of its path, creating a freezing cloud of black mist in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the affected area takes 42 (12d6) cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. In the affected area, the mist extinguishes nonmagical lights and dispels magical light sources of 1st level or lower.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes one bite attack, two claw attacks, and one sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 4 rounds. While poisoned, the target repeats the saving throw at the start of its turn. On a success, it ends this condition. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. If animate dead is cast on creatures killed by this poison, the spellcaster doesn't need to use material components.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A deep drake spits crackling energy in an 80-foot line that makes its victims writhe in pain. This attack deals 35 (10d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Targets that fail this saving throw must also succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The drake's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: friends, vicious mockery. 5/day each: calm emotions, hideous laughter, dissonant whispers, ray of sickness. 3/day each: confusion, invisibility

traits.name: Bewildering Spellcasting
traits.desc: When a creature fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw against a spell cast by a tavern drake, the creature immediately forgets who cast the spell at it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A tavern drake can belch a cloud of intoxicating gas in a 15-foot cone. A creature caught in this cloud is poisoned for 1 minute and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1d6 rounds.

actions.name: Bewildering Touch
actions.desc: A tavern drake can make a touch attack that grants its target a +3 bonus on its Dexterity-based skill checks and melee attacks, but also confuses it, as if it were under the effect of the confusion spell. This effect lasts 1d4 rounds. If the target succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, it negates this effect.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The purple drake makes one bite attack and one sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more, the target takes 2 (1d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns for 3 rounds. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, trying to end the effect early.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The drake exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each target in the cone takes 18 (4d8) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

drake-stellaire.name: Star Drake
drake-stellaire.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Dwarvish, Primordial

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the star drake fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The drake's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Starlit Nimbus
traits.desc: The drake is surrounded by a swirling nimbus of tiny stellar lights. A sighted creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the drake must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw to avoid being incapacitated. At the start of its turn, a character can choose to avert its gaze, becoming immune to this effect until the start of its next turn. However, while averting its gaze, it must treat the drake as if it were invisible.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A drake's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 20). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: faerie fire, moonbeam. 3/day: plane shift. 1/day each: planar binding, gate

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The drake exhales fire or freezing air in a 40-foot cone. Each creature in the cone takes 78 (12d12) fire or cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Blazing Star (1/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 65 (10d12) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be permanently blinded.

legendaryActions.name: Bite Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The drake makes one bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Nova (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The drake temporarily doubles the radius and intensity of its starlit nimbus. All sighted creatures within 20 feet of the drake must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn. Characters averting their gaze are immune to the nova.

legendaryActions.name: Pale Sparks
legendaryActions.desc: The drake casts faerie fire or moonbeam.

traits.name: Dissolving Gaze
traits.desc: When a creature that can see the drakon's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the drakon, and the drakon isn't incapacitated and can also see the creature, the drakon can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 3 (1d6) acid damage, its hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount (until it finishes a long rest), and it is paralyzed until the start of the drakon's next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid making this saving throw. If the creature chooses this option, it can't see the drakon until the start of its next turn, at which point it must choose again whether to avert its gaze. If the creature looks toward the drakon before the start of its next turn, it must immediately make the saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drakon makes one bite attack and one tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (4d4) acid damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The drakon exhales acidic vapors in a 15-foot cone. All creatures in the affected area take 28 (8d6) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dref has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Bound Spirit
traits.desc: The dref is bound to a place, a house, an establishment (most often an inn). As long as the place isn't destroyed or consecrated to another purpose, the dref cannot be destroyed. If reduced to 0 hit points, it simply vanishes with a shrill cry (or perhaps a dissonant musical note) and a characteristic foul odor. It reappears 1d4 hours later, as if nothing had happened.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: druidcraft, dancing lights. 3/day each: charm person, entangle, invisibility, magic missile. 1/day each: counterspell, dispel magic, shillelagh, wall of thorns, fog cloud, barkskin, suggestion

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on her turn, the dryad can spend 10 feet of movement to enter a dead tree within reach and emerge from another dead tree within 60 feet of the first. She appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or larger.

traits.name: Tree Dependency
traits.desc: The dryad has a mystical bond with her vines, and she must remain within 1,000 feet of them at all times, or she is poisoned. If she remains out of range of her vines for 24 hours, she takes a 1d6 Constitution reduction, plus an additional 1d6 per following day, until this separation kills the dryad. A dryad can bond with a new vine at the end of a 24-hour ritual.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Swan Song
traits.desc: When an eala is reduced to 0 hit points, it can use its final breath to sing a beautiful, plaintive song. Creatures within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 round. An incapacitated creature has its speed reduced to 0.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An eala makes two slashing flight-feather attacks.

actions.name: Slashing Flight Feathers
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The eala exhales fire in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the affected area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failure and half as much on a success. An eala's fire breath ignites flammable objects and melts malleable metals in its area of effect that aren't being worn or carried.

traits.name: Reconstitution
traits.desc: If destroyed, an edimmu rises from the dead again after 2d4 days. To destroy it permanently, its mortal remains must be appropriately buried on consecrated or sanctified ground. Edimmus rarely stray more than 1 mile from the place of their death.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: An edimmu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Dehydrator
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. In addition, it is stunned for 1 minute and gains one level of exhaustion. A stunned creature repeats its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The hit point maximum reduction persists until the creature finishes a long rest and drinks a large amount of water, or benefits from a greater restoration spell or comparable magic. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

traits.name: Asgardian Battleaxes
traits.desc: These axes were forged in Valhalla, and runic magic keeps their edges forever sharp. They have a +2 enchantment and an extra damage die. Their magic must be renewed each week by a valkyrie or Odin himself.

traits.name: Warrior
traits.desc: Einherjar love to fight, and they never turn their backs on a duel or avoid a fight, even one that is lost in advance. After all, Valhalla awaits them.

traits.name: Battle Fury
traits.desc: Once an einherjar has been reduced to 30 hit points or fewer, it has advantage on all its attacks.

traits.name: Fearsome Gaze
traits.desc: An einherjar's gaze is particularly piercing and intimidating. As a result, an einherjar has advantage on Intimidation checks.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: An einherjar's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: bless, spare the dying. 1/day each: death ward, spirit guardians

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An einherjar makes three attacks with its Asgardian battleaxe, or one with its handaxe.

actions.name: Asgardian Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage with one hand, or 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage with two hands.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Supernatural Grace
traits.desc: An eleinomae's Charisma modifier is added to her armor class (included in the statistics).

traits.name: Reed Walk
traits.desc: An eleinomae can move across brush or rivers without needing to make an ability check. In addition, such difficult terrain costs her no extra movement.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: An eleinomae's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: dancing lights. 3/day each: charm person, suggestion. 2/day each: hallucinatory terrain, major image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eleinomae makes three attacks with her dagger and one attack with her flowering reed net.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Flowering Reed Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: the target has disadvantage on its Wisdom saving throws for 1 minute and is restrained. A creature can free itself or another creature from this restraint as an action if it succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check or deals 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: A tree gripper can climb difficult surfaces, including moving upside down along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Arboreal Brachiation
traits.desc: A tree gripper doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it climbs out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A tree gripper makes one bite attack and two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). While grappled this way, the creature is restrained, and the tentacle can't be used to attack a different target. A tree gripper has two tentacles, and each can grapple one target. The tree gripper can move at full speed while dragging behind it a Medium or smaller creature it has grappled.

traits.name: Fey Blood
traits.desc: Heath children are considered both plants and fey for any effect that would target one of those types.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A heath child makes two attacks with its claws. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is grappled (escape DC 13), and the heath child uses its thorny grapple against it.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Thorn-Spit Tongue (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. All heath children can spit thorns from their mouths.

actions.name: Entangle
actions.desc: Two heath children working together can cast a variant of the entangle spell, requiring no components and usable at will. The two creatures must be no more than 10 feet apart, and both must use their action to cast the spell. At least one of the spellcasters must be in the entangle spell's area of effect, but the area isn't necessarily centered on it. Creatures in the area of effect must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained. All heath children are immune to the effects of this spell.

actions.name: Thorny Grapple
actions.desc: A heath child's long thorny limbs let it grapple Medium or smaller creatures. A grappled creature takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage at the end of the heath child's turn for as long as it is grappled.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: An erina has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Vigorous
traits.desc: An erina has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Needles
traits.desc: An enemy that hits an erina with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Protection
traits.desc: The erina defender imposes disadvantage on an attack roll made against an ally within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The erina defender makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: An erina has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Vigorous
traits.desc: An erina has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Needles
traits.desc: An enemy that hits an erina with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Fungal Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the rotmind must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be infected by its spores.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rotmind slave makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The rotmind blows a cloud of acidic spores out of its rotting lungs in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in this line take 36 (8d8) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. If the creature fails this save, it is infected by rotmind spores.

actions.name: Rotmind Spores
actions.desc: The infection occurs after inhaling or ingesting the spores. An infected creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of each long rest. On a success, nothing happens, but on a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage and has its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount. The infection ends if the character succeeds on its saving throws after two consecutive long rests, or benefits from lesser restoration or similar magic. A creature that succumbs to the disease transforms into a rotmind slave after 24 hours, unless its corpse is destroyed.

traits.name: Hidden by Firelight
traits.desc: When it is in an area lit only by nonmagical flames, a fire spirit gains a +2 bonus on its Stealth checks. This bonus becomes +4 when it hides in a fire.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: A fire spirit sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius.

traits.name: Magic Light Sensitivity
traits.desc: While lit by magical light, a fire spirit has disadvantage on its attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Water Sensitivity
traits.desc: Each time a fire spirit moves 5 feet through water, or 1 gallon of water is dumped on it, it takes 3 cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fire spirit makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Burning Touch (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: When it makes a slam attack, a fire spirit has a chance to set a target on fire. The target must immediately succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or catch fire and take an extra 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of its next turn. Until someone uses an action to extinguish the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The verdant spirit has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in terrain where vegetation is abundant.

traits.name: Verdancy
traits.desc: Difficult terrain composed of magical or nonmagical plants and undergrowth costs the verdant spirit no extra movement. In addition, the verdant spirit can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage if they have thorns or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Thorn Attack
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, range 20 ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d8 + proficiency bonus piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The spark uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: shocking grasp. 3/day: lightning bolt. 1/day: call lightning

actions.name: Inhabit
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw, or the spark dominates it, as with the dominate person spell. The spark instantly enters the target's space and merges with its physical form. While it inhabits a creature, it takes no damage from physical attacks. The target creature gains a +4 bonus to Dexterity and Charisma while inhabited. Creatures with passive Perception 14 or higher find the host's words and deeds jerky and erratic. Each time the spark uses its innate spellcasting, its host is entitled to a new DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a success, it expels the spark, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. Once installed, the spark slowly burns its host's nervous system; the host must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw every 24 hours. On each failure, it takes 2d6 lightning damage and has its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount. If this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0, it dies. The reduction persists until the host finishes a long rest after the spark's expulsion.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: The scorpion fanatic has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scorpion fanatic makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The muckdweller can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.desc: The muckdweller has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy areas.

traits.name: Fierce Movement
traits.desc: If the muckdweller surprises a creature, it gains a bonus action to use on the first round of combat to make a claw, bite, or swamp spit attack.

traits.name: Muddy Escape (1/Day)
traits.desc: If an attack would reduce the muckdweller to 0 hit points, it instead drops to 1 hit point and spreads itself into a pool of muddy water. In this form, it can move at its normal speed and pass through spaces occupied by other creatures. At the start of its next turn, it can reform, still at 1 hit point, as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The muckdweller makes two attacks, one of which must be with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Swamp Spit (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The muckdweller spits a toxic mix of swamp muck and bile at a target within 20 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A far darrig's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: Constant: magic weapon (antler cutlass only), speak with animals. At will: calm emotions, charm animal (as charm person, but affects only beasts), cure wounds, detect poison and disease, water breathing, water walk. 3/day each: barkskin, conjure woodland beings, hold animal (as hold person, but affects only beasts), jump, longstrider. 1/day each: commune with nature, freedom of movement, nondetection, tree stride

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The far darrig makes four antler cutlass attacks.

actions.name: Antler Cutlass
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be either disarmed or knocked prone. The attacking far darrig chooses the effect at will.

actions.name: Enchanted Cutlass Maneuvers
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a far darrig can magically enlarge or shrink its antler cutlass to give it a reach of 5 feet or 10 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: A shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A shadow fey's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 1/day: misty step (only in an area of shadow, dim light, or darkness)

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity

actions.name: Seductive Whispers (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The shadow fey enchantress addresses a few sweet words to a creature she can see within 60 feet that can hear her. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws it makes to resist the enchantress's spells.

actions.name: Commander (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The enchantress can call out a special order or warning to a creature she can see within 30 feet. The creature must not be hostile to her and must be able to hear her (other creatures can't hear this injunction). For 1 minute, the creature adds a d4 to all its attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from the commander trait of only one enchantress at a time. This effect ends if the enchantress is incapacitated.

traits.name: Traveler in Darkness

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Spirit Expulsion
traits.desc: Although a fellforged's body was designed to be bound to a spirit, the wraith occupying it remains vulnerable to turning attempts. If a turning attempt succeeds, the wraith is ejected from its mechanical body. The ejected wraith keeps its current hit points and fights normally. The construct dies if it isn't animated by a spirit.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A fellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks when directly exposed to sunlight.

traits.name: Unnatural Aura
traits.desc: All animals, whether wild or domesticated, can sense the unnatural presence of a fellforged within 30 feet. They don't willingly approach it, and they panic if forced to do so. They continue to panic while within that radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fellforged makes two necrotic slam attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the amount of damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Violent Escape
actions.desc: Fellforged wraiths don't respect the mechanical bodies that house them. Thus, they don't hesitate to apply such stress to their mechanisms that the flywheels destabilize, the gears break, and the springs snap. As a bonus action, a violent burst of gears and cogs deals 7 (2d6) piercing damage to all enemies within 5 feet that fail a DC 14 Dexterity save. Each time a fellforged uses this power, it takes a cumulative 5-foot speed reduction. If its speed is reduced to 0 feet, the fellforged is paralyzed.

traits.name: Powerful Strike
traits.desc: When the ferocian attacks without moving during its turn, its claw attack has advantage.

traits.name: Spikes
traits.desc: A creature takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns while grappling the ferocian.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ferocian makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (5d12 + 6) slashing damage.

fext.name: Fext
fext.languages: the languages spoken by its patron

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A fext's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: hex. 3/day each: counterspell, fear, gaseous form. 1/day each: hold monster, true seeing

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The fext's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Patron's Blessing
traits.desc: A fext receives a portion of its patron's power. It has an armor class equal to 10 + its Charisma modifier + its Dexterity modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fext makes two attacks, melee or ranged.

actions.name: Occult Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.

actions.name: Occult Fury
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60/200 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage.

fils-de-fenris.name: Son of Fenris
fils-de-fenris.speed: 60 ft., burrow 15 ft. (30 ft. in ice or snow)
fils-de-fenris.languages: Common, Celestial, Draconic, Elvish, Dwarvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The son of Fenris has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The son of Fenris's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: The son of Fenris is a 15th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast spells without material components. It has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): guidance, light, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy. 1st level (4 slots): bane, command, hunter's mark, sanctuary. 2nd level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, hold person, silence. 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, bestow curse, dispel magic. 4th level (3 slots): banishment, death ward, locate creature. 5th level (2 slots): contagion, scrying. 6th level (1 slot): blight. 7th level (1 slot): plane shift. 8th level (1 slot): earthquake

traits.name: Crushing Charge
traits.desc: If the son of Fenris moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature and hits it with a slam attack in the same turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If knocked prone, the son of Fenris can make one additional slam attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The son of Fenris makes one bite attack and one slam attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). If the target was already grappled, it is swallowed instead. Once swallowed, it is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the son of Fenris, and takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the son of Fenris's turns. The son of Fenris can swallow only one creature at a time. If the swallowed creature deals 45 damage or more to it in a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of it. If the son of Fenris dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can climb out of the body by spending 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The son of Fenris breathes acid in a line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Creatures in that line take 45 (10d8) acid damage, or only half as much on a successful DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Distorting Gaze
traits.desc: Those who meet a fearforge's gaze feel the world warp and the ground tilt beneath their feet. When a creature that can see the fearforge's eye starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented. While disoriented, the creature falls prone each time it tries to move or takes the Dash or Disengage action. To recover from this state, the creature must start its turn outside the gaze's area of effect and succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. To use this power, the fearforge mustn't be incapacitated and must be able to see the creature it targets. A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid being affected. In that case, it doesn't need to make a saving throw, but until the start of its next turn, it must treat the fearforge as invisible. If the creature decides to look at the fearforge during its turn, it must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Hidden Eye
traits.desc: The fearforge has advantage on saving throws against being blinded.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A fearforge's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components: At will: detect thoughts, fear. 2/day each: charm person, command, confusion

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A fearforge has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fearforge makes three claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is disoriented by the distorting gaze, this attack deals an extra 13 (3d8) psychic damage to it, and the fearforge is healed an equal amount of hit points.

actions.name: Stupefying Gaze
actions.desc: With a glance, a fearforge can terrify a creature within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round and take an extra 13 (3d8) psychic damage. The fearforge is healed an equal amount of hit points.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: A giant ant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A giant ant makes one bite attack and one sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the giant ant can't bite a different target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Frost Walker
traits.desc: Rocky, snowy, or icy terrain doesn't affect a fraughashar's speed. It never needs to make a Dexterity check to move or to avoid falling prone when the ground is covered with snow or ice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fraughashar makes one bite attack and one dagger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gardien-spectral.name: Spectral Guardian
gardien-spectral.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The spectral guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Tomb Bound
traits.desc: The spectral guardian is bound to the area it protects. It can't move more than 100 feet from the place it must guard.

traits.name: Withering Miasma
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the spectral guardian's space must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and have its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount. This reduction persists until the creature finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: The arcanist guardian is a 9th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells, which don't require material components: Cantrips (at will): acid splash, chill touch, dancing lights, minor illusion, ray of frost. Level 1 (4 slots): mage armor, ray of sickness. Level 2 (3 slots): darkness, scorching ray. Level 3 (3 slots): fear, slow, stinking cloud. Level 4 (3 slots): blight, ice storm. Level 5 (1 slot): cone of cold

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spectral guardian makes two spectral rend attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened and have its speed reduced to 0. Both effects persist until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Sandy Camouflage
traits.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sandy areas.

traits.name: Wasteland Stride
traits.desc: The giant ignores difficult terrain related to sand, gravel, or rocks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two two-handed scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Two-Handed Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (6d4 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Immortality
traits.desc: Jotnar are immune to the effects of aging and to effects that reduce ability scores and hit point maximums.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A jotun giant uses Wisdom as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: earthquake, shapechange, speak with animals. 3/day: bestow curse, gust of wind. 1/day: divination

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The giant's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Too Big to Notice
traits.desc: Creatures near a jotun often mistake it for a landscape feature because of its size. It therefore has advantage on Stealth checks while it doesn't move.

traits.name: Rock Catching
traits.desc: If someone throws a rock or similar object at a giant, the giant can catch it without taking the rock's bludgeoning damage if it succeeds on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two club attacks and one Frightful Presence attack, or one rock throw.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 55 (10d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, range 90/240 ft., one target. Hit: 49 (6d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the giant's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a success, it is immune to the giant's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.desc: The jotun makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Planar Return
legendaryActions.desc: If the jotun giant is banished, it can return to the plane from which it was driven out twice per day. If it is banished a third time, it doesn't come back.

legendaryActions.name: Sweep
legendaryActions.desc: The jotun can sweep an arc with its club, covering a semicircular area 30 feet wide around it. All targets in the area that fail a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw take 46 (8d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage; those that succeed dodge the damage entirely.

traits.name: Immense
traits.desc: An obese giant can't take the Dash action. Attacks that push, trip, or grapple have disadvantage against the obese giant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two slam attacks. If both hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the obese giant uses its pinning squat against the target as a bonus action.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pinning Squat
actions.desc: The obese giant sits down on its target, pinning it to the ground, where it is grappled and restrained (escape DC 17). The giant can attack another target, but it releases the restrained creatures if it leaves its current space. As long as it doesn't move, it can maintain the pinning squat on up to two Medium or smaller creatures. A creature takes 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage each time it starts its turn restrained by the pinning squat.

traits.name: Cast-Iron Stomach
traits.desc: The giant can devour half its weight in food with no ill effect. It has advantage on saves against anything that would give it the poisoned condition. Poisoned or spoiled food is often found in a thursir's lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Runic Blood (3/Day)
actions.desc: A thursir giant can draw the thurs rune on a weapon. A creature hit by such a weapon takes an extra 1d8 lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The thurs rune lasts one hour or three strikes, whichever comes first.

traits.name: Hatred of Air
traits.desc: The al-Aeshma has advantage on attack rolls against an airborne target.

traits.name: Bound
traits.desc: The al-Aeshma must always be anchored to the earth. Even in gaseous form or sandstorm form, it must always touch the ground. When it flies, it can't rise higher than 50 feet. If it isn't touching the ground, it loses all immunities and becomes vulnerable to lightning and thunder.

traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.desc: When an al-Aeshma dies, its body disintegrates into a cloud of coarse sand, leaving behind the equipment it wore or carried.

traits.name: Foul Wind
traits.desc: While the al-Aeshma is in gaseous form, it can fill its space with a stifling stench. When it passes through another creature's space in gaseous form, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn. The foul wind persists until the al-Aeshma abandons its gaseous form or chooses to end this power as a bonus action.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The al-Aeshma uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect good and evil, detect magic, thunderwave. 3/day each: putrefy food and water (as create food and water, but it makes the water and food inedible), tongues, wind walk. 1/day each: creation, gaseous form, insect plague, invisibility, major image

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The al-Aeshma regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes radiant or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The al-Aeshma dies only if it starts a turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The al-Aeshma makes three scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dust Devil
actions.desc: A cylinder of sand 5 feet in radius and 30 feet tall magically forms at a point the al-Aeshma can see within 120 feet of it. The dust devil persists as long as the al-Aeshma concentrates on it (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature (other than the al-Aeshma) that enters the dust devil must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The dust devil can restrain an unlimited number of creatures. A restrained creature takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of its turn. The al-Aeshma can move the dust devil up to 60 feet as an action, with restrained creatures moving along with it. The dust devil dissipates if the al-Aeshma loses sight of it. A creature can free a creature restrained by the dust devil (including itself) by using an action and succeeding on a DC 18 Strength saving throw. If the save succeeds, the freed creature moves to the nearest space outside the dust devil.

traits.name: Bred as a Mount
traits.desc: A water strider suffers no movement penalty or speed reduction when encumbered or carrying a single rider.

traits.name: Buoyant
traits.desc: A water strider can run across the surface of water, but not on land, and it can't climb. It treats turbulent water as normal, not difficult, terrain. A water strider takes 1 point of damage per hour spent on dry land.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The water strider makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Harassment
traits.desc: If the gnoll attacks two creatures in the same turn, the first one has disadvantage on its attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Lightning Dash
traits.desc: The gnoll can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The gnoll has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the gnoll's allies that isn't incapacitated is within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gnoll makes one bite attack and two battleaxe attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.desc: Once per turn, if the white goblin attacks a creature that has already been attacked by another white goblin this round, it gains either advantage on the attack roll or a +1d6 damage bonus (of the same type as the weapon used).

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The white goblin can take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Mountaineer's Footing
traits.desc: When moving across ice or in mountainous terrain, the white goblin's speed isn't halved.

traits.name: Eye Protection
traits.desc: The white goblin is immune to snow blindness and sees normally in glacial and mountain environments.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The white goblin makes two melee attacks: one with its handaxe and one with its dagger.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The white goblin can take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Mountaineer's Footing
traits.desc: When moving across ice or in mountainous terrain, the white goblin's speed isn't halved.

traits.name: Eye Protection
traits.desc: The white goblin is immune to snow blindness and sees normally in glacial and mountain environments.

traits.name: Deadly Favor
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the shaman can expend a spell slot to make its melee weapon attacks magically deal an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage to a target they hit. This effect lasts until the end of the turn. If the shaman expends a 2nd-level spell slot, the damage increases by 1d6.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shaman is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): poison spray, chill touch, eldritch blast
1st level (4 slots): bane, cloak of frost

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The white goblin shaman makes two attacks with its club.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shaman is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): eldritch blast, resistance, thaumaturgy
1st level (3 slots): command, thunderwave, cure wounds

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Depraved
traits.desc: When a dust goblin attacks a creature while hidden, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

golem-a-vapeur.name: Steam Golem
golem-a-vapeur.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Boiler Weakness
traits.desc: If the steam golem is immersed in water, or if at least 20 gallons of water are dumped on its boiler (by a water elemental, for example), it can seize up as the steam pressure drops. If a water elemental soaks the golem, the elemental is destroyed, and the golem must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the water evaporates and the golem continues to function normally; on a failure, its flame goes out and its boiler loses pressure. The golem then acts as if under the effect of the slow spell for 1d3 rounds and is then paralyzed until its fire is relit and it has spent 15 minutes building up pressure.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Extendable Axe
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the steam golem can lengthen one of its arms into an elongated axe or shorten it back.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Whistle
traits.desc: When an opponent within 30 feet of the golem tries to cast a spell, the golem can blow a blast from its twin steam whistles. The spellcaster must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it casts the spell normally; otherwise, it fails to do so. The spell slot isn't expended, but the caster has lost its action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The steam golem makes two axe-arm attacks or one elongated axe attack.

actions.name: Axe-Arm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Elongated Axe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (5d12 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Steam Cloud (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A steam golem can release a cloud of steam that affects a 5-foot radius around it or an adjacent 20-foot cube. Creatures in the affected area take 38 (7d10) fire damage, or only half on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

golem-de-sel.name: Salt Golem
golem-de-sel.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Blinding Salt Cloud
traits.desc: Each time the golem is hit in combat, thousands of tiny salt crystals burst from its body. All creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1d3 rounds.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

golem-smaragdin.name: Emerald Golem
golem-smaragdin.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Absorb Magic
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the golem targets a creature, object, or magical effect within 10 feet and chooses one active spell on the target. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the golem absorbs it and it ends; if it is 4th level or higher, the golem must make a check with a +9 modifier. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. If the golem succeeds, it absorbs the spell, which ends. Its body glows when it absorbs magic this way, as if under the effect of the light spell. An emerald golem can contain only one spell absorbed this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Release Spell
actions.desc: The golem can release an absorbed spell effect, which explodes in a sphere of emerald energy centered on the golem with a radius of 10 feet per level of the absorbed spell. Outside the golem, all creatures in the area of effect take 7 (2d6) lightning damage per level of the absorbed spell, or only half on a successful DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also blinded until the end of the golem's next turn.

golem-tresor.name: Treasure Golem
golem-tresor.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Awestruck
traits.desc: Creatures within 120 feet of a motionless treasure golem have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, as the sheer joy of discovering a vast hoard of riches is enough to distract a creature, which then neglects its surroundings.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (6d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Thieving Whirlwind (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The golem transforms into a 20-foot-radius whirlwind composed of the treasures that make up its mass. In this form, it is immune to slashing and piercing damage. It can then enter another creature's space and stop there. Any creature in the space the whirlwind occupies must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 40 (6d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the whirlwind carries off the most valuable item the target is wearing, including a held item, but not armor. If the creature succeeds on its save, it takes only half the bludgeoning damage and keeps all its possessions. The golem can remain in whirlwind form for 3 rounds. It can resume its normal form as a bonus action on its turn.

traits.name: Master of Disguise
traits.desc: A darakhul wearing a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to pass as a living creature. When the darakhul uses this power, it loses its stench.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Each creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the darakhul must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A successful saving throw makes a creature immune to the darakhul's stench for 24 hours. A darakhul using this power can't benefit from Master of Disguise.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: The darakhul has disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks and on attack rolls as long as it or the object it is trying to see or attack is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.desc: The darakhul and all ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The darakhul makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one war pick attack. If it uses a shield, it is limited to one claw or war pick attack, but not both.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than undead, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a humanoid is paralyzed for 2 rounds or more (failing at least 2 saving throws, consecutive or not), it contracts darakhul fever.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.desc: The iron ghoul and all ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The iron ghoul makes one bite attack and one claw attack, or three cutlass attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on another DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on another DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bone Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the emperor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: The emperor is a 17th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells: Cantrips (at will): blade ward, chill touch, message, prestidigitation, shocking grasp, true strike. Level 1 (4 slots): magic missile, shield. Level 2 (3 slots): mirror image, phantasmal force. Level 3 (3 slots): fear, fireball. Level 4 (3 slots): blight, dimension door. Level 5 (2 slots): cloudkill, hold monster. Level 6 (1 slot): circle of death. Level 7 (1 slot): finger of death, teleport. Level 8 (1 slot): power word stun. Level 9 (1 slot): power word kill

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: The emperor has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks while directly exposed to sunlight.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The emperor has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.desc: When the emperor takes damage from a creature it can see within 60 feet of it, the attacker takes necrotic damage equal to half the damage it deals to the emperor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The emperor makes one bite attack and two claw attacks. It can make a scepter attack in place of a claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. A creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The emperor makes one claw or bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: The emperor casts a cantrip.

legendaryActions.name: Power Source (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Roll 1d8. The emperor regains a spell slot of that level or lower.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.desc: The imperial ghoul and all ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The imperial ghoul makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage.
