It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The beggar ghoul has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ghoul's allies that isn't incapacitated is within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Ferocious Appetite
traits.desc: If a beggar ghoul hits with its bite attack a creature that hasn't yet acted in the combat, the attack is a critical hit.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The bonepowder ghoul can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Coalescence
traits.desc: When a bonepowder ghoul drains the life force of its victims with its tomb dust ability, it can use that energy to don and maintain a more solid form. This new form is Small and semitransparent, but it has the outlines of an ordinary ghoul. The bonepowder ghoul is then no longer amorphous and can't form a whirlwind, but it can speak normally and manipulate objects. It maintains its altered form for 1 minute per point of necrotic damage dealt to living opponents.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.desc: The bonepowder ghoul and all ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The bonepowder ghoul uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: chill touch, darkness, dispel magic, ray of enfeeblement. 3/day: blindness/deafness, circle of death (7th level; 10d6). 1/day: finger of death

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) damage plus 1d4 Strength damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1d4 + 1 rounds. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on another DC 19 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Tomb Dust
actions.desc: A bonepowder ghoul can project tomb dust in a 40-foot cone. All targets in the area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Those that fail take 4d8 necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A bonepowder ghoul can generate a whirlwind of bones and teeth. All creatures in a 20-foot cube take 66 (12d10) slashing damage and lose 1d6 Strength. Those that succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw take half damage and suffer no Strength loss. The whirlwind dissipates after 1 round.

traits.name: Master Rider
traits.desc: While the Master of the Hunt is mounted, any attack that targets his mount is redirected against him. The Master of the Hunt's steed uses its rider's saving throws. If the mount succeeds on a saving throw against an effect that might deal it damage, it takes no damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The Master of the Hunt's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: druidcraft, hunter's mark, phantom steed. 3/day each: commune with nature, hail of missiles. 1/day: conjure fey (the summoned creatures disappear if something breaks the Master of the Hunt's concentration)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Master of the Hunt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The Master of the Hunt's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Parry
traits.desc: The Master of the Hunt adds 6 to his AC against one attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Master of the Hunt makes three melee attacks or three ranged attacks.

actions.name: Hunter's Lance
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, or 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. As a bonus action, the Master of the Hunt can summon his lance to his hand, even if the weapon was destroyed.

actions.name: Howling Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

legendaryActions.name: Strike
legendaryActions.desc: The Master of the Hunt makes one attack with his hunter's lance or his howling longbow.

legendaryActions.name: Relentless Advance
legendaryActions.desc: The Master of the Hunt moves up to half his speed, or half his steed's speed if he is mounted.

legendaryActions.name: Call of the Hunt (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Master of the Hunt blows his hunting horn and chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet. If the creature can hear the horn, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw against his magic or be charmed by the Master of the Hunt for 8 hours. A charmed creature joins the Great Hunt, follows the Master of the Hunt's verbal instructions, and treats its former allies as enemies. If a charmed creature wounds one of its former allies, or is wounded by one, it repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success. If a creature succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the Call of the Hunt for 24 hours.

traits.name: Contagious Lightning
traits.desc: A creature that touches an azza gremlin or hits it with a melee attack using a metal weapon receives a lightning discharge. The creature must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or attract lightning for 1 minute. During this time, attacks that deal lightning damage have advantage against that creature, it has disadvantage on all its saving throws against lightning damage and lightning effects, and each time it takes lightning damage, it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A creature under this effect must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it ends the effect.

traits.name: Ride the Lightning
traits.desc: An azza gremlin can travel instantaneously along any lightning bolt. When it is within 5 feet of a lightning effect, the gremlin can teleport to any unoccupied space within the area affected by the lightning effect, or within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Electric Shock
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d6) lightning damage, and the target is affected by Contagious Lightning.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The gremlin uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: prestidigitation. 3/day: hex

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The gremlin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A cold gremlin makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Aura of Drunkenness
actions.desc: A cold gremlin gives off an aura of drunkenness in a 20-foot radius. Each creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against poison or be poisoned for 1 hour. A creature that has drunk alcohol within the past hour has disadvantage on the saving throw. While poisoned by this effect, a creature falls prone if it tries to move more than half its speed in a turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The sand hag uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility. 2/day each: hallucinatory terrain, major image

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The sand hag can mimic animal sounds and human voices. A creature that hears them can tell they are imitations only if it succeeds on a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Scorpion Walk
traits.desc: The sand hag walks lightly on sand. It never sinks into it and never leaves tracks. It ignores difficult terrain related to sand. On this surface, it leaves no tracks and gains tremorsense out to 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand hag makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Scouring Sirocco (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The hag generates a blast of burning wind in a 30-foot line or a 15-foot cone. Creatures caught in it take 14 (4d6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and are blinded for 1 minute. A successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw halves the damage and negates the blindness. A blinded target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. In the affected area (line or cone), visibility is nil until the end of the hag's next turn.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The hag polymorphs into a Small or Medium female humanoid, or resumes her normal form. Her statistics are the same in either form. Any equipment she wears or carries isn't transformed. She reverts to her normal form if she dies.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The hag uses Charisma as her innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: disguise self, inflict wounds (4d10), message, ray of enfeeblement. 1/day each: detect thoughts, dispel magic, lightning bolt, locate creature, shillelagh, stinking cloud, teleport

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Disconcerting Ugliness
traits.desc: When a creature faces a mirror hag, whatever the distance separating them, it must make a choice at the start of each of its turns: either avert its gaze and have disadvantage on attack rolls against the hag until the start of its next turn, or look at her and make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mirror hag can use its Refiguring Curse and make one melee attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 39 (8d8 + 3) piercing damage against a stunned target.

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Refiguring Curse
actions.desc: The mirror hag curses a living creature within 60 feet and gives it hideous or bestial features. The victim must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Charisma damage. On a success, it is immune to that hag's curse for 24 hours.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc: This hag is an 8th-level spellcaster. She uses Wisdom as her spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She doesn't require material components to cast her spells. She has the following druid spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): friendship with animals (a cantrip for a red hag), poison spray, thorn whip. Level 1 (4 slots): cure wounds, entangle, speak with animals. Level 2 (3 slots): barkskin, flame blade, lesser restoration. Level 3 (3 slots): call lightning, conjure animals, dispel magic, meld into stone. Level 4 (2 slots): control water, dominate beast, freedom of movement, hallucinatory terrain

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Blood Sense

actions.desc: The red hag emits a 30-foot-radius aura for 3 rounds, which draws all fluids out of a creature through the mouth, nose, eyes, ears, and pores. All creatures that start their turn in the affected area, chosen by the hag, take 18 (4d6 + 4) necrotic damage, or half as much for those that succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.desc: A blood hag automatically perceives the blood of living creatures within 90 feet and pinpoints their exact location within 30 feet.

She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: disguise self, knock, minor illusion, misty step, pass without trace, protection from evil and good, tongues, water breathing. 3/day each: bestow curse, invisibility, mirror image. 1/day each: cloudkill, modify memory

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blood hag makes two claw attacks and one blood-drinking hair attack.

actions.name: Blood-Drinking Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15). A grappled creature takes 13 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage at the start of the hag's turn. The hag recovers half that amount as hit points. Excess hit points become temporary hit points. The hag can grapple one or two creatures at a time. See also Tear Off Face.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Call Blood
actions.desc: The blood hag targets a living creature within 30 feet that she has pinpointed with Blood Sense and causes a hemorrhage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the effects listed below. On a success, this hag's power doesn't affect it for 24 hours. 1. Blood Choke. The target's mouth fills with blood, preventing it from speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component for 1 minute. 2. Blood Eye. The target's eyes fill with tears of blood. It is blinded for 1 minute. 3. Thundering Pulse. The target hears nothing but the flow of blood and the beating of its heart. It is deafened for 1 minute. 4. Arterial Rupture. The victim takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage as its veins and arteries tear. The target repeats the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, it takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage; on a success, it ends the effect.

actions.name: Tear Off Face
actions.desc: The blood hag tears off the face of a grappled opponent. The victim must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the hag rips off its face, dealing it 38 (8d6 + 10) slashing damage. The victim is then stunned until the start of the hag's next turn. If the target succeeds on its save, it takes half damage and isn't stunned. Heal, regenerate, and similar magic restores the stolen features; other forms of healing magic leave a mass of scar tissue. The torn-off face is a Tiny animated object (as the spell, 20 hp, AC 18, no attack, STR 4, DEX 18) under the hag's control. It retains the memories and personality of its previous owner. Blood hags keep these faces as trophies, but they can also wear them to gain advantage on a Charisma (Deception) check to impersonate the face's previous owner.

traits.name: Giant Strength
traits.desc: A gug can lift up to 2 tons as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gug makes two fist attacks, two stomp attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice in the same turn, the victim must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The gug moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The gug makes one fist or stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Grab
legendaryActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

legendaryActions.name: Swallow
legendaryActions.desc: The gug swallows a creature it has grappled. The creature immediately takes 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but it is blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the gug. If the gug takes 75 damage in a single turn, it spits out the swallowed creature, which falls prone next to it. When the gug dies, a swallowed creature can crawl out of its corpse by spending 10 feet of movement.

legendaryActions.name: Throw
legendaryActions.desc: The gug throws a creature it has grappled. The creature is hurled a distance of 2d4 x 10 feet in a direction of the gug's choice and takes 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage (plus falling damage if it is thrown into a pit or off a cliff). A gug can throw a creature of Large size at most. It throws Small creatures twice as far, but the damage remains the same.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A denizen of Leng's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: comprehend languages, minor illusion. 3/day each: disguise self, suggestion. 1/day each: dream, etherealness

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: At the start of each of its turns, a denizen of Leng regains 5 hit points. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. A denizen of Leng dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. Even if killed, its body reforms in a Leng crypt, and it then resumes the normal course of its life.

traits.name: Void Gaze
traits.desc: As a bonus action, a denizen of Leng can see through doors and around corners. It is therefore very hard to surprise.

traits.name: Void Sailors
traits.desc: Denizens of Leng can cross the anaerobic void without harm.

actions.name: Ethereal Harpoon
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). In addition, ethereal harpoon attacks ignore armor. Only the Dexterity modifier incorporated in the target's AC is taken into account.

actions.name: Psychic Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Barbed Spiderweb Net (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/50 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) poison damage, and the target is restrained. A successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw halves the poison damage.

traits.name: Dissonance
traits.desc: The owl harpy can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The owl harpy uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day: darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owl harpy makes two claw attacks and two talon attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Drifting Darkness
actions.desc: A hovering owl harpy can drop a fine magical dust from its wings onto a creature 20 feet or less directly below it. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious and poisoned for 10 minutes. It wakes up if it takes damage or if a creature uses its action to wake it up. Waking doesn't remove the poison.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: The owl harpy sings a magical melody. All humanoids and giants within 300 feet that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must use a bonus action on its subsequent turns to keep singing. It can stop at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated. While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the song of other harpies. If it moves more than 5 feet away from the harpy, it must move at its maximum speed (dashing if necessary) by the shortest route to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't maneuver to avoid opportunity attacks, but it can repeat the saving throw each time it takes damage from a source other than the harpy. It repeats the saving throw before entering dangerous terrain (such as lava or a pit) if the most direct route includes a dangerous area. It also repeats it at the end of each of its turns. A successful saving throw ends the effect on the creature and makes it immune to that harpy's song for 24 hours.

traits.name: Corrupting Touch
traits.desc: A herald of darkness can destroy any object of wood, leather, copper, iron, or paper by touching it as a bonus action. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Gift of Darkness
traits.desc: As an action, the herald of darkness can transform a fey, a human, or a goblin into a shadow fey, if the target accepts the transformation.

traits.name: Shadow Form
traits.desc: A herald of darkness can turn into an intangible shadow as a bonus action. In this form, it has a flying speed of 10 feet, can enter and occupy a space occupied by another creature, gains resistance to all nonmagical damage, has advantage on physical saving throws, can pass through any gap or opening, and can't attack, interact with physical objects, or speak. It can resume tangible form as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The herald of darkness uses Abyssal Majesty if available and makes one melee attack.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 6 (1d12) necrotic damage. Targets are paralyzed until the start of the herald's next turn. A DC 17 Constitution saving throw negates the paralysis.

actions.name: Abyssal Majesty (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. All creatures within 30 feet in the herald's field of vision take 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. Those that fail are blinded for 2 rounds; the others are frightened for 2 rounds.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.desc: Each round, the herald of blood takes no damage or other effects from the first attack that targets it.

traits.name: Gift of Blood
traits.desc: As an action, the herald of blood can transform a fey, a human, or a goblin into a red hag, if the target accepts the transformation.

traits.name: Grant Blood Rage
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the herald of blood plunges a single living creature into a blood rage, giving it advantage on attacks for 3 rounds. Afterward, it gains one level of exhaustion and takes 13 (2d12) necrotic damage from blood loss.

traits.name: Humanoid Form

traits.name: Melting Touch
traits.desc: When a herald of blood scores a critical hit or starts its turn grappling an opponent, it can dissolve one wood or metal object of its choice in that opponent's possession. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Enveloping Protoplasm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, or the herald of blood grapples it (escape DC 16). A creature grappled this way takes 39 (6d12) acid damage at the start of each of the herald's turns. The herald has no limit to the number of creatures it can grapple this way.

legendaryActions.name: Move

legendaryActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 39 (6d12) necrotic damage. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

legendaryActions.name: Majesty of Ragnarok (Costs 3 Actions)

All creatures within 100 feet in the herald's field of vision take 32 (5d12) necrotic damage, gain 2 levels of exhaustion, and are permanently blinded. A target that succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw isn't blinded and gains only one level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Keen Smell

legendaryActions.desc: Hraesvelgr makes one fist or talon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Hraesvelgr moves up to half its speed. If it is in roc form, all creatures within 10 feet of it at the end of this movement must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

legendaryActions.name: Swallow (Costs 3 Actions, Roc Form Only)
legendaryActions.desc: Hraesvelgr makes one bite attack against a creature it has grappled. If it hits, it swallows the creature. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but it is blinded, restrained, and has advantage against attacks and effects coming from outside Hraesvelgr. A swallowed creature takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. If Hraesvelgr reverts to giant form, or takes 40 damage or more in a turn from a swallowed creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which then fall prone within 10 feet of it. If Hraesvelgr dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by spending 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Elemental Swarm
traits.desc: Ia'Affrat can occupy the same space as another creature and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect to pass through.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Ia'Affrat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Ia'Affrat's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: poison spray, fire bolt. 3/day each: invisibility, burning hands, ray of enfeeblement, ray of sickness. 1/day each: bestow curse, contagion, blight, insect plague, fireball

traits.name: Inhabit
traits.desc: Ia'Affrat can enter the body of an incapacitated or dead creature through the mouth and other orifices. This process takes 1 minute, and the victim must be Small, Medium, or Large. As an action, Ia'Affrat can leave the body. Attacks that hit its host deal half damage to Ia'Affrat, but it still benefits from its resistances and immunities against that damage. If Ia'Affrat inhabits a dead body, it can animate it and control its movements, the body effectively becoming a zombie for as long as Ia'Affrat occupies it.

traits.name: Veil of Smoke
traits.desc: Ia'Affrat is surrounded by a cloud of black smoke in a 5-foot radius. This area is considered lightly obscured for all creatures other than Ia'Affrat. Any creature that needs to breathe and starts its turn in this area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution check or be stunned until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage if Ia'Affrat has half its hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Smoke Leap. Ia'Affrat can instantly move to a space in its field of vision that contains smoke.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Each creature in the same space as Ia'Affrat must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and it is hurled 20 feet from Ia'Affrat in a random direction and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't hurled or knocked prone. If the hurled creature strikes an obstacle, such as a wall or the floor, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet traveled. If it strikes another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same amount of damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Aura of Apostasy
traits.desc: The divine idol's presence makes the devoted faithful doubt their faith. A cleric or paladin who sees the idol and wants to cast a spell or use a class power must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the spell or power is expended but has no effect.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The divine idol can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Stealth in Shadows
traits.desc: When the idol is in darkness or dim light, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The divine idol uses Seduce the Virtuous and makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Seduce the Virtuous
actions.desc: The idol targets a humanoid creature it can see within 30 feet. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, or ability checks (the idol's choice) until the end of its next turn. If the target benefits from the protection from evil and good spell or a magic circle, this effect doesn't apply.

isonade.name: Isonade
isonade.languages: understands Aquan and Celestial but can't speak

traits.name: Atmospheric Immunity
traits.desc: The isonade lives comfortably at any ocean depth and suffers no depth-related penalties.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The isonade has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The isonade can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The isonade uses Wisdom as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: animal messenger. 3/day each: control water, earthquake. 1/day each: control weather, storm of vengeance, tsunami

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An isonade makes one tail attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (5d12 + 10) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). If the target is already grappled from a previous bite, it is swallowed (see below).

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Leap out of the Water
actions.desc: The isonade bursts out of the water and slams down on a target with devastating effect. It must move 30 feet in a straight line toward its target before leaping. When it leaps, it rises at most 30 feet into the air before landing. A creature in the isonade's landing zone takes 76 (12d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and ends up submerged 10 feet underwater. A target that succeeds on a DC 20 Strength saving throw takes only half damage and ends up in the nearest unoccupied space instead of being submerged. Boats and structures aren't immune to this attack.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: When the isonade's bite attack hits a target already grappled by a previous bite attack, that target is swallowed. The grapple ends, but the target is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the isonade, and takes 36 (8d8) acid damage at the start of each of the isonade's turns. The isonade can have two Large, four Medium, or six Small creatures swallowed at a time. If a swallowed creature deals 40 damage or more to the isonade in a single turn, the isonade must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 10 feet of it. If the isonade dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by spending 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Spearhead
traits.desc: If the jaculus moves at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target and hits it with a jaws attack in the same turn, the attack deals an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The jaculus makes one jaws attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Jaws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Extinguish Flames
traits.desc: A kalke can extinguish candles, lamps, lanterns, and smoldering campfires within 120 feet as a bonus action.

traits.name: Detect Spellcasting
traits.desc: A kalke perceives spellcasting within 5 miles, as long as the effect isn't innate.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A kalke has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The kikimora has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The kikimora uses Charisma as her innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility (self only), mage hand, mending, minor illusion, prestidigitation. 3/day each: friendship with animals, blinding smite, sleep. 1/day each: insect plague, major image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kikimora makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hideaway
actions.desc: When a kikimora chooses a house to settle in, she scrawls a symbol on a wall, baseboard, cupboard, or semi-permanent object (such as a stove) to make it her little domain. This power creates a hidden extradimensional dwelling. Once the kikimora has created her hideaway, she can teleport to it, along with 50 lbs. of objects, instead of moving normally. Only the kikimora, or a creature using the plane shift spell or trait, can reach it. The hideaway's location can be determined by casting detect magic on the symbol's area, but reaching it by plane shifting requires a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. Once inside her hideaway, the kikimora can see what is happening outside thanks to a special sensor. It functions like a window and can be blocked by placing an ordinary object in front of the symbol. If the kikimora places an object in her hideaway, it remains there even if she erases the symbol and redraws it elsewhere. If someone else erases the symbol, all the hideaway's contents spill into the Ethereal Plane (including any creatures there at that moment). In that case, the kikimora can attempt a Charisma saving throw to eject herself into a space adjacent to the symbol (but her possessions don't come with her).

kishi.name: Kishi
kishi.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.desc: The demon has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and unconscious.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The demon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, detect evil and good, suggestion
3/day: glibness
1/day: dominate person

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Trophy Shield
traits.desc: If the kishi kills an opponent during its turn, it can use a bonus action to harvest part of the victim's essence along with a gruesome trophy, which it mounts on its shield. For 24 hours, the kishi's Armor Class becomes 20, and creatures of the same race as its victim have disadvantage on attack rolls against the kishi.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: A kishi has a 35 percent chance of summoning another kishi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The demon makes one bite attack and three spear attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Apothecary
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the kobold can choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, or fire. It has resistance to damage of the chosen type until it uses this ability again. In addition, it is proficient with the poisoner's kit.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Alchemical Protection (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The kobold chooses up to six allied creatures within 10 feet. It releases alchemical vapors that give them resistance to poison damage for 10 minutes. Alternatively, it can grant them resistance to the same damage type currently active from its Apothecary trait.

actions.name: Explosive Flask (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The kobold hurls a flask of volatile substance at a point within 30 feet. It explodes in a 15-foot radius. Creatures in the area take 17 (5d6) poison damage and are poisoned for 1 minute. A creature that succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw takes only half damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success. Instead of poison damage, the kobold can deal damage of the same type as the one currently active from its Apothecary trait.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold chieftain has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold chieftain has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Spike-Shooting Shield (5/Rest)
traits.desc: When the kobold chieftain is hit by a melee attack within 5 feet of it, it can fire one of its shield's spikes at the attacker. The attacker takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.

actions.name: Inspiring Presence (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The chieftain chooses up to six allied kobolds it can see within 30 feet of it. For the next minute, they are immune to being charmed or frightened, and they add the chieftain's Charisma bonus to their attack rolls.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold trapsmith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold trapsmith has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the trapsmith's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Thieves' Tools
traits.desc: The trapsmith is proficient with thieves' tools and rarely parts with them. If it loses its tools or has them stolen, it can craft new ones from wire, scrap metal, and other debris in 30 minutes.

traits.name: Traps and Snares
traits.desc:
The kobold trapsmith excels at setting mechanical traps. Detecting, disarming, avoiding, or mitigating one of its traps requires a successful DC 13 check or saving throw. Each trap has a +5 attack bonus. If the trapsmith has thieves' tools and basic construction materials, it can install one of the simple but effective traps below in 5 minutes. Triggers include pressure plates, tripwires, tumblers on a lock, or other simple mechanisms.
Suffocation Bomb. This small incendiary object burns rapidly and gives off choking smoke in a 20-foot sphere. Visibility within is nil. Any breathing creature in the area when the cloud is released, or that starts its turn there, is poisoned. Once a poisoned creature leaves the cloud, it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. It stops being poisoned as soon as it succeeds on one. The smoke dissipates after 10 minutes or after 1 round of strong wind.
Poisoned Shard. A poisoned shard or needle can hide anywhere: in a lock or a box, under a rug, under a door handle, in a full glass, or in a bowl of gems. As soon as a creature meets the conditions to be pricked, the trap makes a melee attack with advantage: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
Skull Cracker. This trap consists of a weight, spike, or blade designed to fall on a victim or cut it down. When triggered, it makes a melee weapon attack against the first target in its path: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) damage. The damage type depends on the skull cracker's design: a stone or heavy log deals bludgeoning damage, a spike-studded trunk deals piercing damage, a scythe blade deals slashing damage, and so on.
Slip Snare. A concealed loop of rope or wire is attached to a counterweight. When a creature steps into the loop, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be hoisted into the air and left hanging upside down 5 feet above the ground. It is then restrained (escape DC 13). The rope has AC 10 and 5 hit points.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Crusher (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The trapsmith arms a device and hurls it at a point within 30 feet. The device explodes as soon as it touches something solid, sending sharp spikes flying in a 15-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the area take 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. The ground in the spherical area is strewn with spikes; it becomes difficult terrain. A creature that falls prone there takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stunner (1/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained (escape DC 13). While restrained, it takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns and falls prone. The trapsmith has advantage on the attack roll if the target wears metal armor. The stunner is a bola made of wire, magnets, and static-electricity capacitors. The kobold trapsmith can recharge it during a long rest.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.desc: Once per turn, the kobold deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the kobold is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the kobold instead takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The kongamato doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Boat Breaker
traits.desc: The kongamato deals double damage to objects and structures made of wood or lighter materials.

traits.name: Carry Off
traits.desc: A kongamato can carry off prey weighing up to 55 pounds, or a single rider of the same weight. A group can carry up to 110 pounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kongamato makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the kongamato can't bite another target. When the kongamato moves, the grappled creature moves with it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the koralk's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The koralk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Steadfast
traits.desc: A koralk can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A koralk makes three stinger attacks and two scythe attacks. It can also make one bite attack against a target it is grappling.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) slashing damage, or the koralk can instead grab a Medium or smaller target with its smaller vestigial arms (no damage, escape DC 13).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as its entrails liquefy. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the koralk's poison for 24 hours. If the creature dies while under the effects of a koralk's poison, its corpse bursts and a newly formed lemure slicked with foul fluid crawls out. The lemure obeys the highest-ranking devil nearby. The poison can be neutralized by lesser restoration, protection from poison, or similar magic. If the lemure is killed, the original creature can be returned to life only by means of a resurrection spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Hidden Soul
traits.desc: A creature holding the egg that contains Koschei's soul can use its action to command the fiend as if the fiend had been targeted by dominate monster and had failed its saving throw. While his soul is in the needle, Koschei can't be permanently slain. If he perishes, his body reforms in his lair within 1d10 days. If the needle is broken, Koschei can be killed like anyone else.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Koschei's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, phantom steed, scorching ray, sending
3/day each: invisibility, magic missile, shield
2/day each: animate objects, cone of cold, hypnotic pattern
1/day each: disintegrate, meteor swarm, shapechange

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Koschei fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Koschei's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage (included below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Koschei makes two longsword attacks and one life drain attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and Koschei regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei makes one longsword attack.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei magically teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 40 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei makes one life drain attack.

traits.name: Healing
traits.desc: The kot bayun's tales have, at will, the same effect as lesser restoration, and once per week the same effect as greater restoration. The cat designates one listener who benefits from this power. The listener must spend an hour listening without interruption. Kot bayuns are reluctant to grant this healing, so they must be bargained with or compelled by a domination effect.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The kot bayun's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: fog cloud, invisibility (self only)
1/day: blink

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kot bayun makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sleep Song
actions.desc: The kot bayun puts others to sleep with an entrancing lullaby. While it sings, it can target one listener within 100 feet. The listener must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or fall asleep. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The kot bayun can choose a new target each round it continues the song. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that kot bayun's lullaby for 24 hours. The sleep song affects even elves, but they have advantage on the Charisma saving throw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Burst Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rock larva emits a wave in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5 (1d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes only half damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

traits.name: Interdimensional Movement
traits.desc: A star larva of Cthulhu can use misty step as a bonus action once per round.

traits.name: Psychic Bulwark
traits.desc: When an attack that deals psychic damage targets the larva, it rebounds toward the attacker. Resolve the attack as if the attacker were the original target, using the larva's ability modifiers and proficiencies instead of the attacker's.

traits.name: Void Traveler
traits.desc: The star larva of Cthulhu needs no air, heat, ambient pressure, food, or water, which allows it to travel safely through interstellar space and any similar void.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The star larva uses Disintegration Gaze if it is available, and it also makes one crushing claws attack and one dimensional step attack.

actions.name: Crushing Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Disintegration Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 60 ft., one target it can see. Hit: 32 (5d12) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or dissipate into vapor, as if affected by the gaseous form spell. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the effect ends, but on a failure the creature takes another 32 (5d12) necrotic damage and remains gaseous. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage is permanently disintegrated and can't return to life except by means of a wish or similar magic that doesn't require a piece of its corpse to function.

actions.name: Dimensional Step
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d20 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be teleported elsewhere, as with the dimension door spell. The star larva chooses the destination, which can't be a space already occupied by an object or a creature.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The leshy's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: animal friendship, pass without trace, speak with animals
1/day each: entangle, plant growth, shillelagh, speak with plants, tasha's hideous laughter

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: The leshy has advantage on Stealth checks while it has at least light obscurement from foliage.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The leshy can mimic the cries and voices of any creature it has heard. Doing so requires a Charisma (Deception) check. A listener that succeeds on a Wisdom (Insight) or Intelligence (Nature) check (GM's choice) recognizes the mimicry. The leshy has advantage on the check if it imitates a general type of creature (a crow's caw, a bear's roar) rather than the voice of a specific individual.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The leshy makes two club attacks.

actions.name: Change Size
actions.desc: The leshy appears to change size, growing as tall as an oak tree (Gargantuan) or as small as a blade of grass (Tiny). This is only an illusion, so its statistics don't change.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Bone Wrack
traits.desc: When the slow storm hits a living creature with a slam attack or its breath, it absorbs the moisture from the creature's joints, causing stiffness and pain. In addition to this drain of 1d4 Dexterity, if the creature is caught in the slow storm's breath and fails another DC 18 Constitution saving throw, it suffers horrible aches in its bones and joints. Each round it moves while suffering this pain, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage for every 5 feet it travels. The pain of the bone wrack persists until the creature recovers at least 1 point of the lost Dexterity.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The slow storm's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: lightning bolt
3/day: chain lightning

traits.name: Storm Form
traits.desc: If a creature starts its turn in the slow storm's wind or enters that wind, the creature takes 9 (2d8) force damage. A creature takes this damage only once per round. In addition, ranged projectile attacks against the slow storm have disadvantage because of the fierce winds surrounding it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Electrical Discharge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The slow storm spits its electricity in a 30-foot cone. Targets in the affected area take 54 (12d8) lightning damage, lose 1d4 Dexterity, and suffer the bone ravages. A DC 18 Constitution saving throw halves the Dexterity loss and prevents the bone ravages.

traits.name: Keen Smell and Hearing
traits.desc: The canine lich has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ethereal Leap
actions.desc: The canine lich can magically shift from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane and vice versa as a bonus action.

actions.name: Eviscerate
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the canine lich rips the flesh of any prone creature adjacent to it, dealing 19 (3d12) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for 1d4 rounds. An incapacitated creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Howl
actions.desc: The eerie howl of a canine lich closing in on its prey breaks the morale of living creatures that hear it. The howl requires an action. Creatures within 100 feet that hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 5 rounds. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by a canine lich's howl for 24 hours.

traits.name: Aggressive Leap
traits.desc: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the likho can use a bonus action to make two additional claw attacks against it.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The likho's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: message
3/day each: crown of madness, mirror image, ray of enfeeblement
1/day: bestow curse

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The likho makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Unnerving Gaze
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the likho turns its gaze on a single creature it can see and temporarily jinxes it. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

limon-des-sarcophages.name: Sarcophagus Slime
limon-des-sarcophages.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The sarcophagus slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sarcophagus slime uses Frightful Presence and Corrupting Gaze, and it makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the sarcophagus slime's choice within 60 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the slime's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Corrupting Gaze
actions.desc: The sarcophagus slime targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the slime, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. If this effect reduces a creature's hit point maximum to 0, the creature dies and its corpse transforms into a sarcophagus slime within 24 hours. The reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest or benefits from a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The shroud can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Metamorphosis
traits.desc: A shroud instantly transforms into a shadow once it has dealt 12 points of damage. Any damage the shroud has taken is subtracted from the shadow's hit point or ability score total.

traits.name: Shroud Stealth
traits.desc: When the shroud is in darkness or dim light, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the shroud has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by half that amount. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0; otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from its corpse 1d4 hours later.

traits.name: Lindwurm Fever
traits.desc: If a creature is infected with this disease from a lindwurm bite, it gains one level of exhaustion one hour after infection. It must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw after each long rest. On a failure, it gains one level of exhaustion and doesn't regain hit dice from the rest. On a success, it sheds one level of exhaustion and regains hit dice normally from the long rest. If it manages to remove all its levels of exhaustion by succeeding on saving throws, it recovers from the disease.

traits.name: Agile Skater
traits.desc: A lindwurm suffers no penalty from difficult terrain made of ice, and it is immune to the effects of the grease spell.

traits.name: Serpent Belly
traits.desc: If the lindwurm lies belly-down against ice, it senses the approach of a creature through the vibrations it causes, giving it tremorsense.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lindwurm makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract lindwurm fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The target is restrained, and the lindwurm can't constrict another target while this grapple persists.

traits.name: Alien Mentality
traits.desc: The liosalfar's exotic consciousness makes it immune to psychic effects. A creature that tries to read its thoughts is confused for 1 round.

traits.name: Darkness Vulnerability
traits.desc: Magical darkness harms the liosalfar. Each time it starts its turn within magical darkness, it takes 2d10 necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw. It dislikes natural darkness, but natural darkness causes it no harm.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: A liosalfar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The liosalfar's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: augury, dancing lights, detect magic, light, silent image, spare the dying
2/day each: alter self, blur, divination, hypnotic pattern, prismatic spray, scorching ray
1/day each: hallucinatory terrain, plane shift, sunbeam

traits.name: Luminous Form
traits.desc: A liosalfar is composed entirely of light. It is incorporeal and subject to no ability damage, nor to polymorph, petrification, or any form-altering attack.

traits.name: Prismatic Glow
traits.desc: A liosalfar emits rainbow light equal to the daylight spell. It can't extinguish this light without dying, but it can at will reduce it to the brightness of a torch. Even when using alter self, it emits a diffuse glow that can be spotted in darkness or dim light.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The liosalfar makes two disrupting touch attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d12) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An elemental locus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Immortal
traits.desc: An elemental locus doesn't age, and it doesn't die when reduced to 0 hit points. If the elemental locus drops to 0 hit points, it enters a dormant state for 25 weeks before becoming active again with all its hit points recovered. Elementals it spawned keep fighting the enemies that attacked the elemental locus. If no enemies are present, they defend the area where the elemental locus settled.

traits.name: Immense
traits.desc: An elemental locus is larger than most Gargantuan creatures and occupies a space 60 feet on a side. Its movement is unaffected by difficult terrain and by creatures of Huge size or smaller. Other creatures can enter and pass through the elemental locus's space, but they must succeed on a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check for every 10 feet of movement. On a failure, they fall prone and can move no farther that turn.

traits.name: Spawn Elementals
traits.desc: As a bonus action, an elemental locus can lose 82 hit points and spawn an air, earth, fire, or water elemental to serve it. Elementals spawned this way are subject to their creator's will and aren't fully independent. The kind of elemental an elemental locus can spawn depends on the terrain it embodies. For example, a desert elemental locus can spawn earth, fire, and air elementals, but not water elementals.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: An elemental locus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental locus makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Alluring Presence
traits.desc: Every humanoid within 30 feet of the lorelei that looks directly at her must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be drawn to her by the most direct route, ignoring danger. This attraction ends when the creature comes within 5 feet of the lorelei. A creature can avoid this effect for a full round by averting its eyes at the start of its turn, but it has disadvantage on attack rolls and other actions directed at the lorelei until the start of its next turn. The lorelei can switch this power off or on as a bonus action. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by the same lorelei's Alluring Presence for 24 hours.

traits.name: Supernatural Grace
traits.desc: The lorelei adds her Charisma modifier in place of her normal modifier to all her saving throws.

traits.name: Aquatic Spirit
traits.desc: The lorelei is under the effect of freedom of movement whenever she is in contact with a body of water.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The lorelei is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She needs no material components to cast her spells. She has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): detect magic, guidance, light, mending, poison spray, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, fog cloud, mage armor, ray of sickness
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, misty step, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): hypnotic pattern, gaseous form, water walk
4th level (2 slots): dominate beast, ice storm

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: The lorelei targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet. If the target can see or hear the lorelei, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by her. The charmed target regards the lorelei as its one true love, to be heeded and protected. It isn't under the lorelei's control, but it interprets her wishes and actions in the most favorable way. Each time the target takes damage from the lorelei or her companions, directly or indirectly, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours, until the lorelei is killed, until she is on a different plane of existence from the target, or until she ends the effect as a bonus action.

actions.name: Stunning Gaze
actions.desc: With a look, the lorelei mentally disrupts one creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 2 rounds. A target that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by the same lorelei's Stunning Gaze for 24 hours.

traits.name: Crushing Charge
traits.desc: If the loxoda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or larger creature and hits it with a tread attack, it has advantage on that attack. If that attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The loxoda makes two attacks, no more than one of which can be a warhammer or javelin attack.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The lynx's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: gaseous form

traits.name: Misty Constitution
traits.desc: The mist lynx spends its time shifting between gaseous and solid form. Its unique constitution makes it immune to all attacks and spells involving fog or gas, including its own. The mist lynx can see perfectly through mist, fog, and spells such as fog cloud that create reduced or no visibility.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mist lynx makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mist lynx breathes poisonous fog in a 40-foot radius, reducing visibility to nil in a spherical area around it. Any breathing creature that ends its turn in the fog must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d4 + 1 rounds.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The mahoru can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the mahoru's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar
actions.desc: When a mahoru roars, all creatures that can hear it within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are frightened until the end of the mahoru's next turn. Those that fail by 5 or more are also paralyzed for the same duration. Those that succeed are immune to the roar of all mahorus for 24 hours.

actions.name: Vorpal Bite
actions.desc:
A mahoru's sawtooth jaws are built for dismemberment. When the mahoru scores a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or lose a limb. Roll on the following table:
d12 | Result
1-2 | right hand
3-4 | left hand
5-6 | right foot
7-8 | left foot
9 | right forearm
10 | left forearm
11 | right shin
12 | left shin

traits.name: Torrid Radiance
traits.desc: A malakbel generates an aura of intense light and heat in a 30-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the aura or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 11 (2d10) radiant damage. The aura's area is brightly lit, and it sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet. The aura dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower where their areas of effect overlap.

traits.name: Distortion
traits.desc: Ranged attacks made against a malakbel have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A malakbel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A malakbel makes two scorching burst attacks.

actions.name: Scorching Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Torch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The malakbel intensifies its torrid radiance to make it devastating. All creatures in the area of the malakbel's aura take 31 (7d8) radiant damage and gain one level of exhaustion. A creature that succeeds on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw takes half that amount of damage and doesn't gain the level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: A malakbel can magically teleport to an unoccupied space within 100 feet.

mallqui.name: Mallqui
mallqui.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The mallqui regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the mallqui takes damage from its reaction to water, its regeneration doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The mallqui dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mallqui's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: druidcraft, produce flame
4/day each: create or destroy water, entangle
2/day: locate animals or plants
1/day each: dispel magic, plant growth, wind wall

traits.name: Reaction to Water
traits.desc:
The mallqui's flesh putrefies and dissolves rapidly when soaked with water as follows:
Doused with a waterskin or the like: 1d10 damage
Attacked by a creature made of water: normal damage plus 1d10 damage
Rain: 2d10 damage per round (DC 11 Dexterity saving throw for half)
Immersion in water: 4d10 damage per round (DC 13 Dexterity saving throw for half)
You can substitute the save DC of a spell used to summon or control the water that damages the mallqui for the listed values.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mallqui can use its Xeric Aura and make two withering touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Xeric Aura
