actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of the mallqui must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and gain one level of exhaustion. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that mallqui's Xeric Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Xeric Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The malphas's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: magic missile
1/day: haste

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A malphas has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while in sunlight.

traits.name: Night Terror (1/Round)
traits.desc: Immediately after hitting with a melee attack, the malphas can use a bonus action to cast magic missile on the same target through its blade.

traits.name: Fencing Training
traits.desc: The malphas trains in combat from an early age. It is proficient with all martial melee and ranged weapons.

traits.name: Call of Shadows
traits.desc: A malphas can cast magic missile as a reaction when it is hit by a ranged weapon attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A malphas makes three longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

mamura.name: Mamura
mamura.languages: Common, Elvish, Goblin, Sylvan, Void Speech

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.desc: An attacker never has advantage on attacks against the mamura and deals it no extra damage for having allies nearby.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mamura has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Friend of Darkness
traits.desc: While in darkness or dim light, the mamura has advantage on Stealth checks. It can attempt to hide as a bonus action at the end of its turn if it is in darkness or dim light.

traits.name: Distraction
traits.desc: Because of the mamura's strange, unsettling aura, a spellcaster within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 spellcasting ability check before casting a spell. On a failure, the spellcaster loses its action but not the spell slot. It must also make a DC 14 spellcasting ability check to maintain concentration if it spends part of its turn in the aura.

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The mamura doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mamura makes three pincer attacks and one tail stinger attack.

actions.name: Pincers
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 round. The poison's duration stacks if the target fails multiple saves.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage. If it is also poisoned by the mamura's pincers, it takes an additional 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of its turns while poisoned.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A fate eater's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
1/day each: blink, hallucinatory terrain

traits.name: Divinatory Flesh
traits.desc: An individual who feeds on a fate eater's flesh must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it gains a divination spell. On a failure, it vomits blood and also fails the next saving throw it makes during combat.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spectral Bite
actions.desc:
When a fate eater scores a critical hit against a target, it doesn't merely wound the creature; it also damages the strands of its fate, changing its victim's past or future. The target must roll 1d6 on the table below for each critical hit it failed to negate with a DC 15 Charisma saving throw:
1 | See the Alternatives: Suffers the effects of the confusion spell for 1d4 rounds
2 | Detached from the Loom: The character's speed becomes random for 4 rounds. At the start of each of its turns, determine its speed with a dice roll: 3d20 x 1 ft.
3 | Altered Memories: Permanently and randomly loses proficiency in one skill it is proficient in, and randomly gains proficiency in another skill it isn't proficient in
4 | Not So Fast: Loses the use of one of its class features, determined randomly
5 | Lost Potential: Loses 1 point in an ability determined randomly
6 | A Sidelined Path: The character's current hit point total becomes its hit point maximum
Effects 3 through 6 are permanent until the character succeeds on a Charisma saving throw. It repeats the saving throw after each long rest, but the DC increases by 1 after each attempt as the character settles ever more deeply into its new destiny. Otherwise, these new fates can be undone only by a wish spell or comparable magic.

mangepoussiere-yakat-shi.name: Dust Eater (Yakat-shi)
mangepoussiere-yakat-shi.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 100 ft.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A dust eater's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: freedom of movement, inflict wounds, true strike
1/day each: cure wounds (3rd level), magic weapon (6th level), misty step

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The dust eater regains 5 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The dust eater dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Insatiable Hunger
traits.desc:
A dust eater can devour any substance with its jawblade, whatever its composition, and it is never sated. It can even feed on dust or dirt (hence the name various fiends gave the members of this race). If a dust eater's jawblade is stolen, destroyed, or lost, it slowly dies of starvation.
Weapon Bond. A dust eater's jawblade is part of it. It can strike any creature as if the weapon were magically enchanted and made of silver, iron, or any other substance that overcomes that creature's immunities or resistances. A dust eater always knows where its jawblade is, as if using the locate creature spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dust eater makes two jawblade attacks, or it makes one jawblade attack and casts inflict wounds.

actions.name: Jawblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: On its turn, a dream eater can polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Apart from its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A dream eater's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: command
3/day: suggestion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dream eater makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dream Eater's Caress
actions.desc: A creature still grappled by the dream eater at the end of the dream eater's turn is restrained until the end of its next turn. It also takes 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage, and the dream eater gains that many temporary hit points.

actions.name: Lotus Scent (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A dream eater secretes an oily chemical most creatures find intoxicating. All living creatures within 30 feet of a dream eater must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against poison or be poisoned for 2d4 rounds. While poisoned, a creature is stunned. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that dream eater's lotus scent for 24 hours.

actions.name: Waking Dreams (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of a dream eater must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature enters a waking-dream state and is confused (as if affected by the confusion spell) for 6 rounds. If a creature can act normally during a turn (rolling a 9 or 10 on the confusion effect), it can repeat the saving throw at the end of that turn, ending the effect early on a success.

manteau-vide.name: Void Cloak
manteau-vide.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Diligent Sentinel
traits.desc: Void cloaks were created to stand guard against intruders. They have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Shadow Assemblage
traits.desc: Void cloaks are carefully tailored from the substance of shadows. If they take a critical hit, they explode and then dissipate into the shadows.

traits.name: Enveloping Embrace
traits.desc: A void cloak can share the same space with a Medium or smaller creature. The void cloak has advantage on attack rolls against any creature whose space it shares.

actions.name: Slashing Cloak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadow Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: Large or smaller creatures are restrained. To escape, the restrained creature or an ally in an adjacent space must take an action and succeed on a DC 14 Strength check. The shadow net has 15 hit points and AC 12.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, a forest marauder has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The forest marauder makes two boar spear attacks.

actions.name: Boar Spear
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the forest marauder can push the target 10 feet away if it fails a DC 16 Strength saving throw.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Closed-Eyes Curse
traits.desc: If the sandman scores a critical hit or a surprise attack against an opponent, its claws trace a rune on its victim's eyeballs, sealing its eyelids shut and leaving it blind. This effect can be ended with greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The sandman's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, minor illusion, plane shift (night only), phantom steed, prestidigitation, sleep (11d8)
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, major image
1/day each: dream, phantasmal killer (5d10)

traits.name: Made of Dreams
traits.desc: Because the sandman is made of dreams and imagination, it takes only half damage from critical hits and sneak attacks. The total damage of the attack is halved, not just the extra damage.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the sandman hits a creature with an attack during the first round of combat and the target is surprised, that attack deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sandman makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Charged Body
traits.desc: If a creature hits the spire walker with a melee attack using a metal weapon, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The spire walker's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: spark (as the produce flame cantrip, but it deals lightning damage)
3/day each: dancing lights, feather fall, invisibility
1/day each: faerie fire, thunderwave

traits.name: Arrow Step
traits.desc: The spire walker can spend 10 feet of movement to magically shift from its position to the tip of a steeple, mast, or other spire-topped feature it can see within 30 feet. The spire walker has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and Dexterity saving throws while it stands on a steeple or a similar sharp, steep structure.

actions.name: Lightning Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage. If the attack misses, the target still takes 4 (1d8) lightning damage. Whether or not the attack hits the intended target, all other creatures within 10 feet of it take 9 (2d8) lightning damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vine puppet regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and is in the jungle.

traits.name: Root Spirit
traits.desc: In the native forest or jungle of a vine lord, the vine puppet has blindsight out to 60 feet, succeeds on all Wisdom (Perception) checks, and can't be surprised.

traits.name: Green Walker
traits.desc: The vine puppet ignores movement restrictions and damage caused by natural undergrowth.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vine puppet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Thorn Throw
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the thorn explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Each creature in the affected area other than the original target takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mavka's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
Constant: protection from evil and good
At will: create or destroy water, dancing lights, ray of frost, resistance, witch bolt
3/day each: darkness, hold person, inflict wounds, invisibility, silence
1/day each: animate dead, bestow curse, blindness/deafness, contagion, dispel magic, vampiric touch

traits.name: Nightmare Mount
traits.desc: A mavka is bound to a nightmare at its creation. Ninety-five percent of the time, it is encountered with its mount.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: The mavka takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mavka makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Toxic Skin
traits.desc: A creature that touches a mbielu or hits it with a melee attack is exposed to the poison coating its skin. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Roll Over
traits.desc: If a Large creature grapples a mbielu, the mbielu knocks it over and rolls on top of it, crushing it. The mbielu immediately escapes the grapple, and the creature that grappled it takes 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Extra Legs
traits.desc: A clockwork abomination has four legs that give it a climb speed equal to half its normal speed and allow it to move normally through difficult terrain.

traits.name: Reach Pistons
traits.desc: The pistons that power a clockwork abomination also give it a surprisingly long reach.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork abomination is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Infernal Power Source
traits.desc: When a clockwork abomination drops to 0 hit points, its infernal battery explodes. Creatures within 10 feet of the abomination take 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A clockwork abomination makes one bite attack and one slam attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The clockwork abomination's infernal power source allows it to spew fire in a 20-foot cone. Creatures caught in the cone take 22 (4d10) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork weaver spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork weaver spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A weaver spider makes two ravel-blade attacks or two poisoned needle shuttle attacks.

actions.name: Ravel Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, with a chance of deconstruction.

actions.name: Poisoned Needle Shuttle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Deconstruction
actions.desc: A clockwork weaver spider's speed, combined with its razor-sharp blade, lets it shred cloth, leather, and paper in moments. Whenever the spider hits a creature with a ravel-blade attack and the attack roll exceeds the target's Armor Class by 5 or more, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or one of its possessions becomes unusable or damaged until repaired (GM's choice).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork hunter is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Net Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: The target is restrained. A mechanism in the clockwork hunter's chest lets it fire a net connected to its torso by a 20-foot cable. A creature can free itself (or another creature) by using an action to make a DC 10 Strength check or by dealing 5 slashing damage to the net. The hunter can fire up to four nets before it must reload the launcher.

actions.name: Explosive Reactor
actions.desc: The mechanism that powers the hunter explodes when the construct is destroyed, spraying jets of scalding steam and shrapnel. All creatures within 5 feet of the construct take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork hound is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork hound has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Diligent Trackers
traits.desc: Clockwork hounds are tasked with guarding places or tracking prey. They have advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made while tracking.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Knockdown Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Explosive Reactor
actions.desc: The mechanism that powers the hound explodes when the construct is destroyed. All creatures within 5 feet of the hound take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork gendarme is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork gendarme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Net Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: The target is restrained. A mechanism in the clockwork gendarme's chest lets it fire a net connected to the gendarme's torso by a 20-foot cable. A creature can free itself (or another creature) by using an action to make a DC 10 Strength check or by dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10). The gendarme can fire up to four nets before it must reload the launcher.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork myrmidon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork myrmidon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon makes two attacks: two spike attacks, two slam attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: War Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Greek Fire Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon can spray a line of greek fire 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line takes 26 (4d12) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. The myrmidon's internal reservoir lets it use this attack four times before running dry.

actions.name: Grease Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a clockwork myrmidon can spray a jet of alchemical grease from its chest with a range of 30 feet. The grease covers a 10-foot square, which is then treated as difficult terrain. Each creature in the affected area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The myrmidon's internal reservoir lets it use this attack four times before running dry.

actions.name: Greek Fire Bomb
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon's greek fire reservoir explodes when the construct is destroyed, spattering nearby creatures with burning fuel. Each creature within 5 feet of the myrmidon takes 19 (3d12) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. This explosion doesn't occur if the clockwork myrmidon has already emptied its reservoir by using its Greek Fire Spray four times.

mecanique-scarabee.name: Clockwork Beetle
mecanique-scarabee.languages: understands Common, telepathy 100 ft. (with its creator only)

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork beetle is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork beetle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

meche-vivante.name: Living Wick
meche-vivante.languages: shares a telepathic bond with the one who lit its wick

traits.name: Controlled
traits.desc: A living wick can't move, attack, or take actions until it is lit. It obeys only the telepathic orders of the individual who lit it.

traits.name: Light
traits.desc: A lit living wick sheds light like a torch.

traits.name: Melting
traits.desc: While lit, the living wick loses 1 hit point every 24 hours.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Burn Out
actions.desc: The living wick can be ordered to rapidly burn its remaining wick, creating a devastating fireball. All creatures within 20 feet of the living wick take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. The fire bends around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. The wick is reduced to a puddle of wax.

mechuiti.name: Mechuiti
mechuiti.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Primordial, telepathy 300 ft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Mechuiti fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Mechuiti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Mechuiti's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Infectious Ichor
traits.desc: Whenever Mechuiti takes piercing or slashing damage, a spray of caustic blood jets from the wound toward the attacker. The spray forms a line 10 feet long and 5 feet wide. The first creature in the line's path must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw against disease or be infected with Mechuiti's ichor disease. The creature remains poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours, the target must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw; on a failure, its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (2d4). On a success, the disease is cured. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction to a creature's hit point maximum persists until the disease is cured.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Mechuiti's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dispel magic, fireball, hold monster, wall of fire
3/day each: power word stun, fire storm
1/day each: power word kill, meteor swarm

traits.name: Speak with Apes
traits.desc: Mechuiti can explain simple concepts to apes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mechuiti uses Frightful Presence and makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) slashing damage. If Mechuiti scores a critical hit, roll the damage dice three times instead of twice.

actions.name: Scorching Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Mechuiti spews a 60-foot cone of fire and acid. Creatures caught in the cone each take 21 (6d6) fire damage plus 21 (6d6) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 24 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Blazing Crown
actions.desc: Mechuiti's crown of fire erupts in a burst of yellow and green flames. All creatures within 30 feet of Mechuiti take 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 24 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature also catches fire and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the flames are extinguished. A creature can use its action to extinguish the flames on itself or on another creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Mechuiti's choice within 120 feet of him and aware of him must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Mechuiti's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: Mechuiti moves up to half his speed, using whichever movement type he chooses.

legendaryActions.name: Internal Burn
legendaryActions.desc: Mechuiti targets a creature within 120 feet that is infected with Mechuiti's ichor disease. The creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 24 Constitution saving throw. A creature that fails its saving throw also catches fire and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the flames are extinguished. A creature can use its action to extinguish the flames on itself or on another creature within reach.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Mechuiti casts a spell.

legendaryActions.name: Crown of Fire (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Mechuiti uses Blazing Crown.

traits.name: Curtain of Tentacles
traits.desc: When the medazur flies, its thin, electrified tentacles dangle beneath it and touch every creature within 20 feet directly below the space it occupies as it moves. Any creature in this path takes 10 (3d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tusked medazur makes one horn strike attack and one tentacle attack.

actions.name: Horn Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage. In addition, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The target is restrained until the grapple ends. While it grapples a target, the medazur can't use this attack against another target. If the medazur moves while grappling a Medium or smaller target, the target moves with it.

actions.name: Stinking Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The medazur sprays foul-smelling fluid in a line 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is unconscious for the same duration. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The molasses can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Charming Presence
traits.desc: The molasses has a supernatural ability to perceive the emotions of others and play on them. It has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks opposed by Wisdom (Insight or Perception) checks meant to see through its ruse.

actions.name: Reshape
actions.desc: The molasses takes the shape of a Tiny creature or object. A reshaped molasses gains the movement of its new form but no other special abilities.

actions.name: Blood Drain (1/Hour)
actions.desc: A molasses in contact with the skin of a warm-blooded creature deals 4 (1d8) necrotic damage per hour of contact and reduces the victim's hit point maximum by the same amount. The drain is so slow that the victim doesn't notice unless it breaks contact with the molasses (by putting it down or handing it to someone else, for example). When contact breaks, the victim notices blood on its skin or clothes only if it succeeds on a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check.

traits.name: Astral Voyager
traits.desc: A mi-go needs no air or heat to survive, only sunlight (and very little of that). It can take the form of a spore capable of surviving the void journey and regaining consciousness once conditions are favorable again.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The mi-go deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a target it hits with a claw attack if it has advantage on the attack roll, or if the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the mi-go that isn't incapacitated and the mi-go doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Unsettling Technology
traits.desc: Mi-gos are a highly evolved race, and many carry high-technology items. You can represent these technological items using the same rules as magic items, but their function is harder to identify: identify reveals nothing. You must spend 1 hour studying the mi-go item and succeed on a DC 19 Arcana check to understand its use and operation.

traits.name: Spore Release
traits.desc: When a mi-go dies, it releases the spores remaining within it. Every living creature within 10 feet takes 14 (2d8 + 5) poison damage and is poisoned. On a successful DC 16 Constitution saving throw, a creature takes half damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mi-go makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). If both claw attacks hit the same target in one turn, the target takes an extra 13 (2d12) psychic damage.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The mimic can use its action to transform into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Face Compression
traits.desc: When a Medium or smaller creature touches a card mimic, or vice versa, the mimic adheres to it and envelops its face, covering its eyes, ears, and airways (escape DC 13). The target is immediately blinded and deafened and begins suffocating at the start of the mimic's next turn.

traits.name: Faux Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Page Mimicry
traits.desc: The mimic can disguise itself as any small, flat object: a scrap of leather, a plate, and so on — not just a card. It can draw on its skin a map leading to its mother, whatever form it takes.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Face Compression trait.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: A dune mimic can use its action to transform into a Huge object or landscape feature (up to 25 feet by 25 feet in size), or back into its true, amorphous form. Because it can't hide the layer of dust, sand, and gravel covering it, it usually takes the form of a landscape feature or a weathered ruin. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object or Landscape Form Only)
traits.desc: A dune mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the dune mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 15). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The dune mimic can harden its surface so that only creatures of its choice are affected by this trait.

traits.name: Faux Appearance (Object or Landscape Form Only)
traits.desc: While the dune mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object or landscape feature.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.desc: The dune mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dune mimic makes four pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the dune mimic is in object or landscape form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: The dune mimic envelopes every creature it has grappled. An enveloped creature can't breathe, is restrained but no longer grappled, has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the dune mimic, and takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of the dune mimic's turns. When the dune mimic moves, an enveloped creature moves with it. An enveloped creature can try to escape by using an action to make a DC 15 Strength check. On a success, it escapes and lands in a space of its choice within 5 feet of the dune mimic.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The mirager can use its action to transform into a Small or Medium humanoid or back into its true form. Apart from its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mirager's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: charm person
1/day each: hallucinatory terrain, suggestion

traits.name: Alluring Mirage
traits.desc: When the mirager casts hallucinatory terrain, the area seems so lush and inviting that everyone who glimpses it feels an irresistible urge to travel there. Each creature within 120 feet of the location must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is affected by the equivalent of the charm person spell, with the mirager as the caster. It focuses all its attention on the mirage, wants to explore it, marvels at its beauty, and rests there for an hour. The mirager can instead force creatures to focus their attention on it rather than the hallucinatory terrain. A creature affected by the charm automatically fails its saving throw to disbelieve the hallucinatory terrain illusion. This effect ends if the hallucinatory terrain is dispelled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mirager makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Kiss of Thirst
actions.desc: The mirager feeds on the moisture in its prey's body by kissing it. To do so, the prey must be charmed, grappled, or incapacitated. A kiss automatically hits, deals 21 (6d6) necrotic damage, and fills the mirager with a surge of intoxicating euphoria with the same effects as the heroism spell for 1 minute. The kissed creature doesn't notice the damage unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Captivating Dance (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest; Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: The mirager performs a sinuous, sensual dance. Every humanoid within 20 feet that watches the dance must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1d4 rounds and charmed by the mirager for 1 minute. Humanoids have disadvantage on this saving throw regardless of sex or race. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that mirager's dance for 24 hours.

mngwa.name: Mngwa
mngwa.languages: Common, Sylvan, can speak with felines

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The mngwa has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The mngwa has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the mngwa's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the mngwa can long jump up to 25 feet.

traits.name: Feline Empathy
traits.desc: The mngwa has advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made with felines.

traits.name: Ethereal Fur
traits.desc: The mngwa's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier. All attack rolls against it have disadvantage. If the mngwa is adjacent to an area of smoke or mist, it can take the Hide action even while being directly observed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mngwa makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

molosse-nocturne.name: Night Hound
molosse-nocturne.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Bloodhound Scent
traits.desc: A night hound can follow a scent trail despite phase shifts, ethereal travel, dimension doors, and fey steps of any kind. Teleportation and planar shifts, however, exceed its abilities.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The hound's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dimension door

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The hound exhales a 15-foot cone of cold. Creatures caught in the cone take 44 (8d10) cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

momie-venimeuse.name: Venomous Mummy
momie-venimeuse.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Venom of Selket
traits.desc: The venomous mummy's body and wrappings are magically infused with extremely toxic substances. Any creature that comes into physical contact with it (touching it bare-handed, grappling it, biting it, and so on) must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned by Selket's venom. A poisoned target takes 3 (1d6) poison damage every 10 minutes. Selket's venom is a curse, so it persists until removed with remove curse or similar magic.

traits.name: Toxic Smoke
traits.desc: A venomous mummy's poison-infused wrappings and flesh give off toxic smoke when burned. If a venomous mummy takes fire damage, it is surrounded by a cloud of toxic smoke in a 10-foot radius that persists for a full round. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud or enters it for the first time on its turn takes 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Poisoned Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with the curse of Selket's venom (see above).

traits.name: Shadow Swap
traits.desc: While the monolithic champion is in a fey court or castle, it can substitute a shadow double for a target it hits with a greatsword attack. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become invisible, silent, and paralyzed, while an illusory version of it remains visible and audible... and under the champion's control — shouting that a retreat is called for, for example. This power doesn't function outside the fey realms.

traits.name: Fey Flame
traits.desc: The ritual that empowers the monolithic champion grants it an inner flame it can use to augment its weapon or its fists with cold or fire damage, as needed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes two greatsword attacks or two slam attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) cold or fire damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) fire or cold damage.

traits.name: Absorb Dead
traits.desc: When a non-undead creature of Small size or larger dies within 20 feet of a corpse mound, the creature's body joins the mound, which regains 10 hit points.

traits.name: Noxious Aura
traits.desc: Creatures within 20 feet of a corpse mound at the end of its turn must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the noxious aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Zombie Drop
traits.desc: In combat, at the start of the corpse mound's turn, a body breaks free from its mass and falls to the ground. It immediately rises as a zombie under the mound's control. Up to 10 zombies can be active at the same time. The zombies' turn comes immediately after the corpse mound's.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A corpse mound can make two weapon attacks or use Envelop once.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). The target is restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Bone Shard
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. When it is hit, a target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone, pinned to the ground by the shard, and restrained. The target or an adjacent creature can use an action to make a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check; on a success, the shard is removed and the restrained condition ends.

actions.name: Envelop
actions.desc: The corpse mound makes a slam attack against a restrained creature. If the attack hits, the target takes the normal damage but is also pulled 5 feet into the corpse mound's space and enveloped by it, ending any grappled or prone conditions it might have. Once enveloped, the creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the corpse mound, and takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the corpse mound's turns. An enveloped creature can try to escape by using an action to make a DC 17 Strength check. If an enveloped creature deals 30 or more damage to the corpse mound in a single turn, the mound must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or spit the creature out, leaving it prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the corpse mound. If the corpse mound dies, an enveloped creature is no longer restrained and can escape by expending 20 feet of movement, exiting prone. A corpse mound can envelop up to 4 creatures at once.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The morphoi can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immunity to Time Effects
traits.desc: The morphoi is immune to all spells and effects related to time.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The morphoi can use its action to transform into a Medium creature or back into its normal form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Equipment it wears or carries isn't transformed. The morphoi reverts to its normal form if it dies.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., or +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, or 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage if thrown.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

mort-follet.name: Death Wisp
mort-follet.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Flicker
traits.desc: A death wisp constantly flickers, as if blinking, so ranged weapon attacks made against it have disadvantage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: A death wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

traits.name: Shadow Leap
traits.desc: A death wisp can travel between shadows as if using dimension door. This magical transport must begin and end in an area with at least some shadow. A death wisp can leap a total of 40 feet per day, either in a single 40-foot leap or four 10-foot leaps, and so on, as this power is used in 10-foot increments.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A death wisp has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight while in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Unnatural Aura
traits.desc: Animals don't willingly approach within 30 feet of a death wisp unless a master succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check to convince them.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (7d8 + 5) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.desc: A death wisp can target a humanoid within 10 feet of it that died a violent death less than a minute ago. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space its body occupies or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the death wisp's control. The death wisp can't control more than five specters at a time.

traits.name: Luminescence
traits.desc: The chemicals composing a luminescent cave moss make it glow as brightly as a torch. A luminescent cave moss can't end this effect. It can, however, reduce the amount of light it produces to shed only as much light as a candle.

actions.name: Filaments
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the luminescent cave moss can't use its filaments on another target.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc: Living creatures hit by a luminescent cave moss's filament attack, or grappled by it, must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. Creatures that succeed on the saving throw are immune to that particular luminescent cave moss's Strength Drain ability for 24 hours. For each level of exhaustion it inflicts this way, the luminescent cave moss gains 5 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The myling makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). If the target is already grappled by the myling at the start of the myling's turn, the myling's bite attack automatically hits.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Buried Alive
actions.desc: If the myling starts its turn where it wants to be buried, it digs into the ground. If it is grappling a creature, the creature goes down with it. A Medium or larger creature sinks up to its waist, a Small creature up to its neck. If the myling is still grappling its victim at the start of its next turn, it disappears underground with the unfortunate soul. A creature buried this way is considered stunned. It can free itself with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, but it gets only one attempt. On a failure, it can't dig itself out except by magic. It must also make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it takes a deep breath of air and can hold its breath for (Constitution modifier + 1) minutes before it begins to suffocate. On a failure, it begins suffocating immediately. Allies equipped with digging tools can reach the victim in four minutes divided by the number of people digging. A person using an improvised tool (such as a sword, a plate, or bare hands) counts as half a digger.

traits.name: Danger Sense
traits.desc: The wolverine dwarf has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against attacks it can see, as long as it isn't blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The wolverine dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The dwarf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dwarf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the ravager can gain advantage on all its melee weapon attack rolls that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wolverine dwarf makes two melee or ranged attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The dwarf ringmage has advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Ring Magic
traits.desc: The ringmage can imbue a spell with a range of 'self' or 'touch' into a nonmagical ring. To do so, it expends components as if it had cast the spell normally and uses a spell slot one level higher than the spell normally requires. When the ring's bearer activates the ring with an action, the spell is cast as if the ringmage had just cast it. The ringmage doesn't regain the expended spell slot while the spell remains in the ring, unless it chooses to revoke the spell.

traits.name: Ring Staff Focus
traits.desc: The dwarf ringmage can use its ring staff as a focus for spells requiring a ring as a focus, or as a component for its Ring Magic power. If it serves as the focus for ring magic, the spell doesn't require a spell slot one level higher than normal. Once per day, the ringmage can imbue a spell of 4th level or lower into its ring staff by expending a spell slot of a level equal to the imbued spell's level.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The ringmage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): mage hand, shocking grasp, fire bolt, true strike
1st level (4 slots): shield, magic missile, expeditious retreat, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): misty step, web
3rd level (3 slots): fireball, counterspell, fly
4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm
5th level (1 slot): cone of cold

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dwarf ringmage makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Ring Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.desc: The naina senses magic as if constantly under the effect of detect magic.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The naina is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): silent image, dancing lights, mage hand, ray of frost, mending, resistance
1st level (4 slots): witch bolt, charm person, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): invisibility, locate object, darkness
3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, hypnotic pattern
4th level (3 slots): dimension door
5th level (1 slot): dominate person

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The naina can use her action to polymorph into one of her two forms: a drake or a humanoid. She can't change the appearance or abilities of these forms (except for her breath), and damage dealt to one carries over to the other.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The naina makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Drake Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws (Drake Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Drake form only, the naina breathes a cone of poisonous, paralyzing, or sleep gas.

actions.name: Poison
actions.desc: A creature caught in the poison gas takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned. A successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw halves the damage and prevents the poison. While poisoned this way, the creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) poison damage and remains poisoned; on a success, the poison ends.

actions.name: Paralysis
actions.desc: A creature caught in the paralyzing gas must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 2d4 rounds. A paralyzed creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.desc: A creature caught in the sleep gas must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 6 rounds. A sleeping creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The necrophage's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: alter self
1/day each: counterspell, dispel magic, enlarge/reduce, spider climb, tongues
1/week: gate

traits.name: Single Purpose
traits.desc: The necrophage has advantage on attack rolls against worshipers of the fiend it is tasked to destroy, against any creature serving that fiend (whether knowingly or not), and against the fiend itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The masked necrophage makes one khopesh of forgetting attack and one weakening spiked gauntlet attack.

actions.name: Khopesh of Forgetting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or a material thing it loved vanishes from the universe, and the target is the only one who remembers it. The object can be at most the size of a building. It can't be a living being, and it must not be on the target's body or in its line of sight.

actions.name: Weakening Spiked Gauntlets
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion. The target recovers all exhaustion gained from the gauntlets at the end of its next long rest.

actions.name: Wail of the Forgotten (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The masked necrophage utters an ear-piercing wail. Every creature within 30 feet takes 65 (10d12) thunder damage and is permanently deafened unless it succeeds on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw, which halves the damage and limits deafness to 1d4 hours. A target killed by this attack is erased from the memory of all creatures on the planes. Every written or illustrated reference to it disappears, and its body is obliterated. Witnesses to its death are the sole exception. Only a wish or divine intervention can return a creature obliterated this way to life. No mortal remembers its life or its death.

traits.name: Crushing Charge
traits.desc: If the ngobou moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the creature is prone, the ngobou can make a tread attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Bane of Elephants
traits.desc: The ngobou has advantage on attacks against elephants. It can smell whether an elephant passed within 180 feet of its location in the last 48 hours.

traits.name: Spikes
traits.desc: A creature that grapples the ngobou takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (6d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: A nichny ignores difficult terrain and can't be entangled, grappled, or hindered in its movements, as if constantly under the effect of the freedom of movement spell. This power doesn't work against a grapple attempt if the assailant wears gold or orichalcum gauntlets or uses a chain of those metals in the attack.

traits.name: Grant Luck (1/Day)
traits.desc: A nichny can enchant a small gem or pebble so it brings luck. If it gives the charm to someone else, that creature gains a +1 bonus to all saving throws for 24 hours.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The nichny's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, invisibility, magic missile, ray of frost
3/day each: blink, dimension door, haste, polymorph (self only)
1/day each: word of recall, teleport

traits.name: Aura of Luck
traits.desc: A nichny is surrounded by an aura of luck. All creatures it considers friends that are within 10 feet of it gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Creatures it considers enemies suffer a -1 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. The nichny can activate or deactivate this aura on its turn as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The nichny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Foretelling
traits.desc: Once per week, the nichny can answer up to three questions about the past, present, or future. All three must be asked before it gives its answers, which are always short and potentially framed as paradoxes or riddles. One answer is always false, and two are true.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nichny makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

nihileth.name: Nihileth
nihileth.speed: 10 ft., swim 40 ft., fly 40 ft. (hover, ethereal form only)

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If a nihileth is reduced to 0 hit points by damage, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Dual State
traits.desc: A nihileth exists on the Material Plane in two alternate forms, and it can switch between them at will. In its material form, it is resistant to damage dealt by nonmagical weapons, and in its ethereal form, it is immune to that damage. In ethereal form, its silhouette is the same as in material form, but it seems filled with a black-violet mist and edged by a thin dark-violet aura. While in ethereal form, a nihileth can move through the air as if it were in water, with a fly speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Aura of Void
traits.desc: An undead nihileth is surrounded by a chilling aura. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of a nihileth must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be slowed until the start of its next turn. In addition, any creature afflicted with the disease transmitted by a nihileth or a nihilethic zombie takes 7 (2d6) cold damage each time it starts its turn in this aura's area of effect.

traits.name: Infectious Telepathy
traits.desc: If a creature communicates telepathically with a nihileth or uses a psychic attack against it, the nihileth may transmit its disease to that creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be infected with the same disease transmitted by a nihileth's tentacle attack.

traits.name: Void Body
traits.desc: A nihileth can reduce to 0 all damage it takes from a single source. Radiant damage can only be halved.

actions.name: Enslave (3/Day)
actions.desc: A nihileth can target a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the nihileth until the nihileth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the nihileth's control and can't take reactions. The nihileth and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nihileth makes three tentacle attacks or three withering touch attacks, depending on the form it is in.

actions.name: Withering Touch (Ethereal Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Switch Forms
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a nihileth can shift from its material form to its ethereal form and vice versa at will.

actions.name: Tail (Material Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tentacle (Material Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is hit, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute; during that time, it can be cured with lesser restoration or similar magic. After a minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and viscous. The creature can no longer regain hit points unless it is fully immersed in water, and the disease can be cured only by a heal spell or comparable magic. Unless the creature is fully immersed in water or regularly doused with water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes. If a creature dies while afflicted with this disease, it returns 1d6 rounds later as a nihilethic zombie under the nihileth's permanent control.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Swipe
legendaryActions.desc: The nihileth makes one tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.desc: The nihileth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: One creature charmed by the nihileth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the nihileth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The nkosi can use its action to transform into a Medium lion or back into its normal form. In lion form, it can't speak, and its speed is 50 feet. Apart from its speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The nkosi has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Hunter's Maw
traits.desc: If the nkosi moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a scimitar attack on the same turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If it is prone, the nkosi can immediately make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Scimitar (Nkosi Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mambele Throwing Knife (Nkosi Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The nkosi can use its action to transform into a Medium lion or back into its normal form. In lion form, it can't speak, and its speed is 50 feet. Apart from its speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The nkosi has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Brutal
traits.desc: When the pack leader hits its target with a melee weapon attack, it deals one extra damage die (included in the attack).

traits.name: Hunter's Maw
traits.desc: If the nkosi moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a scimitar attack on the same turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If it is prone, the nkosi can immediately make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pack leader makes two attacks with its scimitar or its mambele.

actions.name: Scimitar (Nkosi Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mambele Throwing Knife (Nkosi Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pack Leader's Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Each nkosi of the pack leader's choice within 30 feet of it can immediately use its reaction to make one bite attack. The pack leader can then make one bite attack as a bonus action.

noctegarm.name: Noctegarm
noctegarm.languages: Common, Giant, Goblin, telepathy 200 ft. (facsimiles only)

traits.name: Create Facsimile
traits.desc: If the noctegarm spends a full round devouring a humanoid corpse, it immediately becomes pregnant. Nine hours later, it gives birth to a double of the devoured creature. This double, called a 'facsimile,' has all the original's memories and abilities, but it loyally serves its mother, much as a familiar serves its wizard. A noctegarm can have up to 14 facsimiles under its control at once. It can communicate with them telepathically within 200 feet.

traits.name: Distended Jaw
traits.desc: Like snakes, noctegarms can open their jaws far wider than other creatures of similar size, giving them a formidable bite and letting them swallow creatures of Medium size or smaller.

traits.name: Superstitious
traits.desc: A noctegarm must stay at least 5 feet away from a brandished holy symbol or a burning sprig of wolfsbane, and it can't touch a creature holding such an object or make a melee attack against it. After 1 round, it makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a success, it temporarily overcomes its superstitions, and this trait doesn't apply until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The noctegarm's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: hold person, dissonant whispers, darkness
1/day each: conjure woodland beings (wolves only), dimension door, scrying (facsimiles only)

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, but it has total cover against attacks and effects from outside the noctegarm. It takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the noctegarm's turns. The noctegarm can have only one swallowed creature at a time. If a swallowed creature deals 25 or more damage to it in a single turn, the noctegarm must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the noctegarm. If the noctegarm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by expending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

noctin.name: Noctin
noctin.languages: Common and the languages spoken by the noctin's fext master

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The noctin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pact Wrath
traits.desc: One of the noctin's weapons is imbued with power. Attacks made with it count as magical, and the noctin adds its Charisma bonus to that weapon's damage (included below).

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The noctin is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following warlock spells:
Cantrips (at will): poison spray, chill touch, eldritch blast
1st level (4 slots): armor of Agathys, charm person, hex, hellish rebuke
2nd level (2 slots): crown of madness, misty step

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The noctin makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Pact Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

traits.name: Chilling Howl
traits.desc: On its first turn in combat, the swarm howls as a bonus action, letting out a strange, supernatural, blood-freezing cacophony. All creatures within 300 feet that hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be frightened until the start of the swarm's next turn.

traits.name: Snow Runner
traits.desc: The swarm of wolf spirits is unaffected by difficult terrain caused by snow or ice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A swarm of wolf spirits uses Death Frost if it is available and makes three bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage. The target is knocked prone if the attack is a critical hit.

actions.name: Death Frost (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: All creatures within 5 feet of the swarm take 22 (4d10) cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Those that fail the saving throw also gain one level of exhaustion and are frightened until the start of the swarm's next turn.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening at least 2 inches square. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Eye Extraction
actions.desc: Each creature that shares a space with the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be temporarily blinded as its eyes begin to leave their sockets. This blindness persists while the affected creature shares a space with the swarm and ends at the end of the blinded creature's turn if it has left the swarm's space. A healing spell temporarily ends the blindness, but a restoration spell does not. If a creature already temporarily blinded is targeted by another Eye Extraction and fails its saving throw, it is permanently blinded: its eyes pop from their sockets and join the swarm (dealing 1d8 piercing damage to it). If the target succeeds on either saving throw, it is immune to Eye Extraction for 24 hours (but it doesn't regain its sight while within the swarm). A swarm of eyes with 50 hit points or fewer can't use this power.

actions.name: Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The swarm targets all creatures present in its space with a gaze attack. It chooses one of two effects: confusion or hold person. Each target in the swarm's space is affected unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. Even creatures that avert their eyes or that are blind can be affected by this gaze attack. The confusion or hold person effect lasts 1d4 rounds.

traits.name: Fire Body
traits.desc: If a creature touches the swarm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the first time the swarm enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The swarm sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Water Sensitivity
traits.desc: For every 5 feet the swarm moves in water, or for every 1 gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Swarm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage, or 10 (3d6) fire damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

traits.name: Potent Poison
traits.desc: The poison of a swarm of death butterflies affects tangible undead, even those normally immune to poison.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Weight of Wings
traits.desc: A creature sharing a space with a swarm of death butterflies has its speed halved and must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded. Both effects end if, at the end of its turn, the creature no longer shares a space with the swarm. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the swarm's blindness effect (but not the speed reduction) for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes one bite attack against every creature with which it shares a space.

actions.name: Bites
