actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., all creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 22 (6d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 11 (3d6 + 1) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target also takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1d4 rounds; it takes half as much poison damage and isn't poisoned on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the swarm's blindness effect (but not the speed reduction) for 24 hours.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., all creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target also takes 17 (5d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1d4 rounds; it takes half as much poison damage and isn't poisoned on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny dock prowler. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Clamping Bite
actions.desc: When a creature leaves the space the swarm occupies, 1d3 dock prowlers continue to grapple it (escape DC 10). Each prowler deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage at the start of the creature's turn until it escapes their grasp.

actions.name: Filch
actions.desc: Each round, the swarm of dock prowlers makes 1d6 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks against all creatures present in its space. Each check's DC equals 10 plus the grappled target's Dexterity modifier. For each successful check, a prowler steals a small metal object from a target, which doesn't notice the theft if its passive Perception is lower than the check result.

nuee-de-scarabees-manavores.name: Swarm of Manavore Beetles
nuee-de-scarabees-manavores.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 30 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Magic Immunity
traits.desc: The swarm of manavore beetles is immune to spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Smell Magic
traits.desc: The swarm of manavore beetles detects the presence of magical creatures, active spells and spell effects, and magic items within 120 feet.

traits.name: Mana Erosion
traits.desc: The swarm of manavore beetles devours magic. Unattended magic items in the swarm's space at the end of its turn have their effects suppressed for 1 minute. In addition, charged items in its space lose 1d6 charges at the start of each of the swarm's turns; items with a limited number of daily uses lose one of those uses; and single-use items such as potions or scrolls are destroyed. Magical effects in the swarm's space are dispelled (as with dispel magic cast with a +5 spellcasting ability modifier).

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or a random magic item it carries is immediately subjected to the Mana Erosion trait. If this attack hits a spellcaster, the spellcaster must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or one of its unused spell slots of the lowest level is expended.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny construct. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., up to 4 creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Glittering Carapace
traits.desc: The beetles' iridescent, polished carapaces refract and tint light into a rain of colors. If the swarm is exposed to bright light, a creature that looks at it within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn. If the creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is also unconscious. Unless surprised, a creature can avoid making the saving throw by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn. A creature that averts its eyes can't see the swarm until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the swarm in the meantime, it must immediately make the saving throw. The creature has advantage on the saving throw if the swarm is in dim light, and this trait doesn't function while the swarm is in darkness.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target also takes 10 (4d4) poison damage and becomes euphoric for 1d4 rounds, or it takes half as much poison damage and suffers no euphoria on a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw. A euphoric creature has disadvantage on its saving throws.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny fey. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: When the swarm is in darkness or dim light, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the swarm has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Cold Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 28 (8d6) cold damage, or 14 (4d6) cold damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or it can't regain hit points. An affected target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The effect also ends with greater restoration or similar magic.

traits.name: Strength of Bones
traits.desc: A swarm of bones can choose to deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, and it adds 1.5 times its Strength bonus to its swarm damage rolls, since the broken bone fragments composing it scratch, bite, pierce, and crush against their victims.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: A swarm of bones can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can also move through any opening the width of a human skull. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A swarm of bones can attack every hostile creature with which it shares a space using its swirling bones.

actions.name: Swirling Bones
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the same space as the swarm. Hit: 31 (5d8 + 9) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (includes the Strength of Bones special power).

actions.name: Death Embrace (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the same space as the swarm. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 16) and enveloped in the swarm of bones. While a creature is grappled this way, the swarm can make it move, on the creature's turn or at any other time when the creature shouldn't otherwise be able to move. Any attack that targets the swarm of bones but isn't an area attack has a 50 percent chance of instead striking the creature held grappled at the heart of the death embrace.

traits.name: Bound
traits.desc: An emerald eye can't move more than 25 feet from the creature to which it is psychically bound. At the moment of its creation, it is bound to its creator. Once freed, however, it can bind itself to another creature using its Bind action.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: An emerald eye is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

actions.name: Slash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (5d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Attraction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: An emerald eye can compel a creature to move toward a specific person or object. If the creature fails a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, it feels an overwhelming urge to move toward whatever the emerald eye indicates. The target must be within 25 feet of the emerald eye when the attraction is triggered, but it can afterward leave that initial area of effect freely while remaining under the attraction's control. From the creature's perspective, nothing seems out of the ordinary, and it can't consciously put itself or its allies in danger to reach the designated object. The creature can attempt a new DC 13 Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Bind (3/Day)
actions.desc: The emerald eye can psychically bind itself to a creature with Intelligence 6 or higher. The attempt fails if the target succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. The target isn't aware of being targeted by this effect, whatever the result of its die roll.

actions.name: Telepathic Lash (3/Day)
actions.desc: An emerald eye can project at a humanoid within 25 feet a wave of emotions and impulses that overwhelm it and that it struggles to control. If the target fails a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, it is stunned for 1 round.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the corrupted ogre chieftain can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

traits.name: Mutation
traits.desc:
The corrupted ogre chieftain has one mutation from the list below:
1. Reinforced Skin: The corrupted ogre chieftain's skin is covered in dull, melted scales that give it resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
2. Extra Arm: The corrupted ogre chieftain has a third arm sprouting from its chest. The corrupted ogre chieftain can make three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
3. Scholar: The corrupted ogre chieftain's head is enormous. Its Charisma becomes 16. The corrupted ogre chieftain gains innate spellcasting (psionic) and uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: shield, misty step; 1/day each: dominate monster, levitate
4. Terrifying: The corrupted ogre chieftain's body is covered in horns, eyes, and fang-filled maws. Each creature of the ogre chieftain's choice within 60 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the ogre chieftain's frightening presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The corrupted ogre chieftain makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The firebird's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: guidance, purify food and drink, speak with animals
3/day each: charm person, cure wounds (2d8 + 5), daylight, faerie fire, heat metal, hypnotic pattern, tongues
1/day each: compulsion, heal, reincarnate

traits.name: Light of the World
traits.desc: A firebird's feathers shed warm light. The creature can cast light as dim as a candle or as bright as a lantern. The firebird constantly produces light, and if one of its feathers is plucked, the feather continues to shed light equal to a torch.

traits.name: Warm Presence
traits.desc: A firebird and all creatures within 5 feet of it are immune to the effects of natural cold in their environment. If it is invited into a building, the firebird can extend this warm presence to all the inhabitants of the place, no matter how far from it they are.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firebird makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The shaman has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shaman is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, resistance, thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): inflict wounds, shield of faith, command
2nd level (3 slots): spiritual weapon, hold person

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shaman makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

orobas.name: Orobas
orobas.languages: Celestial, Undercommon, Darakhul, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, Void Speech, telepathy 100 ft.

traits.name: Foreknowledge (3/Day)
traits.desc: An orobas can foresee actions and tilt its luck accordingly. Three times per day, it can choose to have advantage on any attack roll or ability check.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An orobas has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: An orobas's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Sage Counsel
traits.desc: An orobas can sometimes distort the answers of a divination. It dilutes the answer, omits crucial information, makes it convoluted, or simply lies. An orobas always has advantage on its Deception and Persuasion checks when it reveals the results of a divination.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
An orobas's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
Constant: detect evil and good
At will: augury, protection from evil and good, teleport (self plus 55 lbs. of objects only)
5/day each: fireball, bestow curse, scorching ray
3/day each: antimagic field, chain lightning, contact other plane, wall of fire, dimension door
1/day each: evil eye, foresight, find the path

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An orobas makes four attacks: one bite, one claw, one with its flail, and one tread.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must also succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Tread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The ostinato can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: The ostinato is invisible, as with the greater invisibility spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ostinato has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ostinato makes two cacophonic ray attacks.

actions.name: Cacophonic Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Auditory Symbiosis (1/Day)
actions.desc: A humanoid in the ostinato's line of sight within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, or the ostinato fuses with it, becoming a pleasant, repetitive melody in its head. The ostinato can't be targeted by an attack, a spell, or another effect. The target retains control of its body and perceives the ostinato's presence as a melody, not as a living being. It no longer needs to eat or drink, gains the ostinato's magic resistance, and has advantage on its Charisma checks. It has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and can't concentrate on a spell or effect for longer than one turn. It makes a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check every 24 hours. On a success, it understands that the music it hears emanates from an outside entity. The auditory symbiosis persists until the target drops to 0 hit points, the ostinato ends it as a bonus action, or the ostinato is driven out by dispel evil and good or similar magic. When the auditory symbiosis ends, the ostinato bursts out in a sonic explosion and appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. All creatures within 60 feet, including the original target, take 21 (6d6) thunder damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw. The target is immune to that ostinato's auditory symbiosis for 24 hours if it succeeds on the saving throw or once the symbiosis ends.

actions.name: Ravenous Aura (1/Day)
actions.desc: While the ostinato is fused with a humanoid (see Auditory Symbiosis), it feeds on nearby creatures. It can choose up to 9 creatures within 60 feet. Each must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and have its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum drops to 0. A victim notices the damage immediately but doesn't know where it comes from.

ovasis.name: Ovasis
ovasis.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The ovasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Mirage
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the ovasis surrounds itself with a mirage to lure its victims to it, concealing its true nature. This works like the mirage arcana spell (save DC 16), but it isn't magical: it can't be dispelled and can't be detected with detect magic or similar magic.

traits.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
traits.desc: Any creature that drinks the ovasis's water or eats the fruit of nearby plants experiences a dream (as the dream spell, save DC 16) the next time it sleeps. The ooze plants a compulsion in the dream, as a torrent of images and sensations pushing the creature to do something. When the creature wakes, it is affected by the compulsion spell (save DC 16, caster level 7) in addition to the dream's effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ovasis makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The ovasis has two pseudopods, each of which can grapple one creature at a time.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: The ovasis envelopes the creatures it grapples. An enveloped creature can no longer breathe. It is no longer grappled, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the ovasis, takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the ovasis's turns, and is subjected to its Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion. It takes no damage if the ovasis chooses not to harm it. When the ovasis moves, enveloped creatures move with it. An enveloped creature can escape if it uses an action and succeeds on a DC 16 Strength check. On a success, it escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ovasis.

actions.name: Vapors of Tranquility or Torment (Recharges after a Long or Short Rest)
actions.desc: The ovasis sublimates its waters into a vapor filling a disc centered on it, 60 feet in radius and 10 feet thick. All creatures in the area are affected by calm emotions or confusion (save DC 16). The ooze chooses the effect, which must be the same for all creatures.

traits.name: Spellcaster Detection
traits.desc: The arcane parasite automatically and instantly detects creatures using spells or magical abilities within 120 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The arcane parasite has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Explosive Death
traits.desc:
When the arcane parasite dies, it explodes, releasing a magical discharge. Each creature within 10 feet takes 3d8 damage of a type depending on the parasite's color, or half as much on a successful DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. Colors and damage types:
1. Red — fire
2. Orange — acid
3. Yellow — lightning
4. Green — poison
5. Blue — cold
6. Violet — thunder
7. White — radiant
8. Black — necrotic

actions.name: Magic Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+2) piercing damage, and the arcane parasite anchors itself to the target with its proboscis, injecting an anesthetizing saliva that makes its bite entirely painless. If the target is unaware of the parasite's presence, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom check to notice the bite. Once attached, the parasite drains one spell slot of the highest level available from the target each round. The parasite usually detaches after draining 1d4+1 spell slots, or if the target has no spell slots left. It can detach by using 5 feet of its movement. The victim or another creature can also detach the parasite by using an action, but the proboscis deals another 5 (1d4+2) piercing damage when torn away.

traits.name: Faux Appearance
traits.desc: While the swarm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from ordinary stones.

traits.name: Slip and Fall
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the swarm can push a prone creature whose space it occupies 5 feet.

traits.name: Unsteady Ground
traits.desc: When the swarm moves into another creature's space or starts its turn there, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A prone creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw to stand up in a space occupied by the swarm.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny stone. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Darts
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The caustic trap has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Channel Energy Absorption
traits.desc: If a caustic trap is in the area of effect of an attempt to turn undead, it gains temporary hit points. It gains 10 temporary hit points per puppet that would be affected by the turning if it were a zombie, up to 60 hit points.

traits.name: Buried
traits.desc: As long as the caustic trap has done nothing that might reveal its presence, it is considered invisible.

traits.name: Caustic Puppets
traits.desc: A caustic trap can control up to four bodies per tentacle. These 'puppets' look like zombies and move like them. Treat each as a zombie whose movement is limited to an area 30 feet by 30 feet above the buried trap. Unlike zombies, the puppets deal 3 (1d6) acid damage (spraying from the wound) to a creature within 5 feet that deals slashing or piercing damage to them. All the puppets attached to a tentacle are destroyed if the caustic trap attacks with that tentacle. This deals 9 (2d8) acid damage to all creatures within 5 feet of each destroyed puppet, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Damage dealt to the puppets doesn't harm the caustic trap. If the trap is killed, all its puppets die immediately, dealing no acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The caustic trap makes four melee attacks, using any combination of tentacle, spine, and filament attacks. A single creature can't be targeted by more than one filament attack per turn.

actions.name: Spine
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Filaments
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained.

traits.name: Animal Voice
traits.desc: The pombero can magically speak with any beast, and it imitates animal sounds perfectly.

traits.name: Distorted Limbs
traits.desc: The pombero can contort and squeeze through a space only big enough for a Tiny bird as if it were difficult terrain.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The pombero deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a target it hits with a weapon attack if it has advantage on the attack roll, or if the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the pombero that isn't incapacitated and the pombero doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Velvet Steps
traits.desc: The pombero has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in a forest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pombero uses Bewitching Touch if it is available and makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Bewitching Touch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The pombero chooses one creature it can see within 5 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 10 minutes. The effect ends if the charmed creature takes damage. The pombero can have only one creature charmed at a time with this power. If it charms another, the charm on the previous one ends immediately.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The pombero is invisible until it ends the effect as a bonus action or attacks.

traits.name: 360-Degree Vision
traits.desc: The rift boar's extra eyes give it advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Chaos Mutations
traits.desc:
Half of all rift boars have additional mutations. Choose them or roll on the following table.
d6 | Mutation
1 | Acid Blisters. A creature that touches the boar with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) acid damage.
2 | Tentacle Tongue. The boar attacks with its tongue instead of its tusks: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled and restrained as with a tentacle attack (escape DC 14).
3 | Mucus-Covered. The boar's AC increases by 1.
4 | Acidic Saliva. The boar's tusk or tongue attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) acid damage.
5 | Poison Spit. Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d12) poison damage.
6 | Roll twice on this table.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The boar makes one tusk attack and two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tusks
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the boar can't use its tentacles on another target.

traits.name: Hatred of Spellcasters
traits.desc: The white ape deals one extra damage die per attack (a d8 or d10, respectively) against an enemy it saw casting a spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ape makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract arcane degeneration.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frenzy (1/Day)
actions.desc: When two or more adversaries are adjacent to the ape, it enters a deadly battle frenzy. Instead of its normal Multiattack, it makes one bite attack and two claw attacks against each enemy within 5 feet of it. Melee attacks against the white ape have advantage from the end of this turn until the start of the ape's next turn.

profanateur-maudit.name: Cursed Defiler
profanateur-maudit.languages: understands an ancient language but can't speak

traits.name: Cursed Existence
traits.desc: When a cursed defiler is reduced to 0 hit points in desert terrain, its body disintegrates into a heap of sand that is scattered by a sudden dry breeze. However, unless it is killed on hallowed ground, by radiant damage, or by a blessed creature, a cursed defiler reforms at the next sunset 1d100 x 1 mile away in a random direction.

traits.name: Shroud of Sand
traits.desc: A miniature sandstorm constantly swirls around the cursed defiler in a 10-foot radius. This area is lightly obscured for creatures other than cursed defilers. Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track a cursed defiler, or other creatures traveling within the area of its shroud of sand, have disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cursed defiler makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice during the same round (the blows need not come from the same cursed defiler), it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Cutting Sand (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: As an action, the cursed defiler can intensify the sand vortex surrounding it. All creatures within 10 feet of it take 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A deep one can breathe water as easily as air.

traits.name: Mad with Rage
traits.desc: When a deep one takes 10 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on its claw attacks and adds +2 to the damage it deals on its next turn.

traits.name: Dark Depths
traits.desc: A deep one is immune to the effects of the pressure of the ocean depths.

traits.name: Ocean Transformation
traits.desc: A deep one born to a human family appears human at first, but it transforms into an adult deep one between the ages of 16 and 30.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A deep one can breathe water as easily as air.

traits.name: Mad with Rage
traits.desc: When a deep one archimandrite takes 10 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on its attacks on its next turn, adds +4 to the damage it deals, and can make one extra attack with its unholy trident.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A deep one archimandrite's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: bless, sacred flame, shocking grasp, vigor, suggestion
3/day each: shatter, charm person, lightning bolt, sanctuary
1/day each: chain lightning, cone of cold, ice storm

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.desc: If a deep one archimandrite fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Dark Depths
traits.desc: A deep one archimandrite is immune to the effects of the pressure of the ocean depths.

traits.name: Voice of the Archimandrite
traits.desc: The deep one archimandrite can let out a resounding cry to call all deep ones within 1 mile to it. This isn't a spell but an order that creatures of the ocean and deep ones willingly obey.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A deep one archimandrite can make one claw attack and one unholy trident attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Unholy Trident
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A deep one can breathe water as easily as air.

traits.name: Mad with Rage
traits.desc: When a deep one hybrid priest takes 10 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on its melee attacks and adds +4 to the damage it deals with its spells and claws on its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A deep one hybrid priest's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: sacred flame, shocking grasp
3/day each: inflict wounds, sanctuary, sleep
1/day each: shatter, ice storm

traits.name: Dark Depths
traits.desc: A deep one hybrid priest is immune to the effects of the pressure of the ocean depths.

traits.name: Ocean Transformation
traits.desc: A deep one priest born to a human family appears human at first, but it transforms into an adult deep one between the ages of 16 and 30.

traits.name: Voice of the Deep
traits.desc: A deep one priest can captivate an audience by droning in a mellifluous, monotonous voice. Creatures that listen are fascinated for 5 minutes, and the priest can make them forget something they recently saw or attach no importance to it, unless those creatures succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw at the end of that period. On a success, the audience members remember the events the deep one wanted them to forget.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A psoglav's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components:
1/day: greater invisibility

traits.name: Magic Weapon
traits.desc: A psoglav's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shadow Door (4/Day)
traits.desc: A psoglav can travel between shadows as if using the dimension door spell. This magical transport occurs between two areas at least partially lit by dim light. The shadow door lets them cover a maximum distance of 90 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A psoglav demon makes three bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) damage.
Shadow-Stealing Ray (Recharge 5-6). A psoglav can emit a ray from its single eye. A target within 60 feet of the psoglav is automatically hit by this ray. The target is pushed 20 feet backward and must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or also be knocked prone. The target's shadow remains in the space it originally occupied and behaves as an undead shadow under the psoglav demon's control. If the creature hit by the shadow-stealing ray flees the combat, it lacks its natural shadow for 1d12 days, which is the time the undead shadow takes to dissipate and the creature's natural shadow to reappear. If its original creature dies during the encounter, the undead shadow steals its body. In that case, the creature's alignment becomes evil and it comes under the psoglav's control. The creature regains its natural shadow immediately after the undead shadow is killed. A creature can have its shadow stolen by the shadow-stealing ray only once per day, even if it is hit by the rays of two different psoglavs. However, it is pushed backward each time a ray hits it.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Qorgeth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, black tentacles
3/day each: dispel magic, insect plague (ravenous worms), fear
1/day each: teleport, earthquake

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Qorgeth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Burrower
traits.desc: Qorgeth can burrow through solid rock at full speed. He leaves a tunnel 15 feet in diameter in his wake.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Qorgeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Qorgeth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Qorgeth makes one bite attack, two crush attacks, and one stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by Qorgeth. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and it also takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of Qorgeth's turns. There is no limit to the number of creatures Qorgeth can swallow. If a swallowed creature deals 50 or more damage to Qorgeth in a single turn, he must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 10 feet of him. If Qorgeth dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by expending 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Crush
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. The target is also grappled and restrained (escape DC 19) until Qorgeth moves. Qorgeth can grapple up to two creatures at once; at least one of his crush attacks must be directed at the creatures he has grappled.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target takes 33 (6d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour; a successful DC 23 Constitution saving throw halves the poison damage and prevents the poisoned condition. A creature that fails its saving throw by 10 or more is also paralyzed while poisoned.

legendaryActions.name: Shrill Scream
legendaryActions.desc: All creatures in an 60-foot cone that can hear Qorgeth must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Death Roll (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Qorgeth moves up to half his speed and makes one crush attack. Constructions or objects in the spaces he passes through automatically take double crush damage.

legendaryActions.name: Devour (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Qorgeth makes one bite attack.

qwyllion.name: Qwyllion
qwyllion.languages: Common, Goblin, Infernal, Sylvan, Void Speech

traits.name: Disruptor
traits.desc: Because of its sickening nature, the qwyllion imposes disadvantage on spellcasters' concentration checks while they are within 40 feet.

traits.name: Sickening Aura
traits.desc: The qwyllion is sickening to behold, a thing of corruption. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d8 rounds. If a creature already poisoned by this effect fails its save again, it is incapacitated instead. If it fails its save yet again, it drops to 0 hit points. A successful saving throw makes a creature immune to this effect for 24 hours. A creature dominated by the qwyllion is immune to this effect.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The qwyllion's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: shatter, dominate person (range 20 ft.)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The qwyllion uses her Baleful Gaze if it is available and makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Baleful Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The qwyllion fixes her gaze on a single creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d8 + 3) necrotic damage and be incapacitated until the start of the qwyllion's next turn. A humanoid killed by the qwyllion's baleful gaze rises 2d4 hours later as a specter under the qwyllion's control.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ramag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The ratatosk's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or somatic components:
At will: message, animal messenger, vicious mockery
1/day each: commune, mirror image
3/day each: sending, suggestion

traits.name: Frenetic Movement
traits.desc: The ratatosk can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Desperate Lies
traits.desc: A creature that hears the ratatosk must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw when it attacks the ratatosk. On a failure, it continues its attack but must target a different creature. If it has no enemy within reach of the attack, it must choose an ally. If it has no target within reach, it still makes the attack (with ammunition or the spell slot expended as normal), but it automatically misses and has no effect.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed this way, it regards a random ally as an enemy.

actions.name: Divide with Words (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Up to 6 creatures that can hear the ratatosk and are within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. A creature that fails is affected by the equivalent of the confusion spell for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll ravager regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll ravager takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Thick Skin
traits.desc: The troll ravager's skin is thick and resistant, giving it a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is already included in the troll's AC.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll ravager makes three melee attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite, or two with its battleaxe and one with its handaxe, or two ranged attacks with its handaxes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands. If the troll uses its battleaxe two-handed, it can't use its handaxe.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: War Cry (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Up to three allies that can hear the troll ravager and are within 30 feet of it can each make one extra melee attack as a reaction.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ravenala has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The ravenala's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: entangle, sleep
1/day each: heal, wall of thorns

traits.name: Green Walk
traits.desc: The ravenala moves through natural or magical thickets without needing to make an ability check and without spending extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ravenala makes two slam attacks or two pod burst attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pod Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target and creatures within 5 feet of it also take 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Lament of the Enveloped
actions.desc: The ravenala targets one creature within 5 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled and restrained by the ravenala.

reine-de-la-nuit-et-de-la-magie.name: Queen of Night and Magic
reine-de-la-nuit-et-de-la-magie.languages: Celestial, Common, Elvish, Sylvan, Umbral, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Queen of Night and Magic fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shadow-Born
traits.desc: While in light that isn't bright, the Queen of Night and Magic has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, and she can hide even while being observed.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Queen of Night and Magic is an 18th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). She knows the following sorcerer spells:
Cantrips (at will): blade ward, chill touch, dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): mage armor, magic missile, shield
2nd level (3 slots): darkness, mirror image
3rd level (3 slots): blink, fear
4th level (3 slots): confusion, greater invisibility
5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, teleportation circle
6th level (1 slot): circle of death
7th level (1 slot): plane shift, prismatic spray
8th level (1 slot): dominate monster
9th level (1 slot): meteor swarm

traits.name: Sudden Unraveling
traits.desc: When the Queen of Night and Magic is targeted by a spell or is in a spell's area of effect, she can use her Unravel power against it. The Queen doesn't need to see a spell to target it with this reaction, but she must see at least a portion of the area or the object affected by the spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic makes three attacks with her rapier or with Star Strike.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Shadow Rift (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic creates a shadow rift in a sphere 20 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within 150 feet. All creatures caught in the rift take 72 (16d8) cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 23 Constitution saving throw. Creatures that fail their saving throw are also restrained by tendrils of frozen shadow. A restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the restrained condition on a success.

actions.name: Star Strike
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

actions.name: Unravel
actions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic targets a creature, an object, or a magical effect she can see. For each spell affecting the target, the Queen makes a Charisma check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell's level. On a success, that spell is dispelled.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic casts a cantrip.

legendaryActions.name: Swirling Stars
legendaryActions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic makes one Star Strike attack. Even if one of the Queen's opponents is within 5 feet of her, she doesn't have disadvantage on this attack.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic uses her Teleport power.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Queen of Night and Magic casts a spell.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Snow Queen's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: fog cloud, magic missile, ray of frost
3/day each: chill metal (as heat metal, but it deals cold damage), ice sphere
1/day: cone of cold

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Snow Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The Snow Queen's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 7 (2d6) cold damage (included below).

traits.name: Winter Walk
traits.desc: The Snow Queen ignores difficult terrain caused by ice or snow. She can walk on vertical and horizontal surfaces covered with snow or ice.

traits.name: Frozen Shards
traits.desc: When the Snow Queen is hit by a melee attack, she can strike her attacker with the ice shards of her crown. The attacker takes 11 (2d10) piercing damage and 11 (2d10) cold damage, which it avoids on a successful DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Snow Queen makes two attacks, in any combination of her claws and her ice crown.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Crown
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Sudden Cold (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The Snow Queen drastically drops the temperature around her. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion. Immunity to cold extends to this sudden cold power.

legendaryActions.name: Ice Crown
legendaryActions.desc: The Snow Queen makes one ice crown attack.

legendaryActions.name: Snow Blindness
legendaryActions.desc: The Snow Queen designates a target she can see within 100 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be blinded by swirling snow until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Mantle of Snowfall (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Snow Queen throws her mantle of snow toward a point she can see within 60 feet. The area within 30 feet of that point is instantly covered in a thick layer of snow. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The area becomes difficult terrain, where each foot traveled costs 2 feet of movement. The terrain remains difficult until the end of the Snow Queen's next turn, at which point her mantle returns to her shoulders.

reine-des-sorcieres.name: Witch Queen
reine-des-sorcieres.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Sylvan, Umbral

traits.name: Weave Absorption
traits.desc: When the Witch Queen counters or dispels a spell, she is healed a number of hit points equal to twice the spell's level.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Witch Queen's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +12 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: faerie fire, hex, misty step, silent image, tongues
3/day each: chain lightning, counterspell, dispel magic, hypnotic pattern, teleportation circle
2/day each: bestow curse, feeblemind, mass suggestion, flesh to stone
1/day each: power word kill, sleep (9th level), shapechange

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Witch Queen has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Witch Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Token of Favor
traits.desc: As an action, the Witch Queen can cut a lock of her copper hair, knot it, and give it to a creature of her choice. While that creature wears this token of favor, it gains the Magic Resistance trait (see above). The Witch Queen can revoke her favor at any time as a bonus action. When that happens, the creature loses the token's benefit, and, if the Witch Queen wishes, the creature even has disadvantage on its saving throws against spells and magical effects for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Witch Queen makes two attacks, or makes one attack and casts a spell.

actions.name: Lunar Silver Ring
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. The lunar silver ring is a magic weapon.

actions.name: Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) force damage. A creature hit by a blast must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the Witch Queen.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The Witch Queen makes one attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Witch Queen casts a spell.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: The Witch Queen magically teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 40 feet.

traits.name: Vermin Control
traits.desc: Spawn of Akyishigal can give orders to Tiny beasts with Intelligence 2 or less within 30 feet that aren't magically controlled. The vermin obey the spawn's orders to the best of their ability without regard for their own safety.

traits.name: Swarm Spitting (Recharge 5-6)
traits.desc: A spawn can spit out a swarm of insects. This swarm is entirely under its control. It persists for one minute or until it is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A spawn makes one bite attack and two stinger attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d6 rounds.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.desc: Spawn of Arbeyach and all other members of their hive share a bond that grants heightened awareness. Thus, while a spawn is within 60 feet of at least one of its hive-mates, it has advantage on its initiative rolls and its Wisdom (Perception) checks. If a spawn becomes aware of danger, all other members of the hive are aware of it too. At the start of an encounter, none of the spawn sharing a hive mind can be surprised unless all members of the hive are.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A spawn of Arbeyach's spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
1/day: conjure animals (insect swarms only)

traits.name: Scent Communication
traits.desc: A spawn of Arbeyach can communicate with its kin and with any insect swarms within 60 feet by transmitting pheromones. Within a hive, this range extends to the entire hive. It is a silent, instantaneous mode of communication that only Arbeyach, his spawn, and insect swarms can understand. As a bonus action, a spawn of Arbeyach can use this trait to take control of and direct an insect swarm within 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A spawn of Arbeyach makes one bite attack and two stinger attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the dock prowler can't use its bite on another target. While the target is grappled, the prowler's bite attack automatically hits.

actions.name: Filch
actions.desc: A dock prowler that has an adversary grappled at the start of its turn can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as a bonus action. The check's DC equals 10 plus the grappled target's Dexterity modifier. If the prowler succeeds, it steals a small metal object from the target, which doesn't notice if its passive Perception is lower than the check result. The prowler flees with its treasure.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: A mossy stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in wooded or swampy terrain.

traits.name: Love of Heavy Weapons
traits.desc: Most mossy stalkers use heavy weapons but have disadvantage when wielding them.

traits.name: Keen Smell and Hearing
traits.desc: The mossy stalker has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Poisoned Gift
traits.desc: A mossy stalker can poison food or liquids. A creature consuming a contaminated substance must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. When the stalker applies the poison, it can choose one that renders the victim unconscious or paralyzed while poisoned. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Greatsword or Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing or bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mushroom-Poison Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) poison damage. The target is poisoned until the start of the stalker's next turn. A DC 11 Constitution saving throw halves the poison damage and prevents the poison.

actions.name: Falling Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100 ft. (vertically), one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

roi-baigne-de-lune.name: Moon-Bathed King
roi-baigne-de-lune.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Umbral, telepathy 100 ft.

traits.name: Control Moonbeams
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the Moon-Bathed King can cause all moonlit areas within 100 feet to shift up to 10 feet.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Moon-Bathed King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: continual flame, detect evil and good, invisibility (self only), moonbeam, zone of truth
3/day each: blight, dispel evil and good, dispel magic
1/day each: demiplane, heal

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Moon-Bathed King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The Moon-Bathed King's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 7 (2d6) radiant damage (included below).

traits.name: Slip into Shadow
traits.desc: When targeted by an attacker he can see, the Moon-Bathed King takes on the substance of his manifest illusions. He becomes almost insubstantial, so the attack is made against him with disadvantage. If the attack still hits, the Moon-Bathed King takes only half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Moon-Bathed King makes three attacks with his crystal staff or moon flash.

actions.name: Crystal Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage. If a target is struck by the staff twice or more in a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Moon Flash
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that isn't in its natural form, it takes an extra 22 (4d10) radiant damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or revert to its natural form. When the moon flash strikes a target, the point of impact glows with moonlight and sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. This light is fixed and persists until the end of the Moon-Bathed King's next turn.

actions.name: Fearful Shadows (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The Moon-Bathed King magically animates the shadows of all his enemies within 60 feet of him. The animated shadows attack the creatures casting them. All affected creatures in the area take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. If a creature fails its saving throw, it also loses 1d4 points of Strength. A creature reduced to Strength 0 falls unconscious until it regains at least 1 point of Strength. A creature that lost Strength to an encounter with the fearful shadows recovers it at the end of a short or long rest.

actions.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
actions.desc: The Moon-Bathed King can summon a moon devil. The summoned devil appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner. It acts as its summoner's ally and can't summon other devils. It remains for 10 minutes, until its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

legendaryActions.name: Staff
legendaryActions.desc: The Moon-Bathed King makes one attack with his crystal staff.

legendaryActions.name: Walk on Light
legendaryActions.desc: The Moon-Bathed King teleports from one moonlit area to another within 100 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Aura of Madness (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: While standing in an area lit by moonlight, the Moon-Bathed King can transmit his madness to other creatures within 30 feet. A creature that isn't a fiend and that starts its turn in the aura's area of effect or enters it for the first time on its turn (including when the aura is activated) must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma check or be confused (as if affected by the confusion spell) until the start of its next turn. This aura persists until the start of the Moon-Bathed King's next turn.

traits.name: Alternate Form
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the Bear King can take the form of a shaggy grizzly bear or a hybrid form between human and bear. In his alternate form, the Bear King becomes Large and can make bite and claw attacks. He keeps this form until he resumes human form as a bonus action, loses consciousness, or dies.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The Bear King has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Bear King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration (Alternate Form Only)
traits.desc: The Bear King regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Bear King makes two ranged attacks or two melee attacks. In hybrid or grizzly form, he can also make one extra bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Hybrid or Grizzly Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't a construct or undead, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or lose 10 (3d6) hit points from bleeding caused by the wound. Each time the Bear King succeeds in biting the wounded creature again, it loses an additional 10 (3d6) hit points per turn. As an action, a creature can end the bleeding it or an adjacent ally suffers from with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The bleeding also stops if the creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid or Grizzly Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Maul (Hybrid or Human Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by two maul attacks in the same turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Javelin (Human Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Melee Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The Bear King makes one claw or maul attack.

legendaryActions.name: Honey Throw
legendaryActions.desc: The Bear King dips his hand in the honey pot at his belt and hurls a handful of honey at a target within 30 feet. This is a ranged attack (+9 to hit). If the attack hits, the creature is restrained (escape DC 17).

legendaryActions.name: Terrifying Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Bear King lets out a blood-curdling roar. All creatures within 90 feet that can hear him must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw or that has the effect end for it is immune to the terrifying roar for 24 hours. The Bear King's allies are unaffected.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The rat king has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Plague of Ill Omen
traits.desc: The rat king emits a magical aura of misfortune in a 30-foot radius. An enemy of the rat king that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be ill-omened until the start of its next turn. When a cursed character makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, it must subtract 1d4 from the result.

traits.name: Absorption
traits.desc: When the rat king deals damage to a rat or a swarm of rats, it can absorb the rat or part of the swarm into its mass. It regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt to the rat or swarm.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rat king makes four bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A bitten creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. A diseased creature immediately gains one level of exhaustion. It repeats the save whenever it finishes a long rest. On a failure, it gains another level of exhaustion; on a success, the disease doesn't progress. The creature recovers from the disease if it succeeds on its saving throws for two consecutive long rests or if it benefits from lesser restoration or similar magic. From that point on, it recovers one level of exhaustion each time it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Summon Swarm (1/Day)
actions.desc: The rat king summons three swarms of rats. They appear immediately within 60 feet of him, possibly in a space occupied by another creature. The swarms act as allies of the rat king. They remain for an hour or until he dies.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The River King can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The River King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The River King can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: create or destroy water, shocking grasp, water breathing
3/day each: freedom of movement, control water
1/day: chain lightning

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the River King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The River King's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 10 (3d6) lightning damage (included below).

traits.name: Blade of the Wave
traits.desc: When a creature within the River King's reach stands up after being knocked prone, the River King can make one attack with his longsword with advantage against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The River King makes three attacks with his longsword and/or explosive flood, combined as he wishes.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Explosive Flood
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage. A creature targeted by this spell must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pushed 60 feet in a direction chosen by the River King.

actions.name: Grasping Whirlpool (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The River King creates a vortex of churning water centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The vortex takes the form of a cylinder 10 feet in radius and 15 feet tall. Creatures in the affected area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage, be restrained, and be unable to breathe. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is pushed to the edge of the affected area. A restrained creature can free itself from the whirlpool if it uses an action and succeeds on a DC 16 Strength check. If a creature ends its turn in the whirlpool, it takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage in addition to the effects of its suffocation. Creatures with a swim speed have advantage on their Strength saving throws to escape. The whirlpool persists for 1 minute or until the River King uses this power again.

legendaryActions.name: Longsword
legendaryActions.desc: The River King makes one attack with his longsword.

legendaryActions.name: Flow
legendaryActions.desc: The River King moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Shimmer (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The River King shimmers like the sun on the water's surface. Until the start of his next turn, all attacks made against him have disadvantage.

traits.name: Withering Tresses
traits.desc: If the rusalka stays out of the water for 24 consecutive hours, her hair and body wither into drooping marsh herbs, and the creature is completely destroyed.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The rusalka's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: control water, tongues, water walk (she can end it at will for free), suggestion
1/day: dominate person

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.desc: While in darkness or dim light, the rusalka is invisible underwater.

actions.name: Breath-Stealing Kiss
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 13), and the rusalka drains the air from its lungs with a kiss. If the rusalka hasn't used all her movement, she drags the grappled creature underwater, where it begins to suffocate.

actions.name: Drowning Hair (1/Day)
actions.desc: The rusalka's long hair tangles around a creature she has grappled. The creature takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. In addition, until it escapes the rusalka's grapple, it is restrained, and it has disadvantage on Strength checks made to escape the grapple.

traits.name: Counting Compulsion
traits.desc: If, as an action, a creature points out a group of like objects to a rübezahl, the demon is compelled to count all the objects in the group. Until the end of its next turn, the rübezahl has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it can't take reactions. Once it has counted a given group of objects, it can't be compelled to count those objects again.

traits.name: Forked Tongue
traits.desc: A rübezahl has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks, and magical attempts to see through its lies always indicate it is telling the truth.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A rübezahl's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self (humanoid forms only), fog cloud
3/day each: call lightning, gust of wind, lightning bolt
1/day: control weather

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: A rübezahl deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage to a target it hits with a weapon attack if it has advantage on the attack roll, or if the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the rübezahl that isn't incapacitated and the rübezahl doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A rübezahl makes one gore attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A rübezahl can cause a crackling bolt of lightning to appear in the sky — or in the air, if it is underground or indoors — and direct it to strike a point the rübezahl can see within 150 feet. All creatures within 20 feet of the point of impact take 36 (8d8) lightning damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails its saving throw is stunned until the start of the rübezahl's next turn.

saccageur-releve.name: Risen Ravager
saccageur-releve.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Lifesense
traits.desc: The risen ravager automatically detects all living creatures within 120 feet. This power is blocked by 3 feet of wood, 1 foot of dirt or stone, 1 inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

traits.name: Aggressive Leap
traits.desc: When the risen ravager hits an enemy with a blade attack after moving at least 20 feet, its target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone, and the ravager can use a bonus action to make a single blade attack against it.

traits.name: Fused Arsenal
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the ravager can absorb an unattended weapon into its body. Each time it absorbs one, its blade attack deals +1 damage (maximum +3).

traits.name: Frenetic Movement
traits.desc: The risen ravager can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The risen ravager makes three blade attacks.

actions.name: Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: A sarcopter's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The sarcopter has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

traits.name: Crawling Death
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a sarcopter must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The sarcopter regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes radiant or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. A sarcopter dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sarcopter makes two attacks with its bone stinger or two attacks with its gaze of turmoil.

actions.name: Bone Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If both attacks hit a single creature in the same turn, that creature is grappled (escape DC 10). As a bonus action, the sarcopter can choose whether this attack deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

actions.name: Gaze of Turmoil
actions.desc: The sarcopter can target one creature within 120 feet that can see it. The target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is paralyzed for 1d4 rounds unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, in which case it takes half damage and isn't paralyzed. The gaze of turmoil can't be used twice against the same creature in the same turn.

actions.name: Slash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target takes an extra 27 (5d10) slashing damage and must make a DC 12 Constitution check. On a failure, the sarcopter severs and absorbs one of the target's limbs (determined randomly) and heals hit points equal to the slashing damage it dealt.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the willow remains motionless and isn't in bloom, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary tree.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A strangling willow makes as many attacks as there are targets within 15 feet of it. Each creature can be targeted only once per round, either by a strangulation (a branch) or a pin (a root).

actions.name: Pin
