actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Strangle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). A grappled creature can no longer breathe and takes 9 (1d8+5) bludgeoning damage at the start of its turn unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On its turn, the willow can target an already-grappled creature with a new strangle attack; each successful attack adds another escape check before breaking free. However, the start-of-turn damage doesn't stack — a single saving throw suffices no matter how many branches hold the creature.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The scheznyki's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, darkness, detect evil and good, faerie fire, invisibility, fly, mage hand, ray of frost (only while wearing a volatilizer hat)
5/day each: magic missile, ray of enfeeblement, silent image
3/day each: locate object (within 3,000 feet, to find a volatilizer hat), tasha's hideous laughter, web
1/day each: dispel magic, dominate person, hold person

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scheznyki has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scheznyki makes four war spike attacks or two hand crossbow attacks.

actions.name: War Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its pincers and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two pincers, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target also takes 7 (2d6) poison damage and is blinded for 1d3 hours. On a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw, the poison damage is halved and it isn't blinded. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for as long as it remains poisoned. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its pincers and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until it finishes a long or short rest. A DC 10 Constitution saving throw halves the poison damage and prevents the poison. If the target fails its saving throw while already poisoned, it gains one level of exhaustion in addition.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The bandit lord has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bandit lord's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Parry
traits.desc: The bandit lord adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Redirect Attack
traits.desc: When a creature the bandit lord can see targets him with an attack, the lord chooses an ally within 5 feet of him. They swap positions, and the chosen ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bandit lord makes three melee or ranged attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Commander (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: For one minute, the bandit lord can utter a special command or warning to a nonhostile creature that can see and hear him within 30 feet whenever that creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature adds a d4 to its roll if it can hear and understand the bandit lord. A creature can benefit from only one Commander die at a time. This effect ends if the bandit lord is incapacitated.

traits.name: Green Walker
traits.desc: The vine lord ignores movement restrictions and damage caused by natural undergrowth.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vine lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vine lord regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and is in its native forest or jungle.

traits.name: Root Spirit
traits.desc: In its native forest or jungle, the vine lord has blindsight out to 60 feet, succeeds on all Wisdom (Perception) checks, and can't be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vine lord makes two claw attacks and four filament attacks. A single creature can't be targeted by more than one filament attack per turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Filament
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Awaken Verdure (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vine lord magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma 1, can't speak, and their only action option is Slam. An animated tree acts as an ally of the vine lord. The tree remains animated for one day, until it dies, until the vine lord dies or moves more than 120 feet away from it, or until the vine lord uses a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree takes root again if possible.

actions.name: Spore Sacks (1/Week)
actions.desc: The vine lord can release seeds held in special sacs on its vines. They germinate into 1d4 green spore pods that mature in 3 days. A pod contains toxic spores that it releases when someone steps on it, picks it up, or interferes with it. If a humanoid or beast inhales these spores, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against disease or vines begin to grow inside its body. If the disease isn't cured within three months, they invade its entire nervous system and transform the victim into a vine puppet.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The selang's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, minor illusion
3/day each: alter self, fear, sleep, suggestion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The selang makes two dagger attacks or two shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus soporific poison.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus soporific poison.

actions.name: Soporific Poison
actions.desc: A wounded creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 2d6 rounds. A creature poisoned this way is unconscious. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it.

actions.name: Alien Melody
actions.desc: The selang can wound its enemies and sow confusion in their ranks by playing curious, ear-splitting melodies on its bagpipe made of dorreq beaks, cartilage, and throat sacs. When it plays a tune on this instrument, all creatures within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by contagion, confusion, irresistible dance, or tasha's hideous laughter, depending on which melody the dark satyr chooses to play. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against this psychic effect is immune to the melodies for 24 hours. The selang can use each of these spell effects once per day.

shabti.name: Shabti
shabti.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The shabti is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The shabti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The shabti's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Serpent Bracelets
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the shabti orders its bracelets to fall to the ground, where they transform into two giant poisonous snakes. It can direct them mentally without expending an action. If the snakes are killed, they dissolve into wisps of smoke that coil around the shabti's arms and reform the bracelets, but they must wait a week before they can transform into snakes again. These bracelets are bound to the shabti at its creation and don't function for other creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shabti uses Telekinesis and makes two attacks with its nabboot.

actions.name: Nabboot
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the curse called tomb taint. The target's speed is then halved, and its hit point maximum decreases by 3 (1d6) for every 24 hours that pass. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, it dies and its body crumbles to dust. The curse persists until someone removes it with remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Telekinesis
actions.desc: The shabti targets a creature within 60 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Strength check or the shabti moves it up to 30 feet in a direction of its choice (including upward), and the creature is restrained until the end of the shabti's next turn.

shadhavar.name: Shadhavar
shadhavar.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The shadhavar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self (horse or unicorn form only)
2/day: darkness (centered on itself, moves with it)

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The shadhavar's gore attack is magical.

traits.name: Plaintive Melody (3/Day)
traits.desc: The shadhavar can use a bonus action to play a captivating melody through its hollow horn. All creatures within 60 feet that hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the shadhavar's next turn. A creature charmed this way is incapacitated, its speed is reduced to 0, and the shadhavar has advantage on attack rolls against it.

traits.name: See in Darkness
traits.desc: The shadhavar's darkvision functions in magical darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadhavar makes one gore attack and one hooves attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Anaerobic
traits.desc: The shoggoth needs no oxygen to live. It thrives as easily at the bottom of the ocean as in the void of space.

traits.name: Flesh Absorption
traits.desc: The body of a creature that dies while grappled by a shoggoth is fully absorbed into its mass. Nothing usable remains for raise dead, reincarnate, and comparable spells that require contact with the deceased's body.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: A shoggoth can move through any space wider than 1 foot. It must spend 1 extra foot of movement for every foot it moves through a space smaller than itself, but it suffers no other penalty for squeezing.

traits.name: Hideous Melody
traits.desc: The shoggoth emits a piping sound with a melody so strange it destroys the mind. A creature that hears this cacophony at the start of its turn and is within 120 feet of the shoggoth must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be confused (as with the confusion spell) for 1d4 rounds. A creature that rolls a natural 20 on this saving throw is immune to the hideous melody for 24 hours. Otherwise, affected creatures must repeat the saving throw every round.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: The shoggoth has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Surging Charge
traits.desc: If the shoggoth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. If it is prone, the shoggoth immediately moves into its space as a bonus action and crushes the creature under its bulk. The crushed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the shoggoth's turns. It stays in its space and doesn't move with the shoggoth. A crushed creature can escape if it uses an action and succeeds on a DC 19 Strength check. On a success, it crawls to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the shoggoth.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shoggoth makes 1d4 + 1 slam attacks. Reroll the die to determine the number of the shoggoth's attacks at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained. The shoggoth can grapple as many creatures as it wishes at the same time, and this has no effect on the number of attacks available to it.

silhouette-de-sable.name: Sand Silhouette
silhouette-de-sable.languages: the languages she knew in life

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: When the sand silhouette is in a desert environment, it can take the Hide action even while being directly observed.

traits.name: Sand Form
traits.desc: The sand silhouette can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sand Glide
traits.desc: The sand silhouette can burrow through nonmagical loose sand without disturbing the material it moves through. While burrowing this way, it is invisible.

traits.name: Water Vulnerability
traits.desc: The sand silhouette takes 2 (1d4) cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in contact with water, or for every 1 gallon of water poured on it. If it is fully immersed in water, it takes 10 (4d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand silhouette makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the victim is grappled (escape DC 14), and the sand silhouette can envelop it.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: The sand silhouette envelops a Medium or smaller creature it has grappled. The enveloped target is blinded and restrained, but no longer grappled. It must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the sand silhouette's turns or take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the sand silhouette moves, the enveloped target moves with it. The sand silhouette can envelop only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Haunted Haboob (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The sand silhouette transforms into a 60-foot-radius cloud of sandy dust swarming with terrifying shapes. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must choose whether to close its eyes — becoming blinded until the start of its next turn — or keep them open, in which case it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

sorcelueur.name: Witchlight
sorcelueur.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Weakness to Dispel Magic
traits.desc: A dispel magic spell cast on the witchlight paralyzes it for 1d10 rounds.

traits.name: Luminance
traits.desc: A witchlight usually glows like a torch. It can dim its brightness to that of a candle but can't extinguish it. Because of this light, it has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Thin as Light
traits.desc: Although the witchlight isn't incorporeal, it can pass through any opening that lets light through.

actions.name: Light Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) radiant damage.

actions.name: Flash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The witchlight emits a blast of blinding light that blinds all creatures that can see it within 30 feet for 1d4 rounds unless they succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Alter Fate (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the witch of the skein fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead and transfer the failed effect to an enemy within 30 feet. She experiences the effects of the successful save, if any. The chosen enemy is entitled to a saving throw as if it were the initial target of the effect, but with disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The witch of the skein has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Misty Step (At Will)
traits.desc: The witch of the skein can step from one spot to another as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sealed Fate (1/Day)
traits.desc: The witch of the skein attunes herself to the PCs' threads of destiny. Ask each player to write down a prediction about how the PC to their left will die and at what level. Collect the notes without revealing their contents. When a PC dies, read the prediction concerning them. If they died in the manner foretold, they fulfilled their destiny, and the gods resurrect them immediately as a reward. If they died at the foretold level, or within one level of it, they return to life with some important information about the fate of someone important.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The witch of the skein makes two inexorable thread attacks.

actions.name: Inexorable Thread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) radiant damage, and the target 'steps one pace closer to death.' If the target drops to 0 hit points, it is considered to have already failed one death saving throw. The effect is cumulative; each successful inexorable thread attack adds one failed saving throw. This effect persists until the character finishes a long rest. If a character hit three or more times by the inexorable thread drops to 0 hit points, it dies instantly.

actions.name: Bind Fates (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the witch of the skein must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, its fate is tied to that of one of its allies, chosen at random. Damage and conditions inflicted on the target are instead inflicted on that ally, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. The effect persists until one of the bound creatures gains a level or until it is dispelled with a heal spell or heroes' feast.

actions.name: Fate-Distortion Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The witch of the skein projects a 60-foot cone of distortion that unravels the weave of fate. Creatures caught in this cone take 55 (10d10) force damage, or half as much on a successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. In addition, if more than one target that failed its saving throw is under an effect, those effects are redistributed at random among the targets that failed their saving throws.

traits.name: Unfathomable
traits.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as to divination spells it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern the gypsosphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Mystic Vision
traits.desc: The gypsosphinx sees death coming and can predict how someone will die. This power comes with no desire whatsoever to share that information. It is known to allude to a creature's death, to needle it on the subject, or even to lie ('If we fight, I will kill you and eat your heart: I have seen it' is one of its favorite bluffs).

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The sphinx is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast spells without material components. It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): mage hand, mending, minor illusion, poison spray
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, detect magic, identify
2nd level (3 slots): blur, darkness, locate object
3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, glyph of warding, major image
4th level (3 slots): blight, greater invisibility
5th level (1 slot): cloudkill

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rake
actions.desc: If the sphinx hits with both claw attacks, it automatically follows up with a rake attack. If the target fails a DC 17 Dexterity check, it is knocked prone and takes 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Bite Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The sphinx makes one bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as usual.

traits.name: Trained
traits.desc: A spinosaurus never willingly attacks a reptilian humanoid, and if it is forced or magically compelled to do so, it has disadvantage on its attack rolls. The spinosaurus can be ridden by up to twelve Medium creatures or four Large creatures at the same time. The spinosaurus loses this trait if it spends a full month away from any reptilian humanoid.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The spinosaurus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spinosaurus makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). When the spinosaurus moves, the grappled creature moves with it. While grappled, the target is restrained, and the spinosaurus can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the spinosaurus's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a creature succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the spinosaurus's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The spinosaurus moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Roar
legendaryActions.desc: The spinosaurus uses Frightful Presence.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The spinosaurus makes one tail attack.

traits.name: Trained
traits.desc: A spinosaurus never willingly attacks a reptilian humanoid, and if it is forced or magically compelled to do so, it has disadvantage on its attack rolls. The spinosaurus can be ridden by up to three Medium creatures or one Large creature at the same time. The spinosaurus loses this trait if it spends a full month away from any reptilian humanoid.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spinosaurus makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the spinosaurus can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vine troll skeleton regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it is within 10 feet of the duskthorn dryad's vines and it has taken no acid or fire damage since its previous turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate, if the duskthorn dryad that created it dies, or if someone destroys its heart in the dryad's or the treant's tree.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

squelette-en-machoires-de-requin.name: Shark-Jawed Skeleton
squelette-en-machoires-de-requin.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). While this grapple persists, the shark-jawed skeleton can bite only the creature it is grappling, and it has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Mountain Stride
traits.desc: Mountain slopes and rocky escarpments don't slow the stuhac. In mountains, it passes through difficult terrain with ease.

traits.name: Powerful Leap
traits.desc: The stuhac leaps three times as far as normal: 75 feet horizontally and 30 feet vertically with a running start, or half that from a standing start.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The stuhac can use its action to take one of two forms: that of an aged male humanoid, or its natural form. It can't change the appearance or abilities of these forms, and damage dealt to one carries over to the other.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stuhac makes two claw attacks and one bite attack, or two claw attacks and one laming attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (5d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Laming
actions.desc: The stuhac can cripple a creature by telekinetically tearing its tendons and ligaments. It can target a creature within 100 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) force damage and have its speed reduced by 20 feet. Magical movement (such as flight, teleportation, and so on) is unaffected. This damage heals only by magic, not by spending hit dice or resting.

suffragan-coeur-de-vers.name: Suffragan Wormheart
suffragan-coeur-de-vers.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The suffragan wormheart's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, command
4/day: inflict wounds
2/day each: blindness/deafness, hold person
1/day each: animate dead, speak with dead

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The suffragan wormheart can make two helminth infestation attacks, or cast a spell and make one helminth infestation attack.

actions.name: Helminth Infestation
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with a helminth infestation (parasitic worms). An afflicted creature can no longer regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that pass. If the infestation reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, it dies. The infestation persists until it is removed by any magic that cures disease.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: In forests, the stitcher has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Blasphemy Detection
traits.desc: The most common variety of stitcher attacks creatures that blaspheme aloud. They detect blasphemies within 100 feet unless the utterer succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw.

actions.name: Sew
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the stitcher sews the target's mouth, eyes, or nose shut. It pierces its victim's skin at supernatural speed, threading a filament made of the victim's own skin through each hole. The filaments quickly blacken, tighten, and close the sewn orifice. It takes two actions and a sharp blade to cut the filaments and reopen the orifice. The process is extremely painful and deals 2 slashing damage. A victim whose mouth and nose are sewn shut begins to suffocate at the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Tree Speech
traits.desc: A weeping treant can converse with plants, and most plants are friendly or helpful toward it.

traits.name: Acid Tears
traits.desc: Thick tears of dark sap constantly stream down the treant's face and trunk. They are highly acidic: anyone who attacks the treant while standing 5 feet or less from it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (1d2) acid damage from the splashing tears. The acidic sap continues to deal 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of that creature's turn until it or an adjacent ally uses an action to wipe away the tears, or until three rounds have passed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treant makes three slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Zone of Control
traits.desc: The mechaforged templar can make an opportunity attack when a creature enters its reach.

traits.name: Assault
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the mechaforged templar can make a shove attack.

traits.name: Parry
traits.desc: The mechaforged templar increases its AC by 3 against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mechaforged templar makes three attacks with its cutlass.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mechaforged templar whirls its cutlass around itself. All creatures within 10 feet take 16 (3d10) slashing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Rock Explosion
traits.desc: In the first round of combat, if the rock terror was camouflaged behind a rock face and detonates it with its burst wave attack, its foes must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom (Perception) check or be surprised. The stone shards hurled by the explosion deal an extra 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage in addition to the burst wave's normal damage (see below). A creature that isn't surprised can make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage from the stone projection. The rock terror makes no other attack on a turn in which it detonates a rock face.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rock terror makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite, or two with its claws and one burst wave.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Burst Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rock terror emits a wave in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 11 (2d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes only half damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

traits.name: Air Mastery
traits.desc: Airborne creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the thuellai.

traits.name: Snow Sight
traits.desc: The thuellai sees perfectly despite snowy weather. It suffers no Wisdom (Perception) penalty from snow, blizzard, or snow-blindness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thuellai makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 26 (4d12) cold damage. If the target wears metal armor, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The thuellai breathes cold in a 40-foot cone. Creatures caught in the area take 39 (6d12) cold damage, or half as much on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Algid Aura
actions.desc: All creatures within 10 feet of the thuellai take 7 (2d6) cold damage at the start of the thuellai's turn. Spells and magical effects protecting against cold are affected by this aura as if by dispel magic (the thuellai's effective spellcasting bonus is +5) if, at the start of its turn, the thuellai is within 20 feet of the target. Nonmagical flames within 20 feet of the thuellai are extinguished at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Howl of the Mad Winds (3/Day)
actions.desc:
A thuellai's howl can temporarily drive creatures insane and even push them to attack their companions or themselves. Each target that hears the thuellai's howl and is within 100 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or roll 1d8 and consult the table below at the start of its next turn. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. It ends the effect on itself as soon as it succeeds, but on each failure it must roll on the table again at the start of its next turn.
d8 | Result
1 | Acts normally
2-4 | Manages only incoherent mumbling
5-6 | Deals itself 1d8 + Str modifier damage with whatever it is holding
7-8 | Attacks the nearest target, determined randomly if several are available

actions.name: Blizzard (1/Day)
actions.desc: The thuellai creates a frozen blizzard around itself. A 50-foot-radius sphere around the beast fills with freezing fog, swirling snow, and spiraling ice crystals. Visibility is reduced, and creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight or hearing. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain. The effect lasts 10 minutes and moves with the thuellai.

titan-antique.name: Elder Titan
titan-antique.languages: Common, Giant, Primordial, Titan, telepathy 200 ft.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The elder titan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The elder titan's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: power word stun
1/day: power word kill

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elder titan makes two attacks with its greatsword or two attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curious Singularity (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The elder titan opens a momentary tear in the strange power source of its power words. The tear appears at a spot of its choice within 100 feet of it. Each creature within 60 feet of that spot must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 28 (8d6) force damage, falls prone, and is dragged 1d6 x 10 feet toward the curious singularity, taking an extra 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it is dragged. On a success, it takes only half damage and is neither prone nor dragged. The spot where the tear opens becomes the center of an antimagic field with a 60-foot radius until the end of the titan's next turn. This antimagic field doesn't affect the titan's own spells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The degenerate titan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The degenerate titan makes two attacks with its club.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Earth Strike (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The degenerate titan strikes the ground with its fists, creating a shockwave in a line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line takes 35 (10d6) force damage, is hurled 20 feet away from the titan, and lands prone. Creatures that succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw take only half damage and are neither hurled nor knocked prone. A creature hurled against a rigid object, such as a wall or the ground, takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was hurled. If it strikes another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage as the hurled creature (1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet) and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Cry of the Void (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The degenerate titan utters a cry that rips reality in a 30-foot cone. Any spell or magical effect of 3rd level or lower active in the area ends. The titan makes a Constitution check against a DC of 10 + the spell or effect's level against each spell or effect of 4th level or higher active in the area. On a success, the spell or effect ends.

traits.name: Slither
traits.desc: If the titanoboa hasn't eaten a Huge creature in the previous 24 hours, it can move through a space at least 10 feet wide without squeezing, or a 5-foot-wide space while squeezing.

traits.name: Glittering Scales
traits.desc: The titanoboa's scales reflect light in hypnotic, iridescent cascades. If the titanoboa is exposed to bright light, a creature that looks at it within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avoid making the saving throw by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn. A creature that averts its eyes can't see the titanoboa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the snake in the meantime, it must immediately make the saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The titanoboa makes one bite attack and one constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the titanoboa. Once swallowed, it is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the snake, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the titanoboa's turns. If the titanoboa takes 30 or more damage during the turn of a creature it has swallowed, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 feet of it. If the titanoboa dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by expending 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). The target is restrained, and the titanoboa can't constrict another target while this grapple persists.

traits.name: Fiery Heart
traits.desc: The tophet's inner fire ignites or extinguishes at will. It gives off such heat that all creatures within 30 feet of it gain resistance to cold damage.

traits.name: Burning Maw
traits.desc: Creatures thrown into a tophet's burning maw take 21 (6d6) fire damage at the start of each of the tophet's turns. Escaping the beast's belly requires 10 feet of movement and a successful DC 16 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tophet makes two attacks, no more than one of which can be Flame Jet.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. The target is thrown into the tophet's burning maw if the attack is a critical hit.

actions.name: Flame Jet
actions.desc: The tophet targets a point it can see within 100 feet. All targets within 10 feet of that point take 22 (4d10) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Deadly Accuracy
traits.desc: The tosculi elite marauder archer's attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage (included below).

traits.name: Evasive
traits.desc: Ranged attacks against the tosculi elite marauder archer have disadvantage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The tosculi elite marauder archer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Skirmisher
traits.desc: The tosculi elite marauder archer can Dash as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tosculi elite marauder archer makes two attacks with its longbow or two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: Up to two tosculi can occupy the same space at the same time. A tosculi has advantage on attack rolls when it shares its space with another tosculi that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tosculi warrior makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against poison or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Prepare a Host
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one paralyzed creature. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is paralyzed for 8 hours. The paralysis can be ended with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check or with a spell or effect that cures disease. (Because this attack targets only paralyzed creatures, it is automatically a critical hit; the extra damage is already included in the damage listing.)

traits.name: Glider Wings
traits.desc: The tosculi drone can use its wings to slow its fall (as with the feather fall spell). It can move horizontally 5 feet for every 1 foot it falls. The tosculi drone can't gain altitude with its wings alone, but it can exploit a strong wind or an updraft to glide farther.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: Up to two tosculi can occupy the same space at the same time. A tosculi has advantage on attack rolls when it shares its space with another tosculi that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

totivillus.name: Totivillus
totivillus.languages: Common, Celestial, Draconic, Infernal, Void Speech, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to Totivillus that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw unless Totivillus is incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to Totivillus's fear aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Totivillus is a 20th-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). He can cast spells without material components. He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): poison spray, chill touch, minor illusion, light, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, disguise self, illusory script, magic missile, unseen servant
2nd level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, mirror image, hold person, misty step
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, dispel magic, haste, protection from energy
4th level (3 slots): banishment, greater invisibility, polymorph, dimension door
5th level (3 slots): dominate person, compulsion, modify memory, passwall
6th level (2 slots): evil eye, guards and wards, mass suggestion
7th level (2 slots): forcecage, plane shift
8th level (1 slot): feeblemind
9th level (1 slot): time stop

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Totivillus's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Merge with Text
traits.desc: Totivillus can enter any book, scroll, or other written work and remain hidden inside it for as long as he wishes. If the text is damaged or destroyed, he is ejected without suffering damage.

traits.name: Aura of Confidence
traits.desc: Totivillus projects an aura of confidence in a 25-foot radius. As long as he speaks, creatures in this area of effect find him so fascinating and convincing that they must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of their turns. On a failure, they can't directly attack Totivillus until the start of their next turn. If Totivillus makes physical attacks, this effect ends immediately and can't be reactivated for 1 minute. Devils aren't immune to this aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Totivillus makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Bolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 65 (10d12) force damage plus 33 (6d10) thunder damage; the thunder damage is halved on a successful DC 20 Dexterity saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Totivillus makes one claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Devil's Mark
legendaryActions.desc: Totivillus sprays a jet of magical ink from his fingertips at a single target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or receive the devil's mark, in the form of a tattoo representing Totivillus's personal seal. All devils have advantage on spell attacks targeting a creature bearing a devil's mark, and that creature has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and powers used by devils. The mark can be removed with remove curse if the caster also succeeds on a DC 23 spellcasting check. A detect evil and good spell identifies the mark as profane. It often changes position on the body, especially when it is being concealed (and usually at the most inconvenient moment for its bearer). Because the devil's mark sometimes identifies individuals who have entered a pact with a devil, NPC paladins and clerics may believe a character bearing a devil's mark is an ally of the forces of evil.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Totivillus casts a spell chosen from his list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as usual.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The lake troll can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The lake troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The lake troll regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the lake troll takes fire or cold damage, it regains only 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. If it takes both fire and cold damage, its regeneration doesn't function at the start of its next turn. It dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lake troll makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the lake troll hits a creature with both claw attacks in the same turn, the victim must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or its weapon (if it wields one) suffers a permanent, cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If the penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. The damaged weapon can be repaired with the appropriate artisan's tools during a long rest.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: An ukavac can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

traits.name: Hopping
traits.desc: An ukavac can move its enormous bulk in remarkably quick hops that can carry it up to 20 feet at a time, letting it leap over obstacles or enemies. It can also use this hop as a disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An ukavac makes four claw attacks, or two claw attacks and one bite attack, or two claw attacks and one gore attack, or one bite attack and one gore attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). An ukavac can grapple up to two Medium enemies.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Explosive Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: An ukavac can emit a noise like a powerful thunderclap that deafens and injures nearby creatures. Creatures within 15 feet that fail a DC 17 Constitution saving throw take 36 (8d8) thunder damage and are permanently deafened. Those that succeed take only half damage and aren't deafened. The deafness can be cured with lesser restoration.

uraeus.name: Uraeus
uraeus.languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The uraeus doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Ward Bond
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the uraeus forms a magical bond with a willing creature within 5 feet. Thereafter, regardless of the distance between them, the uraeus knows how far away and in which direction its ward is. It also knows its ward's general state of health. The bond persists until the uraeus or its ward perishes, or until the uraeus breaks the bond with an action.

traits.name: Bonded Savior
traits.desc: When the uraeus's ward takes damage, the serpent can transfer that damage to itself. Its damage resistances and immunities don't apply to transferred damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Incandescent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The uraeus breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Creatures caught in the cone take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Death Spasms
traits.desc: When a strangling watcher dies, it releases all the fear it consumed in life in a single wave of soul-rending terror. All creatures within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. Those that fail are frightened. A frightened creature takes 13 (2d12) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns from the dread accumulated over centuries. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The watcher's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: feather fall
3/day each: phantasmal killer, blur, merge with stone
1/day each: greater invisibility, evil eye, black tentacles

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The watcher can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Squeeze
traits.desc: Despite their size, strangling watchers have thin, boneless bodies that let them slip through passages meant for Small creatures, without it affecting their movement or combat abilities.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The watcher makes four tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). The target is restrained until the grapple ends. The watcher can grapple one target per tentacle.

actions.name: Paralyzing Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The watcher can target one creature within 60 feet with its strange gaze. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the watcher's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The urochar crushes a creature it grapples in a tentacle. The creature takes 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The watcher makes one tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Springing Tentacle (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The urochar uses a tentacle to move up to 20 feet and reach an unoccupied space adjacent to a wall, ceiling, floor, or other solid surface. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. To use this action, the urochar must have at least one tentacle free (not grappling a creature). Grappled creatures move with the urochar.

traits.name: Dynastic Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of an ushabti must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw unless the ushabti is incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is left breathless and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. It can't cast spells with verbal components or speak above a whisper until the end of the ushabti's next turn. On a success, it is immune to that ushabti's dynastic aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Healing Theft
traits.desc: If a creature within 30 feet of the ushabti regains hit points thanks to a spell or magical effect, it receives only half the expected hit points while the ushabti regains the other half.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The ushabti is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ushabti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The ushabti's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ushabti makes one attack with its Medjai scepter and one with its khopesh.

actions.name: Medjai Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Khopesh
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The imy-ut ushabti regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Torn Wrappings
traits.desc: A creature that touches an imy-ut ushabti or deals slashing or piercing damage to it while within 5 feet tears its delicate linen wrappings and releases a torrent of scarabs. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid them. On a failure, they cover it and deal 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can remove the scarabs covering itself or an affected ally within reach by using an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. The scarabs are destroyed if the affected creature takes area damage.

actions.name: Ceremonial Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Vomit Swarm (1/Day)
actions.desc:
The imy-ut ushabti willingly parts its wrappings and releases a swarm of scarabs that obey its mental commands. It has the same statistics as an insect swarm, but with the following attack instead of the insect swarm's normal Bites attack:
Bites. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

vaettir.name: Vaettir
vaettir.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Greedy Bond
traits.desc: A corpse-black vaettir sees the face of any creature wearing or carrying an object that once belonged to it. It also knows the direction and distance of objects that once belonged to it, as long as someone else possesses them. If the object changes hands, its new holder becomes the vaettir's target. A bone-white vaettir sees the individuals who offended it. Time and distance have no effect on these abilities as long as the parties remain on the same plane.

traits.name: Rejected by Death
traits.desc: The vaettir is destroyed if it drops to 0 hit points, but it returns to unlife where it was slain at the following dusk, with all its hit points. To kill it for good, one must behead it, burn the corpse, and throw the ashes into the sea — or return it to its burial mound, place a pair of scissors on its chest, and drive needles into its feet.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The vaettir's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
2/day each: gaseous form, hunter's mark
1/day each: enlarge/reduce, phantom steed
1/week each: compulsion, bestow curse, remove curse

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A vaettir avoids direct sunlight, as it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while exposed to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vaettir makes two attacks with its greataxe or two attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cadaverous Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The vaettir spews a 15-foot cone of putrid gas. Creatures caught in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Maddening Gaze (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vaettir can lock its gaze on a creature to drive it mad. Each creature within 30 feet of the vaettir that it fixes with its gaze must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become confused (as with the confusion spell) for 1d4 rounds. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The aeonic wanderer can either use Backwards Drift or make two attacks with its time-warp staff. The wanderer's future version (if it has been summoned) can only use Forwards Drift.

actions.name: Time-Warp Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Backwards Drift (1/Day)
actions.desc: A future version of an aeonic wanderer materializes in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of its present self. The future wanderer has the same statistics as its present version, all of its hit points, and its turn immediately follows its present self's. If the original aeonic wanderer dies, its future double disappears. If the present wanderer sees its future version die, it must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, nothing happens. On a failure, roll a d6 to determine the effect it suffers: 1 = frightened, 2 = incapacitated, 3 = paralyzed, 4 = unconscious, 5 or 6 = disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. This effect lasts 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Forwards Drift (2/Day)
actions.desc: The future version makes one time-warp staff attack against a target. If the attack hits, instead of dealing bludgeoning damage, both the target and the attacker leap forward in time and effectively cease to exist in the present. They reappear in the same spot 1d4 rounds later, at the end of the present wanderer's turn. If creatures occupy those spaces at that moment, they are pushed 5 feet in a direction of their choice. The drift's target (but not the future wanderer) must then make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, with the same effect as an aeonic wanderer witnessing the death of its future version (see Backwards Drift). If it uses this power a second time, the drift's target reappears, but not the future wanderer. This doesn't trigger a saving throw for its present version.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.languages: Common, Giant, Dwarvish, plus any language (see Gift of Tongues)

traits.name: Weapons of Asgard
traits.desc: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with a weapon, she deals an extra 11 (2d10) radiant damage (included in the attacks below).

traits.name: Dreadful Presence
traits.desc: Each living creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of a valkyrie perceives her ominous aura and must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be frightened for 1d4 rounds. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The valkyrie can suppress this aura at will.

traits.name: Gift of Tongues
traits.desc: A valkyrie speaks fluently any language she hears spoken for at least a minute, and she retains that knowledge for her entire life.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The valkyrie's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: bless, speak with animals, spare the dying, sacred flame, bane, invisibility, thaumaturgy
5/day each: warding bond, healing word, gentle repose
3/day each: beacon of hope, mass healing word, vigor
1/day each: compulsion, commune, freedom of movement, death ward

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: The valkyrie casts a spell from her list of at-will spells.

legendaryActions.name: Spear or Longsword Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The valkyrie makes one attack with her longsword or her spear.

legendaryActions.name: Harvest the Dead (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: A valkyrie can take the soul of a recent dead and bind it to a weapon or shield. She can bind no more than one soul to a single object. An individual whose soul is bound can't be returned to life except by means of a wish or similar magic. A valkyrie can release a soul bound by another valkyrie or transfer a bound soul from one object to another. Once bound, the soul gives the object a +1 bonus per 4 character levels the soul possessed (maximum +3). This replaces any other magic previously active on the object. If the GM wishes, part of this bonus can become an appropriate special ability instead (for example, the soul of a fire giant can create a flaming weapon).

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The umbral vampire can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The umbral vampire's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: plane shift (Shadowfell only), mirror image
1/day each: bane (dim light or darkness only), black tentacles

traits.name: Shadow Meld
traits.desc: When the umbral vampire is in dim light or darkness, it can Hide as a bonus action, even while being observed.

traits.name: Strike from the Shadows
traits.desc: The vampire's umbral grip attack gains 10 feet of reach and deals an extra 4d6 damage when the vampire is hidden from its target and both are in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: The umbral vampire has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight while in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Umbral Grip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) cold damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d6. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0; otherwise, the reduction persists until it finishes a long or short rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from its corpse 1d4 hours later.

traits.name: Corrupting Touch
traits.desc: When a corrupting ooze scores a critical hit or starts its turn with an adversary grappled, it can dissolve one leather, wood, or metal object of its choice in that adversary's possession. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Powerful Swimmer
traits.desc: A corrupting ooze floats naturally on water. It swims by pulsations that propel it faster than it walks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13).

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: The putrefying wind can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Polluting Presence
traits.desc: All liquids and plant life in the same space as the putrefying wind at the end of its turn are blighted and cursed. Normal vegetation dies in 1d4 days, while plant creatures take double damage from the wind's actions. Unattended liquids become toxic and unfit to drink.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: The putrefying wind is invisible, as with the greater invisibility spell.

actions.name: Decomposing Wind
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the curse called tomb rot. An affected creature can no longer regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that pass. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, it dies and its body crumbles to dust. The curse persists until someone removes it with remove curse or similar magic.

ver-givre-larve.name: Frost Worm Larva
ver-givre-larve.speed: 30 ft., swim 30 ft., burrow 20 ft. (snow and ice only)

traits.name: Frostborn
traits.desc: A frost worm larva breathes water as easily as air.

traits.name: Ravenous
traits.desc: In its larval stage, the frost worm is tormented by hunger. It can make opportunity attacks against enemies that disengage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The larva makes one tentacle attack and one gnawing attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gnawing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The worm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and along the threads with which it builds its traps, without needing an ability check. An angler worm can't be restrained by its own traps or by those of another angler worm.

traits.name: Sensitive Touch
traits.desc: The angler worm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on vibrations.

traits.name: Transparent Trap
traits.desc: Spotting the threads forming an angler worm's trap requires a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check. This check always has disadvantage unless the creature making it can see invisible things. A creature that enters a space containing an angler worm trap must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky threads (escape DC 14). This saving throw has disadvantage if the creature is unaware of the traps' presence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An angler worm makes one bite attack. It can also make one coils attack against each enemy restrained in its threads and within reach of its coils. Once it has coiled around a creature, it can no longer make coils attacks against the others.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Coils
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) acid damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into a space adjacent to the angler worm (if it isn't already) and grappled in its coils (escape DC 12). While grappled this way, the creature is considered restrained by the angler worm (but not by its trap threads), can't breathe, and takes 22 (5d8) acid damage at the start of each of the angler worm's turns. A creature that successfully escapes the worm's coils might have to immediately make another DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid being restrained again, if it escapes into a space containing another trap.

actions.name: Ethereal Lure (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The angler worm chooses a point within 20 feet of it. Faint blue light shines from that point until the start of its next turn. All creatures that can see the light at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of their next turn. A creature charmed this way must Dash toward the light by the most direct route possible, automatically fails all saving throws to avoid being restrained by the traps, and is unable to see the angler worm.

ver-sathaq.name: Sathaq Worm
ver-sathaq.languages: understands Deep Speech and Terran but can't speak

traits.name: Aura of Suffering
traits.desc: The sathaq worm's presence causes great pain to creatures native to the Material Plane. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the sathaq worm must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to that worm's aura of suffering for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: The sathaq worm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The sathaq worm deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the sathaq worm. Once swallowed, it is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the worm, and takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) slashing plus 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. The sathaq worm can have only one swallowed creature at a time. If the worm takes 20 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of it. If the sathaq worm dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can exit the body by expending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Faux Appearance
traits.desc: While the vesiculose remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pool of water.

traits.name: Rootlet Swarms
traits.desc: The vesiculose is constantly surrounded by four Medium swarms of Tiny rootlets that move as the plant directs them. Each has a speed of 30 feet, can be targeted independently, has 25 hit points, and (unlike the mother plant) is vulnerable to fire damage. Otherwise, it has the same statistics as the plant's main body. The vesiculose loses one of its Snare attacks each time a swarm drops to 0 hit points. A destroyed swarm regrows in 24 hours.

traits.name: Perfumed Water
traits.desc: The vesiculose's pool gives off a sweet fragrance that lures creatures and compels them to drink. Creatures (other than undead and constructs) within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to approach the vesiculose and drink its water. The water is cool and refreshing but contains a soporific poison: any creature (other than undead and constructs) that drinks it regains 1d4 hit points and sheds a level of exhaustion, but it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against poison or fall unconscious for 1 minute. If the creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is unconscious for 1 hour. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it.

traits.name: Luxuriance
traits.desc: The vesiculose's sap seeps into the ground and fertilizes the vegetation. There are always 3d6 beneficial fruits (such as berries, nuts, figs, dates, and so on) within 30 feet of a vesiculose. They have the same effects as the goodberries of the eponymous spell, but they retain their properties for 1 week after being picked or after the vesiculose dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vesiculose uses Snare four times and Coil and Envelope once each. It loses one Snare attack per rootlet swarm destroyed.

actions.name: Snare
actions.desc: The vesiculose targets a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of one of its rootlet swarms. The target takes 10 (4d4) piercing damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). If it succeeds on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, it takes only half damage and isn't grappled. Until the grapple ends, it is restrained, has disadvantage on Strength saving throws and Strength checks, and the rootlet swarm responsible for the grapple can't grapple another target.

actions.name: Coil
actions.desc: Each rootlet swarm that has grappled a creature moves up to 20 feet toward the vesiculose's body. The rootlets can venture up to 100 feet from the body.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: The vesiculose envelopes all restrained or unconscious creatures within 5 feet of its main body (up to 2 Large creatures, 4 Medium creatures, or 8 Small creatures). Once swallowed, a creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the vesiculose, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the vesiculose's turns. When the vesiculose moves, enveloped creatures move with it. An enveloped creature can try to escape by using an action to make a DC 15 Strength check. On a success, it escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the vesiculose's body.

traits.name: Fed by Darkness
traits.desc: If a vidien is in magical darkness at the start of its turn, it heals 5 hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
