traits.desc: The vidien has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, except those that deal radiant damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The vidien's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, fear, darkness
3/day each: eldritch blast (3 beams), black tentacles
1/day each: phantasmal force, reverse gravity

traits.name: Natural Invisibility
traits.desc: A vidien in absolute darkness is considered invisible to creatures relying on normal vision or darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vidien makes four tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Filament
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The vidien causes a burst of necrotic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Creatures caught in the sphere take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Close Shaver
traits.desc: The wicked barber has advantage on attack rolls against creatures in the same space as it.

traits.name: Inhuman Quickness
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take two bonus actions on its turn instead of one. They must be different; it can't take the same bonus action twice in the same turn.

traits.name: Invasive
traits.desc: The wicked barber can enter a hostile creature's space (whatever its size), move through it, or even stay there without penalty.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Filch
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take the Use an Object action or make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as a bonus action.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the wicked barber can magically teleport from a space of dim light or darkness it currently occupies to another space of dim light or darkness it can see within 80 feet. Equipment it wears or carries moves with it. The barber has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wicked barber makes two attacks with its straight razor.

actions.name: Straight Razor
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Festering Cut
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the wicked barber, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The attack's victim and its allies who see the attack must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1d4 rounds.

traits.name: Dance of the Unlucky (1/Day)
traits.desc: A vila who dances for 1 hour creates a fairy ring of small gray mushrooms. It persists for seven days and is 50 feet in diameter per vila participating in the dance. Creatures other than vilas that fall asleep (including magically) inside this ring have disadvantage on ability checks for 24 hours from the moment they wake.

traits.name: Forest Swiftness
traits.desc: In a forest environment, the vila gains a +4 bonus on initiative checks.

traits.name: Forest Meld
traits.desc: A vila can meld into any tree of its forest for as long as it wishes, as with the merge with stone spell.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The vila's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). She can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: sleep
1/week: control weather

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A vila makes two attacks with her short sword or two attacks with her short bow.

actions.name: Short Sword +1
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Short Bow +1
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fascinate (1/Day)
actions.desc: When the vila sings, creatures that can hear her within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. Those that succeed on their save are immune to that vila's song for 24 hours.

actions.name: Song of the Forest (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vila can magically call 2d6 wolves or 2 wampus cats. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds. They act as allies of the vila and obey her spoken commands. They remain for an hour, until the vila dies, or until she dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target is blinded and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.desc: The marsh viper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in swampy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target is paralyzed and takes 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Refrigerant Acid
traits.desc: The acid mist given off by a frost veil can reduce flesh and organic matter to nutrients it can absorb. Creatures that strike a frost veil with a melee weapon that lacks reach, or with an unarmed strike, take 4 (1d8) acid damage.

traits.name: Faux Appearance
traits.desc: While a frost veil is motionless, it is indistinguishable from a natural formation of frost or ice.

traits.name: Windborne
traits.desc: When carried by the wind, a frost veil can fly at a speed of 30 feet. In a strong wind, this speed is 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The frost veil makes three filament attacks.

actions.name: Filament
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If two filaments hit the same target in a single turn, that target is enveloped.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: When a frost veil wraps around a Medium or smaller creature, that creature takes 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). The target also takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and 13 (3d8) acid damage at the end of each of its turns while grappled by the frost veil. A frost veil can't attack while it envelops a creature. All damage received by the frost veil is split evenly with the creature it envelops, except slashing and psychic damage, which affect only the frost veil.

actions.name: Spirit Spores (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: When in distress, frost veils release around themselves a 10-foot cube of psychotropic spores. Creatures caught in this cloud must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against poison or suffer hallucinations, as if affected by the confusion spell, for 1d3 rounds.

traits.name: Focused Animosity
traits.desc: The wampus cat has advantage on melee attacks against a male individual she has seen using divine magic or brandishing a holy symbol.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The wampus cat's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). She can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self (human appearance), mage hand
2/day: hex

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The wampus cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Meow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Intelligent creatures within 60 feet of the wampus cat that can hear her must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. Those that fail find the meow very pleasant and attractive, so the wampus cat has advantage on Charisma checks against them for 1 minute. They can't attack the wampus cat before that time ends unless they are damaged in the interim.

traits.name: Bone Trap
traits.desc: When the sand wyrm is underground with its bony protrusions exposed, it can snap them shut on a Large creature, two Medium creatures, or four Small or smaller creatures standing directly above it. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature can spend an action to make a DC 15 Strength check to free itself or another restrained creature, ending the effect on a success. A creature restrained by this trait moves with the sand wyrm. The wyrm's stinger attack has advantage against creatures restrained by this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand wyrm makes one bite attack and one stinger attack. It can replace the bite with a gore attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour. Regaining hit points doesn't end the poison or the paralysis.

xanka.name: Xanka
xanka.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The xanka's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Weapon Ingestion
traits.desc: When the xanka is hit by a melee weapon and the final adjusted attack roll is 19 or lower, that weapon suffers a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls after dealing this attack's damage. If the penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Even magic weapons are subject to this effect.

actions.name: Absorb
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage, and the xanka regains hit points equal to the damage dealt by this attack. In addition, if this attack hits a living creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or have a gaping wound open on it, dealing 2 (1d4) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns until it is healed by magic or with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Medicine) check. If the creature that fails this saving throw wears armor or a shield, it can avoid the necrotic damage by instead permanently reducing its armor or shield's AC by 1.

traits.name: Grasp a Thread of Fate
traits.desc: The xhkarsh targets a creature whose fate it has already corrupted within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or a portion of the xhkarsh's consciousness installs itself in its body. The target still controls itself, but the xhkarsh can control its actions for 1 minute per day and alter its memories as a bonus action (as if casting the modify memory spell, DC 15). The target is unaware of the xhkarsh's presence but can make a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check once per 24 hours to notice it. The effect persists until the xhkarsh ends it or the target's fate is restored with dispel evil and good or similar magic. The victim is immune to this effect for 24 hours when it succeeds on a saving throw against it and after the effect ends for any reason. A xhkarsh can hold up to four threads of fate at a time.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: The xhkarsh is invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration breaks. Equipment the xhkarsh wears and carries becomes as invisible as it is.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The xhkarsh makes two claw attacks and two stinger attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its fate corrupted. A corrupted target has disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws and is immune to divination spells and effects that sense emotions or read thoughts. The target's fate can be restored with a dispel evil and good spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Sharp Horns
traits.desc: The ychen bannog deals triple weapon damage dice when it scores a critical hit with a gore attack.

traits.name: Peaceful Creature
traits.desc: The ychen bannog hates fighting and prefers to flee from combat. If it can't, it attacks an enemy or obstacle to carve a path to safety. A rider mounted on a ychen bannog, or a handler on foot beside it, can use an action to make a DC 16 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. On a success, the ychen bannog moves and attacks as directed. On a failure, the beast flees. The handler or rider must be proficient in Animal Handling to attempt the check.

traits.name: Trample
traits.desc: When the ychen bannog takes the Dash action, it can move through the space of a Large or smaller creature, treating that space as difficult terrain. It can make a tread attack as a bonus action as it moves through the creature's space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ychen bannog makes one gore attack and one tread attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Devastating Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The ychen bannog lets out a terrifying bellow audible up to 10 miles away. Structures and unattended objects in an 60-foot cone take 55 (10d10) thunder damage. Creatures in the cone take 27 (5d10) thunder damage and are deafened for 1 hour. They take only half damage and aren't deafened on a successful DC 18 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zimwi makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the zimwi, it is swallowed and the grapple ends. Once swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the zimwi, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. If the zimwi's stomach takes 20 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the zimwi must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 5 feet of it. Damage dealt to the zimwi's stomach doesn't harm the zimwi. Its stomach is bigger on the inside than on the outside; it can hold two Medium swallowed creatures or four Small or smaller swallowed creatures at a time. If the zimwi dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by expending 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the zimwi isn't grappling anyone, it is grappled (escape DC 11).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Leap from Lake to Lake
traits.desc: A zmey spends most of its time in lakes and ponds. While submerged in a natural body of still water, it can move as a bonus action to a similar body of water within 5,000 feet. This power doesn't work in a fast current, but the zmey can leap from or into a river or stream with calm, lazy waters.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The zmey typically has three heads. While it has more than one head, it has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and stunned. If the zmey takes 40 or more damage in a single turn (other than psychic or poison damage), one of its heads is severed. It dies if all three are cut off.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The zmey regains 15 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the zmey takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the beast's next turn. Regeneration stops working once all three heads are severed. A severed head takes 24 hours to grow back.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.desc: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Brood Head
traits.desc: A zmey's severed head grows into a young zmey 2d6 rounds after being separated from the body. At least 1 pound of salt must be poured on the head's neck stump to prevent this transformation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zmey makes one bite attack per head and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The zmey breathes up to three 60-foot cones of fire (one per head). Creatures caught in a cone take 16 (3d10) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. If the cones overlap, their damage stacks, but each target makes only one saving throw. The zmey can choose whether this attack harms plants or plant creatures.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.desc: The zmey makes one bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The zmey makes one tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Trample
legendaryActions.desc: The zmey moves up to half its speed. It can enter an enemy's space but can't end its movement there. A creature in a space the zmey moves through must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The baby zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The baby zmey regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the baby zmey takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the beast's next turn. It dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The baby zmey makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The baby zmey breathes a 30-foot cone of fire. Creatures caught in the cone take 16 (3d10) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

necrophore.name: Necrophore
necrophore.speed: walk 30 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 10 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The necrophore makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The necrophore spits acid in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Creatures in the line take 32 (5d12) acid damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: A giant ant queen has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.

traits.name: Royal Scent
traits.desc: Giant ants defending a queen have advantage on all their attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A giant ant queen makes two bite attacks and one sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the giant ant queen can't bite a different target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.desc: The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. If it moves at half its speed or less, attacks made against it before the start of its next turn have disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gbahali makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the gbahali can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
